jobs.title: Project Architect
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a talented and motivated Project Architect to join our Buildings + Places business line in Houston, Dallas and Austin Texas. This role provides an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful projects for public and private clients. The ideal candidate will have strong design and technical expertise, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to lead design efforts while delivering high-quality architectural solutions.

As a Project Architect you will play a key role in project delivery, working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure design excellence and client satisfaction. This position is ideal for an experienced architect looking to advance their career by taking on greater leadership responsibilities.

US West Buildings + Places as a vast market spread and geography, providing opportunities across a wide range of project typologies, including Science & Technology, Advanced Manufacturing, Commercial, Aerospace, Higher Education, Industrial and Process, Transportation, Aviation, Sports and Federal market sectors across the western United States and beyond. As a dynamic team of Architects, Planners, and Engineers. We strive to incorporate beauty, sustainability, resiliency, equity, and innovation in our projects.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Design Leadership: Lead the design process for projects in commercial, industrial, logistics, and interiors sectors, ensuring innovative and functional solutions.
• Project Coordination: Collaborate with project teams, including engineers, consultants, and other stakeholders, to integrate architectural and technical solutions.
• Documentation: Prepare and oversee detailed design documentation, including drawings, specifications, and reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with building codes.
• Client Interaction: Support client engagement efforts, including presentations, design reviews, and addressing project-related inquiries.
• Team Collaboration: Work closely with senior architects and project managers to deliver projects on time and within budget.

Key Competencies

• Design Excellence: Passion for creating innovative and functional architectural solutions.
• Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly to clients and stakeholders.
• Problem-Solving: Creative and analytical thinker capable of addressing complex design challenges.
• Attention to Detail: Commitment to accuracy and quality in all aspects of project delivery.
• Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, fostering a culture of cooperation and innovation.

To be fully proficient in this role, the candidate must possess the following experience and skills:

• Licensed Architect in the state of Texas (or ability to obtain licensure within a year of hire date).
• Proficiency in design software such as Revit, AutoCAD, and SketchUp, as well as visualization tools like Enscape or Lumion.
• Strong understanding of building codes, construction methods, and sustainability practices.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's in Architecture
• 4+ years of professional experience in architectural design and project delivery or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Architecture
• 6+ years of professional experience in architectural design and project delivery or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Licensed Architect in the state of Texas.
• Demonstrated expertise in interiors projects, including programming, space planning, material selection, furniture selections, and user-centric design.
• Experience in commercial projects, with a proven ability to deliver high-quality designs.
• Strong portfolio showcasing impactful architectural designs across relevant sectors.
• LEED Accreditation or equivalent sustainability certification is a plus.

• This position will not offer sponsorship now or in the future

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Mixed Pet Veterinary Hospital - Veterinary Assistant/Technician
jobs.description:
Who is VetEvolve?

VetEvolve is a network of veterinary practices built to support the people delivering care and the practices they lead. We combine clinical insight with operational strength to give our teams the support, tools, and structure they need to thrive, without losing what makes each practice unique. We are intentionally focused on growth, not as an end in itself, but as a way to strengthen our practices, expand access to care, and create more opportunities for our teams.

Guided by our values: Care First. Better Together. Grow Forward. Own It. We create an environment where veterinary professionals can do their best work, build meaningful careers, and deliver exceptional care. Growth with intention. Care without compromise.

Lead Veterinary Assistant

Compensation: $XX–$XX/hour, commensurate with licensure and experience

Position Summary:

The Lead Veterinary Assistant is a senior clinical support leader responsible for setting the standard for patient care, team performance, and operational excellence within the hospital. In addition to performing advanced Veterinary Assistant duties, the Lead Veterinary Assistant serves as a mentor, trainer, and process improvement partner for the Practice Manager and veterinary team. This role may include direct supervision of Veterinary Assistants and plays a key role in ensuring consistency, efficiency, and high-quality clinical support.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Model and reinforce exceptional patient care, client communication, and professional standards across the hospital.

• Provide mentorship, training, and day-to-day guidance to Veterinary Assistants, supporting skill development and performance consistency.

• Assist veterinarians during exams, diagnostics, treatments, and surgical procedures, serving as a clinical resource for the team.

• Safely restrain animals and ensure proper handling techniques are followed by all team members.

• Support onboarding and training of new Veterinary Assistants, reinforcing hospital protocols and clinical workflows.

• Monitor and support adherence to medical, safety, and sanitation protocols.

• Partner with the Practice Manager to identify opportunities for workflow improvements, efficiency gains, and enhanced patient care.

• Assist with scheduling, coverage coordination, and task prioritization for Veterinary Assistants as needed.

• Support inventory management, stocking of clinical supplies, and organization of treatment and exam areas.

• Serve as a point of escalation for clinical support questions and operational concerns within the assistant team.

• Ensure accurate medical record documentation, treatment plan entry, and charge capture.

• Maintain compliance with all safety, confidentiality, and patient care protocols.

• Perform all standard Veterinary Assistant duties as needed to support hospital operations.

• Perform other duties as assigned by the Practice Manager.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Minimum of 3 years of veterinary assistant or related animal care experience required.

• Prior experience mentoring, training, or leading peers strongly preferred.

• Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to lead by example and foster a collaborative, positive team environment.

• Proficiency in veterinary practice management software and Microsoft Office applications.

• Ability to remain composed and professional in high-stress or emotionally charged situations.

• Able to work safely around cleaning chemicals, anesthetic gases, radiation, zoonotic diseases, and animal bodily fluids.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and safely handle animals up to 130 pounds.

• Comfortable sitting, standing, walking, bending, and kneeling for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Professional, neat appearance consistent with hospital standards.

Hours:

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule and be available for scheduling during all hours the practice is open to support hospital operations.

• Typically 35-40 hours/week. Rotating Saturday schedule.

Compensation and Benefits:

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage. In addition, employees are eligible to participate in our 401(k) retirement plan. Other benefits include paid time off, paid holidays and access to employee assistance program.

Ready to Learn More?

We look forward to learning about your unique priorities and goals and working together with our local hospital teams to support you.

jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on Our Mission

Zocdoc’s most important asset is our people. An Executive Assistant serves as a trusted and valuable business partner to our leadership team. Their primary responsibility is to optimize and prioritize the leadership's time, ensuring the smooth execution of their goals. By working closely with the team, possessing excellent communication skills, delivering top-notch customer service, and fostering a strong relationship with leadership, this person guarantees that the executives can concentrate on high-yield strategic initiatives.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

• Guided by a strong EQ, autonomous, urgent, and creative

• A highly motivated problem-solver who works well under pressure

• Passionate about organization and structure, but adaptable and resourceful when things change

• The kind of person who enjoys working with others and finding ways to collaborate effectively

• A strong and effective communicator across all mediums (in person, slack, email, phone)

Your day-to-day is…

Full ownership of multiple calendars for our C-suite level leadership team

• Collaborating closely with the broader EA team on projects and events that contribute to a dynamic and supportive environment

• Understanding your executive's preferences, including meeting cadence, travel logistics, and conference room preparation

• Managing meetings and schedules efficiently, both recurring and ad hoc, while keeping calendars organized and prioritizing tasks effectively

• Meeting management, including preparing agendas, taking notes, distributing action items, etc.

• Assisting in scheduling and running high-profile meetings, including Executive off-sites, and ongoing staff meetings. This includes, but is not limited to, attendee communications and venue management/coordination

• Coordinating and overseeing complex domestic and international travel arrangements, including all necessary documentation

• Working with internal members on coordinating any health and tech-related conferences as needed

• Complete expense reports and manage company documents and contracts as needed

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

• A minimum of 4-5 years experience in an Executive Assistant role supporting senior level executives

• Superb communication and relationship management skills! You believe in keeping your stakeholders in the loop and know that multiple communication mediums are the key to success

• Courage. You are able to know when to say yes and when to say no across various competing priorities

• You can handle sensitive and confidential information with high professionalism and discretion

• Humility. You believe in treating everyone with dignity and respect, regardless of title or tenure. You view this role as an opportunity to create positive change

• Passion for customer service, with the ability to adapt to various personalities and rapidly shifting priorities

• A compassionate but consultative and confident approach with a nothing-too-big, nothing-too-small attitude

• A fundamental understanding of urgency and a passion for getting results (we move fast around here!)

Time Expectations:

• Regular Schedule - Monday- Friday 9-6 pm

• Hybrid role with 4 days/week required onsite in our New York HQ

• 24/7 as needed

Benefits:

• Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location

• Unlimited Vacation

• 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)

• Commuter Benefits

• 401(k) with employer funded match

• Corporate wellness program with Wellhub

• Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)

• Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement

• Cell phone reimbursement

• Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks

• Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging

• Great Place to Work Certified

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

NYC Base Salary Range

$125,000—$160,000 USD

About us
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better.  We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

jobs.description:
About Us

Vertex Service Partners is a home improvement services company focused on residential roofing and other exterior services across the United States. Backed by Alpine Investors, a top-decile private equity fund with $4.0 billion of committed capital, Vertex is building a best-in-class national platform. Our company is built on our core values—servant leadership, unwavering character, a growth mindset, persistence, empowerment, pace, and fun—and guided by three pillars: being the Employer of Choice, Partner of Choice, and Contractor of Choice. We offer transformative support in operations, marketing, training, talent, finance, and technology, all while preserving the autonomy of local brands.

As the Regional Director of Sales, you will be responsible for overseeing the performance of Partner Directors of Sales and Sales Managers across a portfolio of partner brands in your region. You will play a key leadership role in growing revenue, scaling high-performing sales teams, and ensuring consistent execution of the Vertex Sales Methodology. Your leadership will shape sales talent, instill performance discipline, and strengthen our culture of excellence, professionalism, and fun. This is a high-impact role with a direct influence on Vertex’s long-term success.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive revenue growth across partner brands by coaching and developing Sales Managers and Partner Directors of Sales

• Support recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and development of Sales Managers and Sales Leaders across multiple territories

• Reinforce and standardize Vertex Sales Methodology across partner companies with the support of market sales trainers

• Lead performance management through KPIs such as close rate %, NSLI, financing utilization, first-call close %, and sales team pipeline growth

• Conduct ride-alongs, shadowing, and coaching sessions with Sales Managers to elevate effectiveness and team performance

• Identify sales process gaps and lead coaching and training sessions focused on consultative selling, closing techniques, and sales leadership

• Standardize effective weekly sales meetings and leadership rhythms with Sales Managers and Partner Directors

• Collaborate with General Managers and operational leaders to align sales and operational goals and accountability structures

• Share and scale sales best practices across partner companies to improve team performance and efficiency

• Partner with training teams and product experts to develop and co-deliver impactful training content

• Support team and territory expansion efforts, including designing scalable sales org structures and territory coverage models

Qualifications:

Required:

• In-home B2C sales experience in a one-call-close environment (home improvement industry strongly preferred)

• Proven track record of success leading sales managers and/or multi-market sales teams

• Strong experience in sales training and team development

• Consultative sales approach with the ability to coach at all levels of the sales organization

• Proficient in interpreting and acting on sales KPIs and CRM-driven performance data

Preferred:

• Experience scaling sales organizations across multiple locations

• Deep knowledge of home services or construction industries

• Familiarity with Vertex's values and commitment to professional growth, operational excellence, and people-first culture

• Strategic Leader: Sees the big picture and connects day-to-day actions to long-term outcomes

• Coaching Mindset: Committed to lifting up sales leaders and teams through guidance and development

• Process-Builder: Skilled at creating consistent frameworks while adapting to local nuances

• Collaborative Partner: Builds trust and alignment across GMs, operations, and training functions

• Culture Champion: Embodies and spreads Vertex’s values of growth, professionalism, and fun

This Role Offers the Opportunity To:

• Lead sales strategy and execution at a regional level for a growing portfolio of respected brands

Job Description

The Maintenance Shift Supervisor ensures that all planned / unplanned maintenance activities for the for loading and drilling equipment is properly executed in a safe and efficient manner. Work closely with other teams and supervisors within mobile maintenance and other departments across the site. This is a rotating schedule.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Review and direct technicians on all scheduled / unscheduled repair activities, ensuring safe / efficient execution.
• Discuss upcoming schedules and plans with peers
• Coordinate with the operations supervisors / dispatcher for all scheduled activities. Ensure the sequencing matches the schedule as developed.
• Assign and distribute the work order packages which include appropriate standard job plans, single point lessons, oil sample labels to the technicians.
• Spend at minimum 50% of time on “visible felt leadership” interacting with the technicians and service contractors.
• Attend meetings when on shift to communicate current machine status & priority, unplanned sick leave, parts issues, required schedule changes and uncompleted work orders requiring rescheduling.
• Proactive interaction with Reactive and PM Technicians – supporting and executing safety / reliability improvements to the equipment.
• Work order and operating system management
• Develop crew support for other continuous improvement initiatives.

Essential:

• 5 to 10 years technical experience in the Mining Maintenance Sector with an emphasis on loaders, hydraulic shovels, excavators, platform drills and boom drills

• 2 years’ experience as a supervisor or an equivalent supervisory position
• Direct practical experience working with mining equipment, particularly Komatsu PC 3000 & 4000, CAT 6020 excavators, CAT 992K, 993K, 988H front end loaders, electric drive haul trucks and various CAT ancillary equipment.
• Heavy Equipment Maintenance Technician degree preferred but not required

Skills:

• MS Office Suite (MS Excel, MS Word, MS Outlook)
• Pronto software experience would be desired
• CAT SIS
• CAT ET
• MyKomatsu
• Cummins Quickserve and related programs
• Minestar

Key Result Areas & Measures

• Excellent and demonstrated commitment to safety & health, interacting with maintenance shop personnel to ensure activities are completed without compromise to the safety and health of all personnel.
• Focus on “visible felt leadership” spending at minimum 50% of time interacting with the technicians.
• Ensure key performance measures are actively reviewed with the technicians targeting fleet availability.
• Positive and enthusiastic team member, seeking to assist and mentor others.
• Rigorous and thorough management for completing scheduled / unscheduled activities to minimize the production impact of the equipment being down for maintenance activities.
• Actively and constructively communicate opportunities for improvement / development to technicians consistently updating individuals as to their current job performance.
• Maintain rigorous housekeeping habits of all maintenance work areas.
• Maintain maintenance shift reports, area inspections, planned general inspections, dispatch reporting data and employee evaluations.
• Maintain good working relationships with key vendors / manufacturers such as Linder (Komatsu), Blanchard (Cat)
• Provide technical support and training to the PM and repair technicians.
• Submit - at minimum - one Field Level Risk Assessment daily.

Physical Requirements:

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, sit, demonstrate manual dexterity, climb stairs, talk, hear and see.
• Must be Fit for Duty: Able to lift and carry 50lbs overhead, climb ladders, work at heights, etc.
• Must be able to work in adverse weather conditions: wind, rain, sun.
• Work is in a surface mine setting, which may include exposure to extremes in temperature and humidity.
• Personal protective equipment is required when performing work in a mine environment, including hard hat, hearing protection, safety glasses, safety footwear, and as needed, respirator, rubber steel-toe boots, protective clothing, gloves, and any other protective equipment as required.
• Haile Gold Mine, Inc. promotes a drug/alcohol free work environment through the use of mandatory pre-employment drug testing and on-going random drug testing.

WHAT'S ON OFFER:

• Competitive salary + short-term and long-term bonus
• Comprehensive benefits package including health, vision and dental insurance, 401K, and more
• Access to OceanaGold Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

YOU MATTER: OceanaGold is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. We believe a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. Should you require any assistance applying for this opportunity, please contact us at careers@oceanagold.com

PLEASE NOTE: APPLICATIONS FROM AGENCIES WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Paralegal
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

We're looking for a Senior Corporate Paralegal to join Ramp's Legal team and own the operational backbone of how we govern and structure  the company. Ramp runs a growing portfolio of U.S. and non-U.S. entities — including regulated and licensed subsidiaries — across a business that ships constantly and raises, acquires, and expands on short notice. You will be the person who keeps that machinery accurate, current, and audit-ready.

This is a broad generalist role. You'll sit at the center of corporate governance, entity management, equity administration, and litigation/employment and you'll partner directly with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, Equity Admin, and People, and outside counsel. We are a small, high-leverage team supporting a company that moves quickly, so you'll cover a lot of ground and be trusted to run matters independently.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Corporate governance: Prepare board and stockholder meeting materials, agendas, minutes, written consents, resolutions, secretary's certificates, and incumbency certificates. Track and calendar governance obligations across the entity portfolio.

 - Entity management: Own the full lifecycle of entity administration — formations and dissolutions, foreign qualifications, annual reports, franchise tax filings, registered agent management, signatories, officer and director lists, post-integration cleanup.

 - KYC, UBO, and diligence: Respond to KYC/UBO and diligence requests from bank partners, regulators, auditors, insurers, and counterparties, and build reusable packages.

 - Equity support: Support equity administration, option and RSU grants, board approvals of equity awards, secondaries, and equity plan recordkeeping in partnership with Finance and People.

 - Transaction support: Run diligence support, signature collection, closing checklists, closing binders, and post-closing obligations for financings, credit facilities, M&A, real estate, and insurance renewals.

 - Commercial and cross-functional support: Assist with powers of attorney, delegations of authority, and corporate approvals needed by the business.

 - Employment support: Support employment- and immigration-related requests and filings.

 - Litigation support: Support subpoena and law enforcement requests, legal holds, e-discovery, and document production. Review and respond to garnishment orders and UCC liens. Serve as Ramp’s custodian of records and as Ramp’s representative in small claims court cases.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 6+ years of corporate paralegal experience at a major law firm and/or in-house at a high-growth technology or financial services company.

 - Deep working knowledge of corporate governance, entity formation and maintenance, corporate recordkeeping, and secretary's office functions.

 - Excellent drafting skills across resolutions, consents, certificates, and corporate documentation, with genuine precision — you catch the wrong entity name, the stale date, and the missing signature block.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently run multiple time-sensitive workstreams without dropping threads or waiting to be asked.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills and the judgment to work directly with executives, board members, outside counsel, and cross-functional partners.

 - Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and processes are still being built — and a bias toward action.

 - High judgment around confidential and sensitive corporate information.

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a fintech, payments, or regulated financial services company, including support for licensed entities (money transmitter, EMI, or similar).

 - Experience supporting venture financings, secondaries, M&A integration, or IPO readiness.

 - International entity management experience across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, or Canada.

 - Experience with equity administration and cap table platforms (e.g., Shareworks).

 - Experiencing with litigation or employment matters.

 - Notary Public commission (NY or CA), or willingness to obtain one.

 - ABA-approved paralegal certificate.

 - A track record of using AI or automation to eliminate manual legal work.




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

 

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice https://ramp.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice

jobs.title: Nurse Educator P/T (Non-Profit) - Manhattan
jobs.description:

Pay Rate: $44 per hour

Schedule: 21 hours per week .....Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 8:30am-4:30pm.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

▪ Implement on-site and centralized training in broad range of compliance, safety and service-related issues, including OSHA; AMAP/AMAP Refresher; Diabetes Management; Dysphagia; First Aid; CPR; and other topics.

▪ Provide ad hoc on-site training and refreshers where instructional need is identified (e.g., diet consistencies, addressing swallowing issues, etc.)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fundraising) — Remote
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Location: This role is fully remote but you must overlap with East Africa Time and US Eastern Time (8am-6pm) by at least 3 hours. As an example, 6PM East Africa Time is 11AM US Eastern time in the summer and 10AM in the winter. In practice, if you are in the Eastern US timezone, that means being regularly available for 8AM meetings and some 7AM ones. We know people have commitments like school drop-offs, so you’re encouraged to set a schedule that works for you -- as long as there’s sufficient overlap with the team. Please note that we can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

About this role:

Are you an experienced engineer at the stage of your career where, above all, you want to do good?

This role is about using engineering to support fundraising: delighting our donors; helping our fundraisers; getting donations recorded and safely started on their journey to our recipients; telling donors and the public about what happens to their gifts. A bit of website development. A lot of plumbing.

The good news about this position:

• You will make a difference to people in extreme poverty

• You will work independently, with few constraints

• You will work directly with lovely people from across our fundraising teams

The trade-offs:

• There is only one other fundraising engineer and mostly you will be working on your own

• Our technology is a mixture of boring (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML and CSS) and legacy (Salesforce, Wordpress, wrangling CSV files sent by our partners)

• We're growing, but this is a role for someone who values depth and impact over a fast title ladder.

The maybe good maybe bad news about the role depending on who you are:

• We are all in on AI where it allows us to get more $ to people in extreme poverty

If you want a role where you will be part of a bigger engineering team, working in Python or working on more complex tasks, then please take a look at our other engineering roles.

This role is right for you if:

• You care about our mission

• You agree with our values

• You have the right to work in one of the countries we're able to hire from (you can check the current list here).

• You're happy working remotely, and taking meetings across East Africa Time and US Eastern Time.

• You are happy to travel to meet your colleagues in the US, Europe and Africa a few weeks a year

• You are fluent in English

• You have 4+ years of engineering experience

• You're happy working autonomously: defining what needs doing, doing it, getting it tested and launched, fixing the bugs, and hustling to make progress every day.

• You're comfortable being on-call on peak donation days (Giving Tuesday and the last weeks of the year), including owning an incident: working out what matters, communicating with fundraisers, and debugging on legacy and others' code, sometimes when no other engineers are available.

• You are happy with our boring and legacy technologies (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, Wordpress, SQL, wrangling csv files etc). You don’t have to be experienced in all of them, but you do have to be genuinely happy to use them (many engineers are not…).

• You are happy and skilled at working directly with non-engineers on messy, poorly defined, rapidly changing, sometimes boring tasks

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

• Base Salary: $181,130

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$27,170, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$31,789 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $208,300+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

• Base Salary: £124,370

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~£18,656, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~£21,827 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £143,026+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

• Base Salary: $112,350

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$16,853, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$19,717 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $129,203+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,453

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

• A positive and supportive team with opportunities for advancement

• A demonstrated commitment to helping all staff develop and grow

• A competitive salary, including bonus

• A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)

• Unlimited PTO (that we encourage staff to take!)

• Desk allowance and flexible work location

About this specific hiring process

• Take-home coding assignment

• Live Coding (60 mins)

• Systems Design (60 mins)

• Project Deep Dive + Behavioral (60 mins)

*It’s possible that there will be adjustments to this interview process. Any changes will be communicated to you during the process.

#LI-REMOTE

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing,  reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or  exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

jobs.title: Commercial Market Leader II
jobs.description:
If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your role is focused on providing leadership of the Commercial  market within the west region of CannonDesign. This includes being responsible for developing and leading high-performance diverse teams focused on the development and implementation of the office or regional Market Business Plan. You will contribute to the success of the firm including the areas of business development and client engagement, client, and team leadership, mentoring of our people, and advancing the quality of work. You will be accountable to integrate our range of design services, managing our processes and delivering solid financial performance for the market. Importantly, you will be an ambassador of our brand, championing Living-Centered Design and bringing our Firm's purpose - to help people continuously flourish - to life in every touchpoint you have with our clients.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO

In this role you will focus most of your time on activities that support the growth and impact of the market, including external brand opportunities. Secondly, you will focus your time on client and team leadership responsibilities engaged directly on projects.

Areas of Focus

• Market Leadership: Responsible for advancing strategic initiatives and client pursuit discussions and strategies. Working with Office and other Market Leadership, you will lead the development of the market business plan. This plan will outline strategies and actionable items that advance client engagement and development, market differentiation and team building/leadership to foster the growth of the market in concert with firm-wide goals. You will participate and engage with other health market leaders in ways to improve our practice globally.

• Top Line Development: Work with Client Leaders and other firm-wide resources to focus on growing the top line of the market by identifying and actively pursuing new target clients as well as nurturing existing client relationships. You will seek to differentiate CannonDesign in the marketplace and promote the full range of our integrated design services, supporting the advancement of Living-Centered Design in all phases of client engagement. In this role you will be accountable for the overall top line results of the market and have a personal goal of achieving top line success of $4.0M per year in net signed fees.

• Client and Team Leadership: Lead by example. Demonstrate commitment to our clients by undertaking the work in an active way on select client project opportunities. Serve as a client leader and/or subject matter expert where appropriate.

• Understand the Market: Identify future market trends and opportunities for growth and advancement of the market. Demonstrate a high level of knowledge of the market, including “Best Practices,” and evidence-based and research-based design.

• Bottom Line Success: Collaborate with the Office Practice Leader, Business Practice Leader, and Client Leaders to ensure that the business plan bottom line initiatives are successfully implemented. Achieve a minimum of 10% firm profitability level for the market each year.

• Staff Development: Assess, mentor and coach, and recruit staff to build a high-performance team, and to develop future leaders within your market. Take ownership for the growth of a diverse and inclusive team. Assist in establishing an environment that encourages leadership, integrity, humility, respect, and responsibility, along with collaboration, experimentation, innovation, creativity and entrepreneurship.

Targets are subject to change as CannonDesign periodically evaluates our performance metrics.

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• Bachelor degree in a relevant field required.

• Current Registration/Licensure in Architecture, Interior Design or Engineering preferred.

• Additional certifications and/or training relevant to this role are preferred.

• Must have a minimum of 15 years of experience with a proven track record of strategic growth, market and team leadership, and business development success in the Commercial Market.

• Strong presentations skills are essential.

• Exceptional client and people leadership skills required.

• Strong business acumen and proven ability to create and execute strategy is needed.

• Professional acumen and maturity demonstrated by the ability to communicate authentically and respectfully is essential.

• Ability to inspire, motivate and develop high-performing, accountable teams.

• Must be able to demonstrate sound judgement and a sound approach regarding risk management and mitigation.

• Some travel required.

The salary range for this position is $158,200 to $197,800 annually.  This salary range is the range we believe is the anticipated range of possible base compensation at the timing of the posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the anticipated salary range for the position. Employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses. We offer a full benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage and flexible spending account options and voluntary insurances. We have paid time off, flex-time schedules, remote work options and a 401k plan and employee perk programs. For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at https://www.cannondesign.com/careers/benefits. Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, education and/or skill level.

ABOUT OUR FIRM

CannonDesign is a design practice where strategy, experience, architecture, engineering, and social impact converge. We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.

ABOUT WORKING HERE

• We are relentless in our pursuit of client adoration (not simply satisfaction). Consistent delivery of the best service is what we are about.

• We are committed to ensuring our practice is equitable for all employees, representative of the communities around us – and focused on the future of design. We advocate for equity, diversity, and inclusion efforts through the leadership of our DEI Council, Employee Resource Groups and other community advocacy initiatives.

• We’re about communication and transparency here. If you want to talk to someone about an idea you have, or a challenge that needs addressing, we’re ready for you.

Please note that candidates can only apply to our positions on our company Careers site. It's not uncommon for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites; never enter your information or apply for CannonDesign positions on any platform. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume and portfolio when applying.

As a condition of employment, all employees are expected to complete mandatory training, including compliance training, within required timeframes and adhere to our internal policies and our Code of Conduct.

CannonDesign is an Equal Opportunity Employer. CannonDesign is committed to maintaining a work environment that is free from any and all forms of unlawful discrimination and harassment. It is therefore the firm’s policy to prohibit discrimination and harassment against any applicant, CannonDesign employee, vendor, contractor, or client on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. It is also CannonDesign’s policy to prohibit any and all forms of retaliation against any individual who has complained of harassing or discriminatory conduct, or participated in a firm or agency investigation into such complaints.

jobs.title: Campaign Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Osano

Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape.

The Role

Osano is looking for a Campaign Coordinator to help execute the integrated marketing campaigns that drive pipeline and brand awareness. This is a hands-on campaign execution and project management role for someone who knows how to take an established campaign strategy and turn it into action across multiple channels. You'll work closely with demand generation, content, product marketing, sales, and other partners to coordinate campaign deliverables, manage timelines, deploy programs, and make sure everything launches on time, on brand, and as intended.

The ideal candidate brings experience executing integrated, cross-channel or omnichannel campaigns in a B2B environment and is comfortable managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, and deadlines at once. You won't be expected to set the overarching campaign strategy — you'll be instrumental in making sure that strategy gets out the door successfully.

What You'll Do

• Coordinate and execute integrated marketing campaigns across channels such as email, paid, organic, content, webinars, and ABM based on established campaign strategies and briefs.

• Translate campaign plans into clear project timelines, tasks, dependencies, and deliverables, keeping stakeholders aligned from kickoff through launch.

• Manage the day-to-day execution of multiple campaigns simultaneously, proactively identifying blockers and keeping projects moving.

• Build, deploy, and monitor campaign components within marketing automation and CRM platforms.

• Coordinate with demand generation, content, product marketing, design, sales, and other partners to ensure campaign assets and deliverables are completed on time.

• Manage audience segmentation, campaign setup, scheduling, tracking, and other deployment requirements based on established campaign parameters.

• QA campaigns before launch, including links, forms, lists, tracking, formatting, creative, and overall customer experience.

• Maintain the shared campaign calendar and ensure cross-channel activities are coordinated appropriately.

• Monitor live campaigns, troubleshoot execution issues, and flag performance or delivery concerns to the appropriate partners.

• Pull and organize campaign performance data to support reporting and optimization efforts.

• Help maintain and improve campaign processes, templates, documentation, and workflows to make execution more efficient and scalable.

• Support occasional event or webinar coordination as needed, including logistics, promotion, lead capture, and follow-up.

What We're Looking For

• 3–5 years of marketing experience, with meaningful hands-on experience in campaign management and execution.

• Experience executing integrated, cross-channel, or omnichannel marketing campaigns from kickoff through deployment.

• B2B marketing experience required; experience within a B2B software or SaaS organization is especially valuable.

• Strong project management skills with experience coordinating multiple campaigns, stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines simultaneously.

• Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce, or similar.

• An understanding of how different marketing channels work together as part of a larger integrated campaign.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly when building, deploying, and QAing campaigns.

• Ability to take an established strategy or campaign brief and independently drive the execution forward.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and confidence working cross-functionally.

• Comfort working with campaign data and performance metrics.

• A proactive, organized approach with a willingness to get into the details and make things happen.

Nice to Have

• Experience working within a B2B SaaS or software company.

• Hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce.

• Experience supporting event coordination, including webinars, conferences, trade shows, or field events.

• Familiarity with ABM campaigns or account-based marketing programs.

• Experience working with marketing project management or campaign planning tools.

• Basic design sense and experience reviewing campaign creative for accuracy and brand consistency.

• Familiarity with the data privacy, compliance, or cybersecurity space.

Why Us

• A well-defined career path that’s not just “climbing the ladder” - learn different competencies, skills, and concepts as you progress and get recognized for it.

• Supportive leadership and peers - from sales engineering and product marketing to sales development and demand generation - you’re never in this alone.

You'll own campaigns from idea through execution and measurement, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Content, Product Marketing, and Revenue Operations to reach the right audiences with the right message at the right time.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable digging into performance data, experimenting with new approaches, and continuously improving how we generate and convert demand. You'll have meaningful ownership over your programs without direct people-management responsibilities.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Senior Vice President (SVP)

Austin, Texas  ·  Remote-Eligible (75% On-Site)  ·  Founding Executive Role

About Our New Venture

This organization is a new, U.S.-incorporated manufacturing platform built to serve frontier-technology industries — humanoid robotics, aerospace, agricultural technology, and healthcare — where reshoring, national security priorities, and speed-to-production are reshaping how and where hardware gets built. Backed by MISUMI Group, a global leader in manufacturing solutions and precision components, this venture combines precision machining, final assembly/test/packaging (FATP), supply chain orchestration, and engineering services into a single U.S.-based platform.

Our founding customers include leading humanoid robotics companies, and is being built from day one to grow with a broader roster of frontier-technology manufacturers as capacity comes online.

The Opportunity

Our organization is standing up its first physical footprint in Austin, Texas: an initial facility in 2026, followed by a purpose-built campus opening in 2027. Over the following three years, the operation is expected to scale from a single-customer pilot into a multi-customer production platform, with the workforce growing from a founding team into a 200-plus-person operation as volume ramps toward several thousand units a year at full scale.

We are hiring the founding SVP to lead this build from the ground up — the first executive on the ground in Austin, responsible for turning an approved capital program into a running, profitable manufacturing operation.

Career path: This role is expected to be promoted to President & CEO of the new organization in 2027, as the operation transitions from initial, single-customer production into multi-customer scale-up — contingent on hitting the facility, customer, and team-building milestones below.

What You'll Own

• Facility stand-up & scale-up: Lead commissioning of the initial Austin facility and the transition into the larger campus that follows, hitting the milestones tied to the capital plan.

• Customer delivery: Own the relationship with our founding customer and its production ramp, then lead qualification and onboarding of additional frontier-technology customers as capacity comes online.

• Operations & quality: Build out precision machining, FATP, and quality systems (FAIR, SPC, DFM) to the standard demanded by frontier-technology customers.

• Workforce build: Execute a multi-year staffing ramp from a founding team to a 200+-person workforce, combining direct hiring, a local apprenticeship/technical-college pipeline, and flexible nearshore capacity for peak demand.

• Governance & compliance: Partner with legal and security leadership to stand up the governance, security, and workplace controls required for U.S. government-adjacent manufacturing work, including export-control registration and cybersecurity certification requirements.

• P&L and reporting: Own the new organization's operating P&L and report regularly to the company Board of Directors and MISUMI's Americas Business Hub leadership on cost, schedule, and quality performance.

• Team & culture: Build the leadership bench underneath you, recruiting manufacturing and engineering leadership from Austin's robotics and advanced-manufacturing corridor.

What You Bring

• 15+ years in manufacturing operations leadership, with direct P&L ownership of a plant, business unit, or manufacturing company.

• A track record of standing up new manufacturing facilities from the ground up — greenfield or brownfield — including commissioning, hiring ramp, and production qualification.

• Deep fluency in precision manufacturing: CNC machining, final assembly/test/packaging (FATP), new product introduction (NPI), and design-for-manufacturability (DFM).

• Experience serving demanding, fast-iterating hardware customers — robotics, aerospace, defense, or similarly exacting sectors — strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with U.S. export-control and government-contracting frameworks (ITAR, CMMC) is a strong plus; willingness to build and operate within those frameworks is required.

• Comfortable operating with board-level visibility and reporting, including to an international (Japan-based) parent company.

• A builder's mindset — energized by a founding role with real ambiguity, not just running an already-established operation.

Additional Requirement

Because the organization's work is expected to support U.S. government- and defense-adjacent manufacturing programs under ITAR and related export-control frameworks, candidates must be U.S. citizens.

Location & Reporting

• Location: Remote-eligible. The SVP is not required to permanently relocate to Austin, provided they can maintain an on-site presence at the new facility for approximately 75% of working time — reflecting the hands-on demands of facility commissioning, workforce build-out, and production leadership.

• Travel: Up to 50% travel overall, covering on-site time in Austin plus trips to MISUMI's Americas Business Hub, customer sites, and Board meetings.

• Reports to: The organization's Board of Directors, with a close working relationship with MISUMI's Americas Business Hub leadership.

• Dotted-line reporting: The organization's Go-to-Market / Business Development leadership, to keep customer pipeline, commercial strategy, and new-customer qualification tightly aligned with facility capacity and delivery.

Salary Range:
$260,000 - $320,000 base salary per year, plus a variable compensation potential of between $260,000 - $320,000

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

• Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.

• Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.

• Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.

• Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.

• Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: Director, Production Partner Management
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

About our New Venture

This organization is a new, U.S.-incorporated manufacturing platform built to serve frontier-technology industries — humanoid robotics, aerospace, agricultural technology, and healthcare — where reshoring, national security priorities, and speed-to-production are reshaping how and where hardware gets built. Backed by MISUMI Group, a global leader in manufacturing solutions and precision components, this venture combines precision machining, final assembly/test/packaging (FATP), supply chain orchestration, and engineering services into a single U.S.-based platform.

Our founding customers include leading humanoid robotics companies, and is being built from day one to grow with a broader roster of frontier-technology manufacturers as capacity comes online.

Position Summary

The Director, Production Partner Management leads the strategy, development, and management of the company's external partner network. This role is responsible for identifying, qualifying, and onboarding new partners to our new organization; negotiating and structuring joint venture (JV) and other strategic capacity partnerships, including co-investment arrangements with equipment providers, staffing partners, and customers; building education and government partnerships that support talent pipelines and manufacturing incentive programs; and ensuring partners meet the quality, capacity, and cost commitments required to support the business. The ideal candidate combines hands-on manufacturing operations expertise with strong commercial and negotiation skills and is comfortable operating at both the strategic (partnership structuring, JV governance) and tactical (plant floor, supplier performance) levels.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Network Development

• Build and execute a strategy for expanding the company's partner network across target processes, geographies, and capacity tiers.

• Source, evaluate, and qualify new partners through capability audits, quality system reviews, and on-site assessments.

• Lead onboarding of new partners, including capability mapping, pricing frameworks, quality agreements, and production ramp plans.

Joint Venture & Strategic Partnership Structuring

• Identify and evaluate joint venture, co-investment, and dedicated-capacity opportunities that expand manufacturing capabilities or secure strategic capacity.

• Lead due diligence, business case development, and deal structuring for JV and strategic partnerships to our organization, in partnership with Finance, Legal, and executive leadership.

• Negotiate partnership agreements, including terms, governance structures, IP and exclusivity provisions, and commercial terms; represent the company on JV governance or steering committees.

• Manage the ongoing partner and JV relationship post-signing, including performance reviews, capital planning, and expansion decisions.

Equipment, Staffing & Customer Co-Investment Partnerships

• Build and negotiate partnerships with capital equipment manufacturers and suppliers to secure financing, leasing, or co-investment arrangements that expand partner facility capacity.

• Develop strategic relationships with staffing and workforce partners to scale labor at partner facilities in line with production ramp and capacity plans.

• Structure and negotiate joint investment agreements with key customers to co-fund dedicated capacity, equipment purchases, or facility expansions in exchange for committed volume or preferred terms.

• Evaluate the financial and operational terms of equipment, staffing, and customer co-investment deals, partnering with Finance and Legal on deal structure and risk allocation.

Education & Government Partnerships

• Develop and negotiate partnership agreements with technical colleges, universities, and vocational/trade programs to build manufacturing talent pipelines, apprenticeships, and co-op programs.

• Build relationships with federal, state, and local government agencies to identify and secure manufacturing incentive programs, grants, tax credits, and reshoring/onshoring initiatives.

• Represent the company with workforce development boards, economic development organizations, and industry associations to advance manufacturing partnership and talent strategy.

• Track policy and funding developments relevant to domestic manufacturing capacity and advise leadership on opportunities to pursue.

Partner Performance & Operations Management

• Establish and track partner scorecards covering quality, on-time delivery, cost, capacity utilization, and responsiveness.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives with partners, including lean manufacturing, yield improvement, and cost-down programs.

• Manage capacity planning and allocation across the partner network to meet forecasted demand.

• Resolve escalated quality, delivery, or commercial issues with partners; lead root-cause and corrective action processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner closely with Business Development, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams to align partner strategy with product roadmaps and business goals.

• Provide regular reporting to executive leadership on partner network health, JV performance, education/government partnership progress, and capacity risk.

• Build, mentor, and lead a team of partner managers / supplier development engineers.

• Own risk management for the partner portfolio, including geographic concentration, financial health of partners, and supply continuity planning.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced technical degree a plus.

• 8–12+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, supplier/partner development, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, with meaningful exposure to contract manufacturing or outsourced production.

• Demonstrated experience structuring, negotiating, or managing joint ventures, strategic alliances, or major capacity partnerships in a manufacturing context.

• Deep understanding of manufacturing processes (e.g., CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, casting, additive manufacturing, or similar) and quality systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949, AS9100, or equivalent).

• Strong commercial acumen — experience with contract negotiation, pricing models, and partnership economics.

• Track record of leading cross-functional teams and managing complex, multi-stakeholder relationships.

• Willingness and ability to travel 30–50%, including internationally, to partner and prospective partner facilities.

Preferred

• Prior experience in a director-level or equivalent role leading a partner management, strategic sourcing, or manufacturing operations function.

• Experience in digital manufacturing, industrial equipment, automotive, aerospace, medical device, or a comparably regulated manufacturing sector.

• Familiarity with capital planning and investment evaluation for joint venture or co-investment structures.

• Experience working with globally distributed manufacturing networks, including partners in Asia, the Americas, and/or Europe.

• Experience negotiating agreements with educational institutions (e.g., technical colleges, universities) and/or government agencies (e.g., economic development, workforce boards) in support of manufacturing or workforce initiatives.

• Experience negotiating co-investment or joint funding arrangements with equipment suppliers, staffing partners, or customers.

Success Metrics

• Growth and diversification of qualified partner capacity against strategic priorities.

• Successful execution of joint venture / strategic partnership deals from evaluation through signed agreement and operational ramp.

• Partner network performance against quality, delivery, and cost scorecards.

• Reduction of single-source and geographic concentration risk across the partner portfolio.

• Number and value of education and government partnerships established, including talent pipeline agreements and secured incentive/grant funding.

• Value of co-investment secured through equipment, staffing, and customer partnership agreements.

Salary Range:
$130,000 base salary per year, plus a variable compensation potential of $130,000

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

• Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.

• Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.

• Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.

• Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.

• Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Instacart is a Flex First team
