jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
Aescape is a New York-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes-driven practice.

Powered by real-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day. 

Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance. 

Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures.



Aescape is seeking an experienced Controller to lead our day-to-day accounting function and partner closely with our Operations/Supply Chain, and Revenue Operations teams. This role will initially report to the SVP of Operations and is expected to transition reporting to the CFO once that position is filled.



This individual will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, leading the monthly close and financial reporting processes, strengthening internal controls, and building scalable accounting processes to support the company’s growth. The role will also partner closely with Operations/Supply Chain on inventory accounting, COGS, landed costs, manufacturing costs, and variances, and other financial aspects of our hardware business. The role will also collaborate closely with Revenue Operations on accounts receivable, customer billing, collections, revenue recognition, and related order-to-cash processes.



The Controller will work closely with and leverage support from the company's third-party accounting firm for accounting operations, technical accounting, financial reporting, tax, audit support, and other areas as appropriate.



This is a hands-on role well suited to someone who is highly responsive, operates with a sense of urgency, and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment. The ideal candidate can work independently, build and continuously improve processes, and balance strong accounting fundamentals with practical realities of a growing physical product, while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. The title of Controller will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.



This role is hybrid, based out of our NYC office in Chelsea.




WHAT YOU’LL DO 

 - Own and maintain the end-to-end accounting function, including general ledger, month-end and year-end close, financial reporting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll accounting, inventory, fixed assets, and other balance sheet accounts

 - Prepare and analyze monthly financial statements, including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement

 - Partner closely with the SVP of Operations and the broader Operations/Supply Chain team on inventory accounting, cost of goods sold (COGS), landed cost calculations, standard costing, and manufacturing variance analysis specific to hardware products

 - Partner closely with Revenue Operations on accounts receivable, customer billing, collections, credit and payment terms, and other order-to-cash processes

 - Own accounts payable, including vendor management and relationship oversight

 - Support accounts receivable efforts, including AR aging reports and collection metrics

 - Apply and maintain appropriate revenue recognition policies in accordance with ASC 606 revenue recognition principles, including reviewing customer arrangements

 - Research, document, and implement appropriate accounting treatment for complex or non-routine transactions, including revenue recognition, inventory, leases, fixed assets, and other technical accounting matters as applicable

 - Establish, maintain, and continuously improve internal controls, accounting policies, close processes, and procedures in accordance with GAAP

 - Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to streamline accounting processes, improve accuracy and efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance financial reporting and analysis

 - Manage fixed asset accounting, including capitalization policy, depreciation schedules, and hardware/equipment tracking

 - Support cash flow forecasting, budgeting, and budget-to-actual variance analysis

 - Support the annual audit and tax preparation process, coordinating directly with external auditors and tax advisors

 - Ensure compliance with sales tax, use tax, and other applicable filings relevant to hardware sales and multi-state operations, with the support from the third-party tax service providers

 - Supervise, mentor, and develop accounting staff as the team grows

 - Partner with the SVP of Operations and executive leadership on ad hoc financial analysis and special projects, and ultimately serve as a key partner to the CFO once hired




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA strongly preferred

 - 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a hardware, manufacturing, or consumer electronics environment

 - Strong knowledge of GAAP and internal control frameworks

 - Proficiency with NetSuite and advanced Excel skills

 - Demonstrated experience owning month-end close and preparing financial statements

 - Strong experience with inventory accounting, standard costing, and COGS in a physical-product business

 - Working knowledge of AI-enabled tools and automation, with demonstrated interest or experience applying AI to accounting workflows, financial reporting, reconciliations, data analysis, and process improvement

 - Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Operations, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and the executive leadership

 - Highly responsive and proactive, with a strong sense of urgency and the ability to prioritize effectively, adapt quickly, and manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

 - Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy while balancing multiple responsibilities

 - Prior experience at a startup or growth-stage company is a plus

 - Ability to work a hybrid schedule: 3 days per week in our New York City office, with flexibility for remote work on remaining days




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU 

 - Join a trailblazing robotics and AI company building the future of recovery

 - The chance to make a difference with a product that empowers healthier and happier living

 - Team culture driven by passion, ambition, empowerment, inclusion, curiosity, and fun!

 - 100% employer-paid healthcare coverage for employees with generous coverage for eligible dependents

 - Flexible time off

 - Quarterly Wellness Days - everyone fully unplugs

 - Generous parental leave

 - Complimentary OneMedical membership

 - 401(k) with employer matching

 - Home office budget

 - Annual stipend for professional development

 - Working late? Dinner is on us

 - Complimentary Aescape recovery sessions for yourself, friends & family

Compensation: Base salary range of $175,000 - $225,000 annually, plus 10% discretionary annual bonus, plus equity grant commensurate with the role and company stage. Full-time employees are also eligible for our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, and paid parental leave.

 


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Aescape is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The salary range listed above is a good-faith estimate provided in accordance with New York City's pay transparency law.




BEGIN YOUR AESCAPE CAREER JOURNEY

At Aescape, we're on a mission to redefine self-care for a better world, and we're seeking trailblazers to join us on this journey. We're inspired by individuals who are passionate, driven, and eager to learn. We value diverse perspectives and resourceful, determined individuals who are committed to making a difference. At Aescape, we empower people to reach their full potential, just as our product empowers better living. If you're ready to innovate, create, and make a meaningful impact, we want you on our team.

YOUR JOURNEY. YOUR AESCAPE.

jobs.title: Conveyance Coordinator
jobs.description:
• Assist with verifying that inbound materials and products are inspected, counted accurately, systematically received, and supported by the required documentation.
• Support the Conveyance Supervisor with daily staffing assignments, work priorities, shift coverage, and follow-up on completed work.
• Provide floor-level direction and guidance to forklift, yard goat, and other conveyance employees in accordance with established procedures.
• Assist with training employees in safe work practices, standard operating procedures, documentation requirements, and proper equipment operation.
• Monitor work areas and employee practices for compliance with GMP, food safety, housekeeping, and departmental standards.
• Immediately address or escalate unsafe conditions, equipment concerns, quality issues, and employee performance concerns to the Conveyance Supervisor.
• Help maintain accurate records for inbound and outbound shipments, including lot information, Bills of Lading, invoices, receiving records, and related documentation.
• Assist with organizing received goods inventory and verifying that materials are stored in the correct locations.
• Coordinate with inventory, purchasing, shipping, and production personnel to support material availability, storage needs, and inventory rotation.
• Monitor incoming receiving activities for accuracy, completeness, and condition of received goods, and report discrepancies promptly.
• Inspect material-handling equipment for visible defects, complete required pre-use inspections, and notify the supervisor or maintenance of needed repairs.
• Direct the safe movement of shipments and materials from receiving areas to storage or production of work areas.
• Support internal departmental audits and corrective actions related to GMP, food safety, and regulatory compliance.
• Assist with tracking department performance measures, identifying operational delays, and recommending process improvements.
• Help maintain a productive work environment by answering employee questions, providing constructive feedback, and reinforcing performance expectations.
• Assist with monitoring driver compliance with safety rules and report repeated or serious noncompliance to the Conveyance Supervisor.
• Support the coordination of POM-owned and rental mobile equipment, including availability, service needs, and maintenance follow-up.
• Act as the department lead in the Conveyance Supervisor’s absence when assigned by management.
• Provide coverage and operational support to other supply chain departments as directed.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

SEASONAL POMEGRANATE HARVEST – YARD COORDINATION RESPONSIBILITIES

During the pomegranate season, the Conveyance Coordinator will provide additional support for the coordination and control of fresh-fruit trailer traffic and yard operations. These responsibilities include:

Trailer Coordination & Yard Management

• Manage and monitor the arrival, movement, placement, staging, and departure of inbound and outbound trailers carrying fresh pomegranates and other fresh fruit.
• Assign and direct yard goat operators, drivers, and other authorized personnel in the safe movement of trailers within the yard.
• Ensure trailers are positioned in the correct yard locations, receiving areas, docks, staging areas, or designated holding areas according to the daily plan and operational schedule.
• Maintain an accurate, real-time trailer inventory and yard map, identifying trailer location, status, load information, and movement requirements.
• Prioritize trailer movement based on receiving schedules, unloading requirements, production needs, product condition, dock availability, and overall plant priorities.
• Coordinate with receiving, production, inventory, quality, shipping, and other departments to ensure trailers are available when needed and moved efficiently.
• Monitor trailer dwell times and identify delays, congestion, or operational issues that could affect receiving, production, or shipping activities.
• Verify trailer identification, load information, and required documentation before directing trailers to designated locations.
• Assist with maintaining orderly traffic flow and safe separation of pedestrians, forklifts, yard goats, trucks, and trailers.
• Communicate trailer status and yard changes to the appropriate departments and supervisors throughout the shift.

• Ability to read, write, and understand work instructions in English
• Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred
• Working knowledge of shipping, receiving, warehousing, inventory, or material-handling operations
• Ability to provide work direction and support employees in a respectful and consistent manner
• Knowledge of forklift, yard goat, and material-handling safety practices
• Basic knowledge of GMP, food safety, and workplace safety requirements
• Ability to maintain accurate records and complete required documentation
• Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office
• Working knowledge of Oracle or the ability to learn applicable systems
• Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
• Customer-service oriented and able to work effectively with internal departments and external partners
• Self-motivated and able to prioritize work in a fast-paced, changing environment
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Ability to work all shifts, overtime, weekends, and holidays as required by management

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

High school diploma or GED, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position. One to three years of experience in shipping, receiving, warehousing, inventory, logistics, or material handling is preferred. Previous lead or assistant supervisory experience is preferred.

POM's Dedication to You:

• Thriving Wellness Community: Access to top-notch medical coverage comprehensive vision and dental plans, and a 401k with match eligibility to secure your financial future and including: 24/7 online physician consultations virtual mental health resources life coaching engaging employee community groups cash rewards for healthy habits and fitness reimbursements library of on-demand fitness videos
• Career Advancement Opportunities: Unlock your potential with clear paths for career progression and internal mobility across our diverse family of brands and business units.
• Focused Learning and Development: Grow as a leader with our dedicated Learning and Organizational Development department, offering extensive resources like People Manager and leadership training, webinars, and eLearning courses.
• Empowering Mentorship Program: Connect with colleagues through our company-wide mentorship program to share goals, overcome challenges, and drive your career forward.
• Continuous Improvement Training: Participate in training that empowers all employees to learn and implement concepts that drive significant, positive change in the workplace.
• Building a Healthy Society: To date, our co-Founders Lynda and Stewart Resnick, through their foundations and The Wonderful Company, have invested more than $2.5 billion in education, health and wellness, community development, and sustainability initiatives across California’s Central Valley, Fiji, and the world. In 2025, Wonderful ranked as #1 in PEOPLE’s “100 Companies That Care” list and was named one of Fortune magazine’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. To learn more about our corporate social responsibility efforts, visit csr.wonderful.com.
• Giving Back to the Community: Make a difference with Wonderful Giving, allowing you to allocate company-provided funds to up to three charities of your choice, and join Wonderful Neighbor to contribute to group service projects within our local communities.

POM Wonderful is the largest grower and producer of fresh pomegranates and pomegranate juice in the United States as well as the worldwide leader in fresh California pomegranates and pomegranate-based products, including our 100% pomegranate juices, healthy juice blends and teas. With nearly two million pomegranate trees in Central California, we grow, handpick and juice our own pomegranates to ensure the highest quality. Sold throughout the world and in the vast majority of North American retailers, our selection of products includes pomegranate-based juices and teas, fresh fruit when in season, and fresh arils.

POM Wonderful is part of The Wonderful Company, a successful, fast-growing privately held $6 billion company with 10,000 employees worldwide. The Wonderful Company’s connection to consumers has health at its heart and giving back in its DNA. To learn more about The Wonderful Company, its products and its core values, visit www.wonderful.com, or follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram.

The Wonderful Company is an Equality Opportunity Employer that provides opportunities for advancement. jobs.title: AIT Engineer
jobs.description:
About Loft Federal

Loft Federal is committed to delivering the U.S. national security space community a fast, affordable, and streamlined pathway to orbit. As a wholly owned U.S. subsidiary of Loft Orbital Solutions, Inc., we specialize in providing mission-ready space infrastructure with unmatched efficiency.

At Loft, we empower our team with autonomy, ownership, and bold problem-solving opportunities while fostering a tight-knit, supportive environment. We believe that diversity, inclusivity, and community are the foundation of an open and innovative culture. We value kind, collaborative, and mission-driven teammates who excel in problem-solving and communication—because great solutions come from great teams.

Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

Senior Assembly, Integration & Test Engineer

Ready to join the adventure?

Loft Federal provides space infrastructure and operation as a service for whatever size mission a client needs - whether that's a constellation, a single satellite, or even flying multiple customer payloads on the same satellite.

As an AIT Engineer, you'll be responsible for ensuring the satellite is built and tested before launch.  This is a truly multidisciplinary role where you'll work with almost every department in Loft and no two days will ever feel the same.  You may be working with the Mechanical team to determine payload arrangement, Electrical team to design harnesses, Systems team on requirements and verification, PMs on scheduling, Software team on debugging, and the Product team for testing Loft hardware. You'll also work within the AIT team on the design and conduction of functional, performance, and environmental testing of the payloads and completed satellite.  Through all of this, you'll need to be good at communication and documentation as well as have a passion for troubleshooting/debugging.   This is a unique role and we're looking for a unique person to fill it!

The Role:

In this role, you’ll play a hands-on part in taking satellites from the test bench to the launch pad. You’ll work alongside the Loft team to build, integrate, test, and verify internally developed products, helping ensure each flight product is ready for successful delivery and mission operations. Your work will include electrical and mechanical integration of payloads onto satellites, as well as environmental testing at both the box and system levels—including vibration, thermal vacuum (TVAC), and electromagnetic interference (EMI) testing. You’ll also have the opportunity to author and execute detailed test procedures, troubleshoot issues as they arise, and work collaboratively across the team to make sure our hardware performs as intended before it flies.

Must Haves

• US Citizenship required

• Active DoD Secret clearance with ability to obtain Top Secret clearance. Active Top Secret clearance with experience in (last 2 years) or active Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) strongly desired.

• 5+ years (3+ with graduate degree) in a testing role or related, preferably in aerospace

• Experience with writing, performing, and documenting tests

• Experience with environmental testing (Vibration, TVAC, EMI, Radiation)

• Experience organizing test campaigns from initial idea to completion

• Familiar with aerospace testing standards such as GEVS, etc.

• Experience using software to test (python preferred)

• Experience designing or building harnesses for flight or test

• Experience setting up GSE for testing

Nice-to-Haves

• Current in-scope DoD SECRET background investigation with at least 3 years of eligibility remaining, or Continuous Evaluation (CE) status, with willingness and ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance

• DoD or Intelligence Community Top Secret background investigation with at least 3 years of eligibility remaining or CE status; and SCI eligibility with current experience in SCI programs, other control systems, and/or Special Access Programs

• AIT or Test lead on previous projects

• Experience juggling multiple test campaign priorities simultaneously

• Significant software experience creating and debugging tests in python

• Board and box level electrical testing and debugging

• HW integration experience, preferably satellite or aerospace

• Experience writing procedures for a variety of levels eg: internal development vs. production acceptance testing

• Experience using Jira/Confluence for organization and communication

• Experience using GIT and Docker

Some of our awesome benefits

• 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents

• Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA

• 100% employer paid Life, AD&D, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability insurance

• Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays

• 401(k) plan and equity options

• Daily catered lunches and snacks in office

• Fully paid parental leave; 14 weeks for birthing parent and 10 weeks for non-birthing parent

• Carrot Fertility provides comprehensive, inclusive fertility healthcare and family-forming benefits with financial support

• Off-sites and many social events and celebrations

• Relocation assistance when applicable

Per Colorado law, we are required to disclose the base compensation range for this role. This range is intentionally wide as we assess individuals based on their unique abilities and experience to find the best fit for our needs. Ultimately, your compensation will be determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.

In addition to a competitive salary and benefits package, you will find a truly remarkable culture guided by transparency and collaboration and work that is challenging and meaningful. We can't wait to meet you and see what you may add to our team!

Salary Range

$110,000—$138,000 USD

Equal Employment Opportunity & Affirmative Action

Loft Federal is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, veteran status, genetic information, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status.

Accessibility & Accommodations

If you require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability when applying for an open position, please contact us at recruiting@loftfederal.com for assistance.

We Hire for Talent, Not Just Resumes

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet about 60% of the qualifications, women and other underrepresented groups tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. At Loft Federal, we value diverse perspectives, respectful debate, and people who challenge assumptions. If you’re excited about a role but don’t meet every requirement, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Third-Party Recruiters & Agencies

No outside recruiters, please. Loft Federal does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, staffing agencies, or third-party recruiters. We will not pay fees for candidates submitted without a signed agreement in place.

jobs.title: Personnel Security Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Industrial Security team is a highly specialized security team responsible for managing Anduril’s cleared personnel, classified programs, and secure facilities. We operate at the intersection of cutting-edge defense technology and stringent security requirements, ensuring the integrity and protection of national security. Our team is composed of experts in security management, compliance, risk assessment, and physical security, dedicated to upholding the highest standards of security in support of national and international defense initiatives while providing the best customer service, both within Anduril and externally.

ABOUT THE JOB

Serve as a member of Anduril Industries Security Services Team supporting employees throughout the United States. Work within a collaborative team environment and take independent action, analyze problems, and provide focused solutions to effectively communicate information to various audiences orally and through written communications. Leverage expertise with US government security policies and procedures as it relates to the personnel security program. Maintain responsibility for updates to various databases, security clearance processing, and review documentation for accuracy and completeness. Address personnel security matters and other clearance-related actions for personnel requiring clearances for collateral and SCI positions. Interact daily with internal and external clients and government security officials to resolve issues.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Support our Personnel Security Team in accordance with government policies, which has duties as outlined below:

• Manage and initiate personnel clearances background investigations and process visit access requests (VARs) and mandatory SEAD 3 reporting via Defense Information System for Security (DISS).

• Provide employees with personnel security guidance consistent with the 13 adjudicative guidelines to assist them in managing their clearances.

• Handle in-person and virtual requests and inquiries, as it pertains to Security Services Help Requests, Security Information Management System (SIMS), Security Forms, Incoming/Outgoing Visit Request, New Hire Orientation Briefings, Cleared Employee Training, Foreign National Contacts and Foreign Travel Briefings.

• Process visitor requests; enter clearance information into the visitor database and/or research information in DISS and SIMS clearance database.

• Coordinate classified meetings requiring VARs; liaison between Security Services and Anduril meeting hosts to facilitate meetings.

• Manage clearances for SCI billeted programs; prepare nomination packages, coordinate with customer sponsor’s COR and SSO, submit SCI VARs through customer sponsor, and assist with scheduling indoctrination and debriefing appointments.

• Additional Duties:

• Manage the internal security database with clearance, access, visit, and adverse information.

• Communicate with Anduril employees on additional information requests.

• Enforce Anduril’s security policies and procedures.

• Update databases for clearance and visitor tracking.

• Ensure Anduril information in DISS is accurate and timely.

• Assist the Security Services Team, as needed.

• Perform other work-related duties as assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma and two years of related administrative and customer service experience.

• Possesses excellent organization and tracking skills, and attention to detail and is comfortable in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience with conducting briefings and debriefings; ability to clearly explain security processes and procedures

• Experience with DoD 32 CFR Part 117, National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM).

• Experience with DoD Manual 5105.21 Volumes 1 and 3.

• Experience with DoD clearance processes such as DISS, NBIS, eAPP, SF86, and SIMS is desired.

• Proficiency in use of computers and Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).

• Ability to communicate and interact professionally and courteously both orally and in writing with all levels of employees and guests.

• Reliable attendance and punctuality is required. Anduril is an “in-person” office.

• Ability to handle multiple demands and prioritize workload based on urgency.

• Must hold a current U.S. Secret security clearance.

• Familiar with DISS and NBIS.

• Familiarity with SIMS or other security software.

US Salary Range

$86,000—$114,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
About Helion

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.

Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.

This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

What You Will Be Doing:

In this role, you’ll design and fabricate both analog and digital electronic circuits, including op-amp, passive and active filter circuits, along with PCB design and validation. You'll also drive the development of next-generation, in-house data acquisition systems and electronic instruments to support our ongoing innovation. This internship offers hands-on experience, solving real-world engineering problems that are important to deploying fusion energy to the world.   

You Will: 

 - Perform qualification and testing plans on new or modified designs 

 - Support senior electrical engineers in design updates and documentation 

 - Fix hardware issues as they arise on integrated fusion generators 

 - Learn from historical engineering approaches, design novel hardware, and test your solutions 

 - Apply both engineering first-principles and method-based thinking to challenging problems 

 - Learn from experts to expand your engineering skillset and domain knowledge 

Required Skills: 

 - Ability to work full time, onsite in Everett, WA for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks during summer 2027 

 - Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field 

 - GPA of 3.0 or above

 - Experience applying engineering principles (e.g. making design trades while communicating progress and blockers)

jobs.title: Senior Director, Collections and Exhibitions
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE LUCAS MUSEUM OF NARRATIVE ART
Opening in September 2026, the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is dedicated to illustrated storytelling.  Founded by George Lucas and Mellody Hobson, the museum’s collection features works by artists including Norman Rockwell, Kadir Nelson, Jessie Willcox Smith, N. C. Wyeth, Beatrix Potter, Judith F. Baca, Frida Kahlo, and Maxfield Parrish; as well as comic art legends such as Winsor McCay, Jack Kirby, Frank Frazetta, Alison Bechdel, Chris Ware, and R. Crumb; and photographers Gordon Parks, Henri Cartier-Bresson, and Dorothea Lange. The Museum also houses the Lucas Archives, containing models, props, concept art, and costumes from Lucas’s filmmaking career. 
 
Designed by Ma Yansong of MAD with a landscape by Mia Lehrer of Studio-MLA, the Museum is in Exposition Park, Los Angeles, on an 11-acre campus that includes new green space and a 300,000-square-foot building with galleries, two theaters, a library, restaurant, café, retail store, and community spaces.  
 


POSITION SUMMARY
The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art seeks a Senior Director of Collections and Exhibitions to join its senior administration team. This role oversees the museum's collections program, including policies and procedures for preventive care, preservation, storage, conservation, and documentation, across three departments: Registration, Collections Management, and Art Prep & Install. The Senior Director works closely with Curatorial and manages the collection across Los Angeles and the San Francisco Bay Area.
The role also leads the Exhibitions and Planning department, overseeing schedules, budgets, and coordination for all exhibitions, rotating permanent-collection installations, and special and touring shows.
The museum is looking for a strategic thinker and empathetic leader who can manage multiple complex, concurrent projects that shape the museum's long-term direction; build and motivate large, dynamic teams; and own division, department, and project budgets. Significant experience in a highly complex environment and a track record of systems leadership and cross-team collaboration are essential. Regular travel between Northern and Southern California teams is required.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate (Full-Time)
jobs.description:
The Warehouse Associate role owns the dock-to-distribution cycle: receiving inbound raw goods and vendor partial kits, running the accuracy-critical distribution and palletizing workflow that gets finished kits out to school sites, and directly supervising seasonal temp labor during peak distribution. This role is a key accuracy checkpoint in a highly bespoke, multi-product kit operation spanning across hundreds of school sites and partners.

Galileo Learning has been offering educational summer experiences for 25 years: STEAM-based hands-on camp and expanded learning programs that build creative confidence, growth mindset, and innovation skills for kids from kindergarten through eighth grade. Behind every camp day is a warehouse operation that receives raw materials, finishes and palletizes kits, and gets them to the right site on time and complete.

This role partners closely within the Supply Chain team to keep goods moving accurately from dock to truck, and is the primary point of direction for seasonal temp labor during peak distribution.

Success in this role requires a high degree of accuracy, physical ability, and the ability to clearly direct others during our highest-volume periods.

Why this Role Matters

Every kit that reaches a school site starts here. Because our kits are complex, multi-component, and highly bespoke, a single receiving or palletizing error can mean a classroom missing the materials it needs on day one. This role is the accuracy checkpoint that stands between a shipment leaving our dock and a Camp Director opening a box that’s exactly right.

Just as importantly, this role keeps our peak season moving. By directing seasonal temp labor clearly and consistently, the Lead helps the warehouse hit its highest-volume weeks without sacrificing the precision our program model depends on.

You will be Accountable For

Receiving

• Receive and process inbound shipments of raw goods seasonally, coordinating with the Procurement Manager on expected delivery schedules
• Receive and verify vendor-supplied partial kits: confirm completeness and accuracy against BOMs before coordinating put-away or handoff for in-house finishing
• Flag any discrepancies, shortages, or damaged goods to the Procurement Manager and Director promptly
• Once inbound shipments are received and POs are processed, coordinate with the Inventory Coordinator to ensure materials are accurately shelved and logged in the inventory management system

Distribution & Palletizing

• Work from per-site packing lists to verify kit quantities and apply accurate location labels; attention to detail is essential in this step
• Direct seasonal temp labor on physical box movement and palletizing in accordance with site-specific packing requirements
• Coordinate with the Inventory Coordinator and Logistics Manager to confirm correct pallet counts are ready for scheduled pickups
• Ensure accuracy of each pallet prior to outbound shipment; serve as a key checkpoint between Inventory pulling and QC final pallet verification

Temp Labor Supervision

• Supervise and direct seasonal temp labor on physical distribution tasks during peak season
• Ensure temp labor is deployed on tasks appropriate to their training level — physical box movement under direct supervision, not independent equipment operation or accuracy-judgment tasks
• Communicate clearly and consistently to maintain accuracy and pace during high-volume palletizing periods

Inventory Support

• Physically unload materials returned from camp sites at season’s end
• Support the QC Coordinator and Production team with initial sorting and staging of returned raw goods and electronics for testing
• Put away finished and processed materials once sorted, boxed, and cleared by QC
• Shelve finished kits and update digital location in the inventory management system once QC has processed and palletized them
• Assist the Inventory Coordinator with pulling kits for palletizing when available and not occupied with primary distribution duties (note: the Inventory Coordinator remains primary puller; this is supplemental support only)

• 3+ years of experience in a warehouse, receiving, or distribution environment, with demonstrated ability to take ownership of a workflow rather than just execute tasks
• Proficiency operating warehouse equipment including forklifts, electric pickers, and pallet jacks
• Physical capability to perform physical tasks including unloading, moving boxes, and standing for extended periods
• Fluent in written and spoken English required; Bilingual, fluent in spoken Spanish strongly preferred
• Ability to read English and work from packing lists and location labels across multiple sites simultaneously
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to give clear, patient direction to seasonal temp labor and flex tone and approach across a fast-changing floor
• Experience informally leading, training, or directing temp or seasonal labor
• Familiarity with computer-based inventory management systems
• Prior experience in a hyperseasonal or education-related operations environment
• This is a full-time, non-exempt position, averaging 40 hours per week. Seasonal peak periods (spring receiving and pre-camp distribution, and post-camp returns) will require additional hours, including overtime, to meet site delivery deadlines. CompensationWe anticipate hourly compensation for this Full-Time, non-exempt position to be approximately $26.00 - $31.00 per hour. Exact compensation may vary and will be based on multiple factors, including geography and professional experience.Our pay practices are guided by a commitment to equity and informed by market benchmarking and internal audits to minimize bias and ensure fairness across all roles. BenefitsWe offer comprehensive benefits that reflect our commitment to supporting diverse needs:
• No-cost medical insurance for employees (additional plans and options to add dependents available at cost)
• Vision and Dental Insurance
• 401k benefits after 1 year of employment
• Flexible Paid Time Off – time off is not limited, and we strongly recommend that employees take time off to rest and recharge
• Unlimited free camp for your child(ren), OR two free weeks to be gifted (including AM/PM Extended Care)
• Friends and Family Discount for Galileo Camps
• Priority scholarship nominations for Galileo Camps
• Employee Assistance Program, options for life insurance, and more!
• We strongly encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we are committed to equitable and inclusive hiring practices. If you think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply! Work LocationThis role is based full-time, onsite. It is not remote or hybrid eligible.2350 Davis Avenue, Hayward, CA 94545This role requires the ability to be physically present on the warehouse floor throughout scheduled shifts, including during peak distribution and returns processing periods. Schedule & Time Commitment

Please note that our job descriptions are a summary of the typical functions of the job, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible responsibilities, tasks, and duties.

We comply with the ADA and provide reasonable accommodations that allow qualified applicants/employees to perform the essential functions of the job. To request an accommodation, contact our Human Resources team.

During the onboarding process, in accordance with applicable local and state requirements, you may be required to complete a Tuberculosis (TB) screening, background check(s), and state-mandated training(s). More details will be provided during your onboarding process.

Physical Demands

• Regularly lift and carry up to 60 lbs.; occasionally lift and move heavier items with team assistance or equipment
• Stand, walk, bend, and kneel on warehouse/concrete flooring for extended periods, including full shifts during peak season
• Seeing, hearing, and speaking, both nearby and at a distance, to safely operate equipment and direct temp labor
• Use hands and fingers to handle boxes, packing materials, and equipment controls
• Tolerate exposure to a warehouse environment, including variable temperatures and dust

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate - Scientist I, Discovery Biology - Contract
jobs.description:
Senior Research Associate - Scientist I, Discovery Biology - Contract

Help translate Nurix’s targeted protein degradation science into real therapies for patients with cancer and inflammatory disease. As a Senior Research Associate/Scientist I in Discovery Biology, you’ll run the cell-based assays and mechanism-of-action studies that move small molecule and degrader-antibody conjugate programs from hypothesis to lead candidate. It’s hands-on bench science with a direct line to the clinic.

Position Description

The Opportunity

• Plan, execute, and analyze in vitro cell-based assays to support small molecule and degrader-antibody conjugate discovery efforts in cancer oncology, including mechanistic studies and new target identification

• Perform routine and specialized cell culture (cancer cell lines and/or primary cells) to support lead progression and follow-up studies

• Independently troubleshoot experimental issues and proactively introduce new techniques and efficiencies to accelerate drug discovery

• Analyze and interpret experimental data to quantify drug potency and activity, and communicate results clearly to project teams

• Upload and maintain experimental data in electronic lab notebooks and enterprise databases with a high level of accuracy and timeliness

• Collaborate closely with scientists across disciplines, contributing to experimental design, meeting presentations, and project strategy

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of relevant industry experience, Master’s degree with 4+ years, or Ph.D. with 0–2 years of industry experience in Cell Biology, Cancer Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related field (final level based on education, experience, and demonstrated independence)

• Strong background in cancer cell biology

• Extensive hands-on experience with cell culture (cancer cell lines and/or primary cells) and good aseptic technique

• Hands-on experience and proficiency with low- to medium-throughput cell-based assay platforms such as HTRF, AlphaLISA/ELISA, CellTiter-Glo, RT-qPCR, flow cytometry, and Western blotting/JESS, and other functional assay development

• Ability to conceive, design, and execute hypothesis-testing experiments that directly contribute to project success with minimal supervision

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, data integrity, and commitment to reproducible research

• Clear written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated effectiveness working with cross-functional teams

• Ability to balance multiple studies and deliver high-quality results against project timelines

Preferred

• Experience with gene editing such as CRISPR and RNA interference

• Experience with targeted protein degradation, including PROTACs, degrader-antibody-conjugates, and molecular glue degraders

• Prior industry drug discovery experience

Location:          Onsite – Brisbane, CA

Fit with Nurix Culture and Values

• Strong team orientation; highly collaborative

• Solutions and results-oriented focus

• Hands-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view

About Nurix Therapeutics

Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix’s dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine’s next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Product Manager-Service Intelligence
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Join an iconic brand that is redefining the pickup truck and rugged SUV marketplace. As Senior Staff Technical Product Manager – Service Intelligence for a confidential digital initiative, you will lead the strategy and execution of a foundational backend intelligence platform that powers critical decision‑making across Scout’s direct‑to‑consumer retail and service ecosystem.

This role focuses on designing a backend‑driven decisioning and orchestration system that evaluates complex, interdependent operational inputs to produce reliable, scalable outcomes in real time. The platform is being built ahead of Start of Operations and will play a central role in how Scout coordinates resources, responds to events, and enables consistent execution across locations. This role operates at a cross-domain level, shaping how multiple systems, products, and operational workflows interact through centralized decision intelligence.

Initially, there is no end‑user interface or traditional UX design responsibility associated with this position; success is defined by system behavior, decision quality, and operational outcomes.

This is a deeply technical, AI‑driven and analytical role requiring strong systems thinking and comfort operating in a highly ambiguous, 0‑to‑1 environment. The successful candidate will help shape core capabilities from the ground up, owning both initial delivery and long‑term evolution of a mission‑critical intelligence platform while maintaining strict discretion around sensitive product details.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Define and Lead Strategy

• Define, evolve, and drive the product and ecosystem strategy for a confidential, intelligence‑driven core platform supporting Scout’s operations and service experience.

• Define how complex operational signals, constraints, and policies are modeled into automated decision logic.

• Lead early-stage platform definition ahead of Start of Operations, building foundational capabilities with no existing baseline.

• Accountable for system performance across Scout’s direct‑to‑consumer retail network, ensuring decisions are reliable, explainable, and scalable.

• Influence senior leadership and align platform strategy with long-term company objectives while protecting sensitive capabilities.

• Identify new problem spaces and expansion opportunities for decision intelligence across additional domains and systems.

Complex Decisioning & Problem Solving

• Frame and solve highly ambiguous, cross-functional problems through intelligent system design and decision frameworks.

• Model operational constraints, dependencies, and priorities as structured logic, rules, or machine‑assisted decision frameworks.

• Drive solutions where “missing inputs” require downstream actions to resolve constraints rather than blocking outcomes.

• Navigate ambiguity inherent to 0‑to‑1 product development, making informed tradeoffs as requirements and dependencies evolve.

• Evaluate tradeoffs involving accuracy, speed, scalability, and explainability, including intangible system behaviors.

• Ensure system behavior is consistent, explainable, auditable, and adaptable as business rules change.

Lead Product Development

• Guide product development across multiple related initiatives, teams, and domains to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.

• Lead end‑to‑end product development for a highly complex, logic‑heavy platform from concept through scale.

• Collaborate closely with Engineering, Data Analytics, AI/ML teams, IT, and Operations to:

• Translate operational needs into system logic and technical requirements.

• Define data models, decision flows, signal ingestion, and output generation.

• Balance deterministic rules with AI‑assisted approaches where appropriate.

• Ensure platform extensibility as new use cases and domains are added over time.

• Establish best practices and frameworks for decisioning platforms adopted across related systems and teams.

AI & Intelligence Enablement

• Champion the use of AI, machine reasoning, and advanced analytics to enable scalable decision‑making.

• Define where AI augments human decision processes versus fully automated execution.

• Ensure models and logic are transparent, testable, and continuously improvable.

• Collaborate with data partners to ensure high‑quality inputs, feedback loops, and monitoring.

Stakeholder Leadership

• Influence and align senior leadership, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders on strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs.

• Serve as a trusted partner to Business, Software Engineering, fellow Digital Product Customer Experience team, and Leadership teams.

• Translate complex, cross‑functional needs into a shared technical and product vision without exposing sensitive strategy externally.

• Lead alignment across teams with differing priorities, timelines, and constraints.

• Build long‑term trust in the platform through transparency, reliability, and outcomes.

Operationalize a Pre‑Launch Platform

• Build readiness for a mission‑critical platform before Start of Operations.

• Define rollout strategies, guardrails, fallback behaviors, and manual override paths.

• Ensure the platform supports consistent execution independent of location or context.

• Define scalable operating models for how decision intelligence is embedded across systems and workflows.

Drive Technical Excellence

• Drive architectural decisions across systems, data flows, and integrations, balancing long-term scalability with short-term delivery needs.

• Partner with Scrum and platform teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure architectures.

• Define best practices for real‑time decisioning systems, data latency, reliability, and observability.

• Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks in logic complexity, system dependencies, and edge cases.

• Ensure solutions meet enterprise security, privacy, and compliance standards.

• Treat the platform as a living system, ensuring post-launch stability and continuous evolution.

Own Live Decision Intelligence

• Own system behavior and decision quality once the platform is live, ensuring outcomes are accurate, explainable, and aligned with operational intent.

• Monitor real-world system decisions to identify gaps, edge cases, and unintended outcomes.

• Lead continuous tuning of logic, rules, thresholds, and AI-driven decision frameworks based on live data.

• Define criteria for acceptable system behavior, including fallback paths, overrides, and escalation mechanisms.

• Use system insights to influence product strategy and operational decision-making at a broader organizational level

Location & Travel Expectations:

• The role will be based out of a Scout Motors location in Fremont, California.

• This role requires 1-3 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Subject to change.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• 12+ years of product management experience with deep focus on technical platforms, complex systems, or decisioning engines.

• Experience working with AI/ML technologies in a product, engineering, or business context

• Proven experience leading 0‑to‑1 products in pre‑launch, startup, or transformation environments.

• Track record of building logic‑heavy or intelligence‑driven systems that coordinate multiple inputs and constraints.

Technical Expertise

• Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, data architectures, and real‑time processing.

• Hands‑on experience working with AI/ML systems, rules engines, optimization problems, or decision frameworks.

• Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs between accuracy, speed, explainability, and scalability.

• Comfort working closely with engineers and data scientists on system design.

• Experience owning backend or platform products where value is delivered through system behavior and decision quality rather than user interfaces.

Skills

• Demonstrated ability to define strategy in highly ambiguous environments.

• Strong ability to influence senior leadership and align diverse stakeholders.

• Exceptional analytical and structured problem‑solving capabilities.

• Ability to define complex logic and decision flows with precision.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to simplify complexity without oversharing sensitive information.

• Data‑driven mindset; comfortable working with metrics, experimentation, and system telemetry.

• High tolerance for ambiguity; energized by building something new where the path is not fully defined.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

• Advanced technical degree or MBA preferred.

• AI-related certification required.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $160,000.00 - $192,500.00

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

About the Role:

You’ll be a key engineer focused on building and owning the systems that move money and assets through Gusto Retirement. This is a very hands-on role: owning backend services and APIs end-to-end, shipping production code, and working through real financial edge cases. You’ll partner closely with product, compliance, and operations to turn complex financial requirements into reliable software. If you like working on core systems where correctness matters and enjoy getting things shipped, you’ll be a great fit.

The Financial Infrastructure team owns the core money and asset flow systems for Gusto Retirement. We’re a senior team that works on payments, settlements, tax and compliance integrations, and much more. The work is complex and often cross-functional, so we stay focused, collaborate closely, and keep tight ownership of what we build. We work closely with product and partner teams, but we’re responsible for execution and reliability end-to-end.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, MS/PhD, Perception, Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Perception team builds the system which learns the spatial-temporal representation and their semantic meanings of the surrounding environment of the self-driving car, i.e., the system that “perceives” the world around the car. We work jointly with downstream teams on the optimization and integration into the Waymo Driver. We conduct our own research to address real-world problems and collaborate with research teams at Alphabet.  We have access to millions of miles of driving data from a diverse set of sensors, enabling engineers like you to (1) develop methods for efficiently and continuously learning from large scale real-world data, to (2) develop models and model training at scale, to (3) analyze real-world behavior and develop systems for handling the complexities of interacting with the real-world, and (4) optimize models for our onboard and offboard hardware.

Waymo interns work with leaders in the industry on projects that deliver significant impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skillset. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

This internship will be based on-site at our headquarters in Mountain View, CA.

You will:

• Design and implement state-of-the-art multi-modality (camera/radar/lidar/audio) and multi-task perception models. Potential project areas include: 3D object detection and tracking, Open vocabulary detection applying world knowledge models, 3D occupancy detection, Semantic segmentation, Large-scale foundation models, Pre-training and self-supervised learning through forecasting.

• Train and evaluate ML models on our vast and high fidelity data from Waymo driving logs.

• Gain experience using large scale ML infrastructure and working in a team environment.

You have:

• Enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Robotics, or a similar technical field of study or enrolled in a master's program with a strong publication record.

• Experience in Python

• Experience building ML models with JAX, PyTorch or Tensorflow

We prefer:

• Strong track record of high quality ML / CV research. Publications at top-tier conferences like CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, ICML, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS, AAAI, IJCV, PAMI.

• Experience in object detection, segmentation, multiple-object tracking audio perception or occupancy detection.

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.

About Loft Federal

Loft Federal is committed to delivering the U.S. national security space community a fast, affordable, and streamlined pathway to orbit. As a wholly owned U.S. subsidiary of Loft Orbital Solutions, Inc., we specialize in providing mission-ready space infrastructure with unmatched efficiency.

At Loft, we empower our team with autonomy, ownership, and bold problem-solving opportunities while fostering a tight-knit, supportive environment. We believe that diversity, inclusivity, and community are the foundation of an open and innovative culture. We value kind, collaborative, and mission-driven teammates who excel in problem-solving and communication—because great solutions come from great teams.

Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

Senior Satellite Systems Engineer
Loft Federal provides space infrastructure and operation as a service for whatever size mission a client needs - whether that's a constellation, a single satellite, or even flying multiple customer payloads on the same satellite.

As a Senior Satellite System Engineer of Loft's mission team, you will work on multiple satellite missions simultaneously, each with a unique, multi-payload configuration. You will work cross-functionally across multiple Loft teams: satellite operation software, payload interface software, mission engineering and AIT.

About This Role:

In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering, customers, and program execution to help turn mission needs into successful spacecraft. You’ll collaborate with internal teams and customers to develop and manage technical budgets, system requirements, and verification approaches, while helping shape and evolve mission concepts of operations (CONOPS) and supporting customer Service Level Agreements. You’ll also have the opportunity to contribute to program and product management, including working directly with customers on programmatic and schedule matters. Alongside your teammates, you’ll develop interface specifications, CONOPS, and other key design documentation, then bring that work into the real world by supporting test procedures and participating in spacecraft integration and test campaigns at our manufacturer’s facility.

Must Haves:

• US Citizenship

• Active DoD Secret clearance with ability to obtain Top Secret clearance. Active Top Secret clearance with experience in (last 2 years) or active Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) strongly desired.

• Enjoy being the face of the technical requirements and working with a team to deliver quality hardware.

• Challenge norms in aerospace on implementing and executing on System Engineering functions

• Have demonstrated experience as a technical specialist on specific spacecraft subsystems as well as system-level experience (Thermal, Structural, ADCS, RF Link, etc)

• Have demonstrated experience in small satellite assembly, integration and test campaigns

• Have experience in a fast-paced development environment.

• Have prior experience delivering a spacecraft to orbit and/or space-qualified hardware to a customer

Nice to Haves:

• Current in-scope DoD SECRET background investigation with at least 3 years of eligibility remaining, or Continuous Evaluation (CE) status, with willingness and ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance

• DoD or Intelligence Community Top Secret background investigation with at least 3 years of eligibility remaining or CE status; and SCI eligibility with current experience in SCI programs, other control systems, and/or Special Access Programs

• You have 5 years of experience as a systems engineer or similar in the space industry

• Preferred: Experience on RF and/or Electrical subsystems

• Preferred: Proficient with STK

• Plus: Experience with thermal/structural analysis

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:

• 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents

• Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA

• 100% employer paid Life, AD&D, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability insurance

• Daily catered lunches and snacks

• International exposure to our team in France

• Carrot Fertility provides comprehensive, inclusive fertility healthcare and family-forming benefits with financial support

• Off-sites and many social events and celebrations

This range is intentionally wide as we assess individuals based on their unique abilities and experience to find the best fit for our needs. Ultimately, your compensation will be determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.

In addition to a competitive salary and benefits package, you will find a truly remarkable culture guided by transparency and collaboration and work that is challenging and meaningful. We can't wait to meet you and see what you may add to our team!
