jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Stuut is transforming how B2B companies turn revenue into cash. Businesses worldwide have trillions tied up in receivables, yet the work between order and payment still relies on fragmented systems and labor-intensive manual processes. Stuut’s AI agent works across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, carrying context through every step. Customers reduce DSO by 47%, collect 40% more cash and eliminate 70% of manual work without replacing their ERP.

Stuut is already trusted by finance teams at companies including Honeywell, NCR and ZoomInfo, from Fortune 10 enterprises to scaling mid-market businesses. We are backed by a16z, Khosla Ventures, Activant, 1984 Ventures, Page One and Microsoft.


THE ROLE

Partnerships are one of Stuut's biggest growth channels, and we're hiring the person who owns the marketing behind them. As our first Partner Marketing Manager, you'll build Stuut's partner marketing motion from the ground up. You'll turn a fast-growing ecosystem of private equity sponsors and operating partners, resellers like Fiserv and Genpact, Big 4 consulting and advisory firms like EY, and hyperscaler, technology, and data-cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, ServiceNow) into a repeatable, measurable source of pipeline.

This role goes well beyond managing a partner logo wall. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our partnership leads across private equity, consulting, and reseller channels, and with Sales. You'll be the marketing counterpart they rely on to equip firms with the narrative, materials, and enablement to win deals, and the link between Stuut, our partners' marketing and field teams, and our own GTM engine. You'll translate what our AI agent does into a joint story that resonates with CFOs, PE operating partners, consulting principals, and AR leaders, and package it so both sales forces can sell it.

You'll run the partner marketing GTM playbook end to end: standing up joint value-prop docs and co-branded collateral, activating partner programs (Snowflake Partner Network tiers, Snowflake Marketplace, Microsoft Pegasus), securing and spending marketing development funds, and orchestrating joint webinars, events, and announcements. You'll set direction and ship the work, writing strategy one hour and a co-sell battlecard the next.

What success looks like: within a year, every priority partner has a sharp joint story, an activated program, and a pipeline number attached to it, and reps on both sides reach for your materials by default.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own partner co-marketing across every channel. Build the joint value proposition, messaging, and campaign plan for each priority partner: private equity sponsors and operating partners, resellers (Fiserv, Genpact), Big 4 consulting and advisory firms (EY and peers), and hyperscaler, technology, and data-cloud partners (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, ServiceNow, Skyflow, ZoomInfo, Microsoft Pegasus / M12).

 - Arm the private equity and portfolio motion. Build the executive briefings, portfolio learning-session content, and portfolio-level proof points and case studies that help sponsors and operating partners drive Stuut adoption across their portfolio companies.

 - Enable consulting and advisory partners. Equip Big 4 and boutique firms across referral, co-sell, and white-label motions with finance and order-to-cash transformation narratives, co-branded materials, and field enablement so they win and influence deals.

 - Own the hyperscaler marketplace motion. Stand up, optimize, and rank Stuut's listings across the hyperscaler and technology marketplaces (AWS Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, Snowflake Marketplace, ServiceNow Store), since the marketplace motion is a large part of this role. Drive co-sell registration, private offers, and marketplace-sourced pipeline through each.

 - Build the co-branded asset kit. Joint value-prop one-pagers, architecture diagrams, solution briefs, co-branded decks and sales sheets, blog and announcement content, partner web pages, and marketplace listings across the hyperscaler and technology marketplaces (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Snowflake, ServiceNow), including a "Powered by Snowflake" badge within brand guidelines.

 - Run joint campaigns and events. Plan and execute joint demand-gen campaigns, co-hosted webinars, and partner events; secure and manage partner marketing and development funds (MDF/PDF) and report on their return.

 - Activate and level up partner programs. Complete Partner Activate / SPN readiness deliverables, certify and enable partner sellers on the Stuut story, and drive tier advancement through the program tiers (Select, Premier, Elite) to unlock co-marketing budget, co-sell incentives, and partner field access.

 - Enable both sales teams to co-sell. Joint battlecards, co-sell talk tracks, joint training sessions, and account-mapping motions (such as Crossbeam) that surface and progress joint pipeline.

 - Keep co-marketing aligned to the partnership roadmap. Partner closely with our Private Equity, Consulting, and Reseller partnership leads and Sales (PE sponsors and operating partners, Fiserv reseller, Genpact reseller + MSA, EY / Big 4 consulting, the hyperscalers, Snowflake SPN, ServiceNow, Microsoft Pegasus) and keep joint pipeline moving.

 - Own partner announcements end to end. Press releases, launch content, and analyst-facing materials for major milestones, fully enabled for both field teams within a few days of go-live.

 - Own the metrics. Track and report partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue, and partner NPS, and hold the quality bar for every co-branded asset across partners, contractors, agencies, and AI-assisted workflows.




YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU...

 - Have 3 to 5 or more years in B2B SaaS marketing, with meaningful time in partner, channel, alliance, or field marketing at high-growth companies selling to finance, operations, or enterprise buyers.

 - Have run co-marketing with private equity, consulting/advisory, reseller, technology/ISV, or SI partners, and can point to joint campaigns, launches, or programs that generated real, partner-sourced pipeline.

 - Have spent time inside or close to the PE, consulting, or advisory world. Working at or alongside a PE firm, a Big 4 or strategy consultancy, or an advisory-heavy partner is a strong plus, because you already understand how those firms think, buy, and sell.

 - Know how the hyperscaler marketplaces actually work (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) along with Snowflake Marketplace and the ServiceNow Store: listings, private offers, co-sell registration, and marketplace-sourced pipeline.

 - Understand how partner programs actually work: MDF/co-op funds, marketplace listings, co-sell motions, deal registration, account mapping (Crossbeam/Reveal), and tiering.

 - Understand enterprise sales cycles, complex buying committees, and what content moves a $100K+ deal forward for both your reps and your partners' reps.

 - Write with clarity and conviction, and can turn a dense technical integration into a joint story a CFO would actually read.

 - Are comfortable with ambiguity and building from zero. This is a first partner-marketing hire with a blank canvas.

 - Are fluent with AI-powered tools for research, content creation, and workflow acceleration. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or similar to produce strong first drafts and move faster.




THIS PROBABLY ISN'T A FIT IF...

 - You've spent the majority of your career at companies with 500+ employees.

 - Your idea of partner marketing is coordinating a logo swap and a quarterly newsletter. We need someone who builds programs that generate pipeline.




HOW WE WORK AT STUUT

Stuut marketing runs on four pillars: take big swings, revenue is all that matters, learn fast through quantitative rigor, and stay product-first. We're a lean team that ships. You'll have unusual ownership, real budget, and direct exposure to the founders and to our partners' senior marketing and field teams. If you want to do the best work of your career and see it show up in pipeline, this is the team to do it with.

A note on AI: We treat AI as a genuine collaborator. We expect you to use it to think better and ship faster, and to make your work easy for the rest of the team to build on.

Compensation

 - Top-of-market salary and equity package

 - Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you

 - 401(k) & Match

 - Equity

 - Flexible PTO

 - Parental Leave

jobs.title: Associate Director, Oncology Field Reimbursement
jobs.description:
This role is field-based, and candidates should live within a reasonable distance from the primary city. Talent will be hired at a level commensurate with experience.

Candidates may live in the following cities:

• Chicago, IL
• Dallas, TX

Purpose Statement:

The Associate Director, Oncology Field Reimbursement leads a regional team of Field Reimbursement Managers (FRMs) providing compliant access, reimbursement, and affordability support across the oncology portfolio. This leader is accountable for building, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing a high-performing FRM team that can execute across today’s portfolio while scaling for future launch needs. The role translates portfolio access strategy into disciplined field execution and partners cross-functionally with Patient Services, Market Access, Sales, Brand, Training, Analytics, Operations, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, hub, and vendor partners.

Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, develop, and manage a regional Oncology FRM team.
• Build, hire, and onboard a portfolio-ready team with clear role expectations, territory readiness, development plans, and a culture of accountability, teamwork, compliance, customer focus, and high performance.
• Set and reinforce expectations for field execution, customer engagement, account prioritization, business planning, performance management, and compliant use of approved resources.
• Coach FRMs through field travel, ride-alongs, team meetings, business reviews, and individualized development plans.
• Ensure FRMs educate appropriate HCP office staff and account stakeholders on coverage, coding, billing, reimbursement, benefit verification, prior authorization, appeals, payer requirements, product acquisition, specialty pharmacy/distribution, and affordability support.
• Translate oncology portfolio strategy, franchise priorities, payer dynamics, patient support objectives, and multiple myeloma launch readiness into regional execution plans.
• Partner cross-functionally to define training, tools, workflows, dashboards, account education priorities, and feedback loops for portfolio and launch readiness.
• Monitor team activity, capacity, account coverage, quality, compliance, and performance through analytics, reporting tools, field insights, and business reviews.
• Engage key oncology and hematology accounts, when appropriate, to understand access barriers and support resolution of complex reimbursement or affordability challenges.
• Capture and escalate field insights related to payer policies, coverage barriers, prior authorization trends, site-of-care issues, coding/billing challenges, specialty distribution dynamics, customer education needs, and portfolio or launch risks.
• Contribute to the evolution of the Oncology FRM operating model, including recommendations for structure, workload balance, engagement cadence, performance measures, and field capability development.
• Ensure all activities comply with AbbVie policies, applicable laws and regulations, compliance requirements, and approved materials and processes.

Portfolio, Launch, and Team-Building Focus

• Build a portfolio-ready team with the capabilities and customer focus needed to support current oncology brands and future launch demands.
• Accelerate onboarding for new FRMs across role readiness, technical knowledge, territory understanding, portfolio fluency, and compliance expectations.
• Integrate current and new FRMs into one cohesive team with shared standards, trust, teamwork, and ownership of portfolio and launch outcomes.
• Establish field execution expectations across steady-state portfolio support, pre-launch readiness, launch, and post-launch execution.
• Use field insights to inform portfolio planning, multiple myeloma launch readiness, training, operational readiness, customer support needs, and continuous improvement.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree required; degree in health sciences, pharmacy, business, healthcare administration, or related field preferred. Advanced degree preferred.

Experience

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in field reimbursement, market access, managed care, payer support, patient services, oncology field support, specialty pharmacy/distribution, hub services, or a related healthcare role.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience leading, coaching, developing, or managing field-based teams preferred.
• Oncology and/or hematology-oncology experience strongly preferred, including experience with physician-administered therapies, buy-and-bill products, medical benefit reimbursement, specialty distribution/pharmacy, or complex access models.
• Launch, indication expansion, territory buildout, or organizational scaling experience strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated understanding of coverage, coding, billing, reimbursement, benefit verification, prior authorization, appeals, claims submission, payer policy, affordability support, and patient support program operations.
• Ability to lead through ambiguity, build team capability, manage change, and deliver results in a matrixed, regulated environment.

Skills and Abilities

• Strong people leadership, coaching, talent development, and performance management skills.
• Ability to build and scale teams during growth, change, portfolio expansion, or launch readiness.
• Strong understanding of oncology access and reimbursement dynamics, including payer policy, coding, claims submission, prior authorization and appeals, product acquisition, specialty pharmacy/distribution, and white-bagging.
• Ability to translate portfolio and launch strategy into clear field execution priorities and measurable action plans.
• Strong business planning, account prioritization, analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to use data, insights, and field feedback to monitor performance, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement.
• High level of integrity, judgment, professionalism, emotional intelligence, and compliance orientation.

jobs.title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer,  Robotics Platform
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. 

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.




WHO WE ARE

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

Responsibilities

 - Design, develop, test, and maintain robotics middleware and application frameworks using modern C++ on embedded Linux.

 - Own significant platform components from technical design and implementation through validation, deployment, and operation across Serve’s robot fleet.

 - Partner with software teams using the robot platform to identify reliability, performance, and developer experience problems and deliver reusable solutions.

 - Collaborate with Autonomy and Systems Engineering on risk assessments, failure analysis, fault-handling strategies, and software architecture.

 - Translate system-level safety and reliability requirements into software behavior, interfaces, and verification strategies.

 - Develop instrumentation, benchmarks, logging, tracing, and fleet-level metrics to measure and improve software performance, reliability, and system health.

 - Diagnose and resolve complex system-level issues involving concurrency, scheduling, interprocess communication, networking, and constrained compute resources.

 - Evaluate technical tradeoffs and contribute to architectural decisions that improve the scalability, maintainability, and reliability of the robotics platform.

 - Lead technical design and code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, development practices, and technical documentation.

 - Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers through design discussions, problem solving, and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience developing production software in modern C++ (C++17 and newer).

 - Experience developing and debugging systems software in embedded Linux environments.

 - Strong understanding of multithreaded programming, concurrency, synchronization, interprocess communication, and systems-level software development.

 - Experience designing software for latency-sensitive, safety-related, real-time, or high-reliability systems.

 - Experience profiling and optimizing embedded software for performance, reliability, and resource utilization.

 - Experience independently owning complex software components through design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to diagnose complex issues across software and hardware boundaries.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across software, systems, and hardware engineering teams.

What Makes You Stand Out

 - Experience developing middleware for robotics, autonomous vehicles, or similar complex systems.

 - Experience developing and deploying production software on NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded computing platforms.

 - Knowledge of Linux internals, scheduling, resource management, device interfaces, and interprocess communication mechanisms.

 - Experience with fault-tolerant architecture, failure-mode analysis, functional safety, or safety-related software development.

 - Experience with distributed systems, networking, RPC frameworks, or serialization technologies such as Protocol Buffers, FlatBuffers, or Cap’n Proto.

 - Experience developing telemetry, observability, health monitoring, or diagnostic capabilities for robotics or distributed device fleets.

 - Experience integrating software with sensors, embedded hardware, or other robotic system components.

Additional Information:

This role works across multiple engineering disciplines and balances hands-on software development with systems-level problem solving, technical design, and cross-functional collaboration. The position may occasionally require access to robotics hardware or onsite participation in integration, testing, troubleshooting, or validation activities.

jobs.title: Staff PCB Design Engineer/Layout Engineer, Air Dominance and Strike
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an  Staff PCB Designer / Staff Layout Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will work closely with avionics, system, and software engineers to create test systems for development, qualification, verification, and validation purposes. If you are someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment supporting new developments, active deployments, and customer operated hardware, we are looking for you.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of experience with PCB layout

• 5+ years of experience with Altium

• Ability to read and interpret schematics, apply best practices appropriate for each design, and push back on schematic or architectural decisions that create layout, manufacturability, or integrity risk

• Deep understanding of PCB fabrication and assembly processes, limitations, design rules, and best practices, including the ability to define and validate stackups with fabricators

• Experience owning ECAD libraries and library standards — footprint creation and verification, IPC compliance, and governance across multiple designers

• Working knowledge of signal and power integrity principles, including the ability to interpret SI/PI simulation results and translate them into layout constraints

• Expert-level high speed digital layout and controlled impedance routing — DDR, PCIe, SerDes, Ethernet, USB — including length/skew matching, differential pair routing, and return path management

• Experience with high density designs: fine-pitch BGA fanout, HDI/microvia construction, and stackups greater than 12 layers

• Demonstrated technical leadership: serving as lead designer on complex or multi-board programs, setting and documenting layout constraints, conducting design reviews, and mentoring less experienced designers

• Ability to manage layout scope, schedule, and risk across concurrent programs while collaborating with electrical, mechanical, and program teams

• Eligible for security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• CID+, CID++ and/or PCEA-CPCD certification

• Working experience applying MIL-STD and IPC standards, including IPC-2221/2222, IPC-6012 Class 3, and IPC-A-610

• Experience with rigid-flex, RF/mixed-signal, and thermally constrained designs

• Experience designing and analyzing power distribution networks using SI/PI tools (HyperLynx, Ansys SIwave, Cadence Sigrity, or equivalent)

• Advanced Altium proficiency: constraint/rule management, scripting or automation, Altium 365/Concord Pro, and version-controlled design data

• Experience leading DFM/DFA engagement with fab and assembly vendors through NPI

• Experience introducing or improving ECAD process, design standards, or documentation practices for a team

• Thriving in a fast-paced environment

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or similar

US Salary Range

$168,000—$272,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description:
About Us

Chorus Innovations is a fast-growing healthcare technology company with an adaptive platform as a service (PaaS) that enables the rapid development of mobile, desktop, text messaging and interactive voice applications. Chorus’ platform currently powers transformative healthcare, biomedical research and community health projects across institutions and public health agencies nationwide. We believe every community should have world-class health technology so they can thrive.

Our mission is to improve the lives of people and communities by democratizing technology development in health and research.

About the Role

The Director of Product Design will be a key leader, shaping the aesthetic, user experience, and overall brand presence across our platform and enterprise client services. This role requires a strategic visionary who can also drive tactical execution and elevate the performance of the design team. The Director will lead with craftsmanship and a reminder of responsibility: to build not just quickly, but beautifully, purposefully, and with pride. These principles ensure not just polished products but a cohesive, thoughtful experience across the board.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Partner with the CEO and executive leadership to define, articulate, and execute an innovative design strategy that directly supports the company's business objectives and elevates the brand's competitive position. This includes strategy for both digital products/platforms and enterprise client-facing services.

• Own outcomes for one or more functional areas. Lead and develop team members, partner closely with cross-functional leaders, ensure high-quality execution, and translate company strategy into scalable, customer-centered solutions.

• Manage and mentor the product design team, fostering a high-performing culture of creativity, collaboration, and accountability. Provide strategic direction, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to ensure team mastery and success.

• Champion and operationalize a rigorous user-centric design approach. Use insights and data from user research to inform and validate all design decisions.

• Govern the evolution and consistency of the Chorus products’ brand identity (Chorus Signature Theme) across all Chorus products. Ensure visual design, tone of voice, and overall user experience cohesively reflect the Chorus products’ brand values and mission.

• Oversee the end-to-end product design lifecycle, from initial concept, AI-assisted building/prototyping, wireframing, high fidelity designing, and final handoff, ensuring the delivery of intuitive, accessible, and market-leading digital products and services.

• Establish and uphold rigorous design quality standards and practices throughout the organization. Implement robust review processes to ensure all design deliverables are consistent, high-quality, and align with brand and system guidelines.

• Serve as the primary design leader in collaborative efforts with Product Management, Engineering, Clinical Solutions, and User Experience Research, to ensure design is seamlessly integrated into the product development roadmap and execution cycles. Collaborate with these partners to continuously refine the product development lifecycle as new tools emerge (example: AI workflows).

• Define, build, and meticulously maintain a scalable and comprehensive Design System to optimize design workflows, promote organizational consistency, and dramatically accelerate design and development iterations.

What We’re Looking For

• 10+ in product design overall, including 6+ years directly managing and developing design teams

• Demonstrated ownership of a design system or brand identity at scale; not just contributing to one, but governing it

• Experience designing for both digital products and enterprise/B2B client services

• A portfolio that shows range: strategic frameworks and pixel-level craft they were personally hands-on with

• Comfortable giving feedback and taking a design from 0-to-1 themselves when needed

• History of building high-performing teams

• Decisive under ambiguity: can synthesize competing input (exec vision, user data, engineering constraints) into a clear call, not just facilitate consensus

• Proven partnership with C-suite or executive leadership on strategy

• Fluency working alongside Product, Engineering, and Research as true peers, especially in fast-evolving workflows (e.g., AI-assisted design/prototyping)

• Experience operationalizing user research into design decisions, not just referencing it

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

• Mission-driven teammates dedicated to improving lives by tearing down tech barriers.

• Diverse, inclusive culture where every voice is valued.

• Full medical, dental, vision, and life-insurance benefits.

• 401(k) with company match.

• Stock-option eligibility.

• Unlimited PTO and generous paid parental leave.

• Performance-based bonuses.

Compensation Disclosure

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $190,000 in the Los Angeles market. Actual offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and may include additional components such as performance bonuses, stock options, and benefits. Chorus Innovations is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team. We welcome applicants of every background and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance, email careers@joinchorus.com.

Chorus Innovations values diversity as a core principle of the work we do and the communities we serve.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religious creed, citizenship, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, military and veteran status, gender, gender identity, gender expression, or any other protected characteristic.

Disability Accommodation for Applicants to Chorus Innovations

We recognize the value that individuals with diverse abilities bring to our organization and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all applicants.

jobs.title: Growth Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 


ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. By leveraging data-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company's growth and success.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Reporting to the Director, Global Growth Content, you will own and scale Airwallex’s growth and demand generation content engine globally on the payments product. You will work closely with global and regional teammates across Growth, Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance Marketing, and Lifecycle to build content that drives qualified demand, pipeline, and revenue.

This role is ideal for a hands-on content leader who loves writing and editing SEO content, ebooks, guides, and one-pagers, and who is excited to go deep on technical product narratives—translating complex capabilities into clear, compelling, conversion-oriented content.

You will join the Airwallex Marketing team during a critical period of growth. As we scale, we are building a team that balances global consistency in content strategy, quality, and process, with local flexibility and speed in execution. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how growth content drives the next phase of Airwallex’s expansion.



This role is based in San Francisco.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Build Growth Content Marketing as a global discipline at Airwallex, establishing best practices, scalable processes, and a high-performing team over time.

 - Own the end-to-end demand gen content strategy, spanning SEO, gated assets, mid-funnel conversion content, and product-led narratives.

 - Write, edit, and ship high-impact content including:
   
   - SEO pillar pages, cluster articles, and comparison content
   
   - Ebooks, whitepapers, and long-form guides
   
   - One-pagers, solution briefs, and product explainers

 - Partner deeply with Product Marketing and Product to translate launches, features, APIs, and workflows into content that is searchable, understandable, and sellable.

 - Use user, customer, and market insights to improve ICP targeting, segmentation, messaging, and content distribution strategies.

 - Work closely with SEO and Performance Marketing to align content with keyword intent, funnel stages, and conversion goals.

 - Be obsessive about measurement and iteration, using performance data to continuously optimize content for traffic quality, engagement, and pipeline impact.

 - Hold a high bar for content quality and technical accuracy, ensuring clarity without oversimplifying complex concepts.

 - Build a structured experimentation mindset—scaling what performs, refreshing or retiring what doesn’t.

 - Balance short-term growth outcomes with longer-term investments in evergreen content, topical authority, and durable demand.




WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 6+ years of experience in growth content marketing, demand gen content, or SEO-led content roles, preferably at a high-growth B2B technology company.

 - A proven track record of creating content that drives measurable business outcomes across the funnel—from traffic to MQLs to pipeline.

 - Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to explain technical products, platforms, or workflows clearly and credibly.

 - Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, including keyword intent, on-page optimization, internal linking, and content clustering.

 - A data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze content performance and optimize based on results—not just instincts.

 - Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance, and Lifecycle teams.

 - Comfort working in a fast-paced, global environment and communicating progress and impact to key stakeholders.

 - Experience managing freelancers or agencies and holding them to a high bar for quality and performance.

 - Familiarity with common CMS, SEO, analytics, and experimentation tools (e.g., Webflow/WordPress, GSC, GA4, Ahrefs).
   
   


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

Parachute Health is hiring its first dedicated Event Marketing Manager to own strategy and execution across the 65+ industry conferences and events we attend each year, spanning four buyer segments: HME suppliers, clinicians, health systems, and payers. This role will also lead the build-out of Parachute's owned events, such as customer advisory boards and hosted customer events.

This is a strategy-plus-execution role. You'll partner with the SVP Marketing, Chief Revenue Officer, and customer-facing leadership to decide which events we invest in and why, manage the budget across the portfolio, and drive the marketing and logistics that make each event successful.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the annual events portfolio strategy: which events to attend, at what tier of investment, and why, tied to lead generation and brand goals across all four buyer segments.

• Manage the events budget, including recommending where to increase, hold, or cut spend.

• Run event execution end-to-end: logistics, booth/asset management, staffing coordination, and on-site presence.

• Partner with Growth Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, and Account Management so leads captured at events flow into effective marketing campaigns and timely sales and CS follow-up.

• Own lead capture, ROI tracking, and attribution for events, closing the current gap between event spend and pipeline visibility.

• Lead the design and execution of Parachute-owned events, including customer advisory boards.

• Manage external vendors supporting the events program (asset storage/shipping, lead capture tooling, and potentially contract event staff).

• Support Sales and Account Management with merchandise and collateral for key prospect and customer accounts.

What We're Looking For

• Experience managing budget and strategy for both industry conferences and owned/hosted events.

• A demonstrated ability to translate event spend into ROI: lead generation, growth within existing accounts, and brand awareness.

• Hands-on experience with lead capture tools and a CRM (HubSpot preferred), including getting event leads routed and followed up on.

• High agency and a bias toward action. Someone who keeps things moving without waiting to be told the next step.

• Creative marketer with proven experience building quality campaigns that drive brand awareness and lead generation.

• Comfort managing several concurrent priorities (multiple conferences in the same week is normal for this role).

• Healthcare experience (DME/HME, homecare, health system, physician group, or health plan) is a plus.

• Comfort managing vendors and using technology/AI tools to work faster and more effectively.

jobs.title: RFP Writer
jobs.description:
Swing Education wins many of our district and charter partnerships through competitive RFP, RFI, and bid processes - and the proposal is where the case gets made. As our RFP Writer, you own that case from the moment an opportunity lands to the moment it's submitted: you help decide what's worth chasing, build the plan, write the story, and get it out the door on time and airtight.

As our RFP writer, you'll sit at the center of sales, product, operations, legal, and finance, turning Swing’s products and services into a proposal that stands out above the rest. You monitor our channels, create the winning stories, and run the day-to-day bid process with a manager on hand for more complex, high-stakes submissions.

If you like deadlines that mean something, writing that has to be persuasive and exactly right, and work that ensures students always have a teacher to help them learn - you'll like this job.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Find the opportunities worth winning. Monitor bid portals, procurement notices, and signals to catch relevant RFPs, RFIs, and bids as they release. Run go/no-go calls with leadership - weighing fit, competitive landscape, timeline, and win probability - so our effort goes where it counts. Log and triage everything coming in, especially through the spring rush when K-12 budget cycles put everything on the calendar at once.

• Run the process end to end. Build the timeline and compliance matrix for each response, working backward from the deadline. Draft, edit, and assemble narrative content, pricing exhibits, staffing plans, and required forms. Drive technical, pricing, and legal reviews through internal sign-off. Own final formatting, proofing, and submission.

• Pull in the right people at the right moment. Partner with account executives to understand each district's needs, pain points, and competitive picture. Get operational and technical detail from product, regional ops, and customer success so every claim reflects what Swing does today. Work with legal on terms, insurance certificates, and contract exceptions, and with finance on pricing structure and margin before anything goes out.

• Learn the product. Build deep, current command of our marketplace model, service offerings, pricing, geographic coverage, and compliance processes - enough to write persuasively and sell our services to district administrators. Keep the proposal content library (boilerplate, templates, past performance, bios, differentiators) current as the business evolves.

• Make the next bid better than the last. Track win/loss outcomes and debrief the losses honestly to sharpen messaging and close recurring gaps. Improve templates, style guides, and reusable content so turnaround gets faster and more efficient. Recommend process changes as bid volume grows.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Extremely high attention to detail.

• 2-4 years of experience writing or coordinating proposals, RFP responses, or grant applications, ideally in a B2B services, staffing, ed-tech, or public-sector-facing environment

• Comfortable owning a proposal end-to-end under deadline pressure

• Solid project-management instincts - able to hold a timeline and keep cross-functional contributors on track

• Very strong writing, editing, and synthesis skills; able to translate technical/operational detail into clear, persuasive narrative

• Experience (or clear aptitude) coordinating input from sales, legal, finance, and operations stakeholders

• Comfort with public-sector or K-12 procurement processes a plus (RFP portals, compliance requirements, scoring rubrics)

• APMP certification (or interest in pursuing one) a plus, not required

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

• AI Enthusiast

What success looks like in the first 6 months

Independently owns intake-to-submission for standard RFPs, escalating appropriately on complex or unusually large bids. Has built working relationships with sales, product, and operations stakeholders as go-to sources. Has a functioning, current content library and compliance matrix template. Contributes at least one process improvement that measurably reduces turnaround time or improves win rate.

jobs.title: Associate Talent Partner, Fleet Operations
jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

About the Role

Wayve is pioneering Embodied AI for autonomous driving. We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Associate to join our Sunnyvale team and support the continued growth of our real-world testing and operations.

In this role, you’ll manage hiring across Fleet Operations in North America and beyond, covering high-volume, specialist, and manager-level roles. Partnering closely with hiring managers and senior leaders, you’ll translate business needs into effective recruitment strategies and help build the teams needed to scale Wayve’s global operations safely and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

• Hiring Delivery: Independently manage end-to-end recruitment across high-volume frontline, technical, specialist, and manager-level Fleet Operations roles, from intake and market mapping through assessment, offer, and close.

• Sourcing: Build representative candidate pipelines through direct sourcing and a range of attraction channels, developing locally informed and scalable approaches for Vehicle Safety Operator and other high-volume roles.

• Stakeholder Partnership: Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and Directors, providing consultative guidance on role definition, assessment, market conditions, candidate quality, and closing strategies.

• Candidate and Hiring Experience: Deliver an inclusive, transparent, and well-managed candidate experience while supporting hiring teams with structured interviewing, timely feedback, and consistent decision-making.

• Data and Market Insights: Use recruitment data and market intelligence to monitor progress, identify risks and bottlenecks, improve funnel performance, and shape realistic hiring strategies.

• Collaboration and Improvement: Partner with colleagues across Talent Acquisition, People, Finance, and Fleet Operations on workforce planning, employer branding, and improvements to hiring processes.

About You

To set you up for success as a Talent Acquisition Associate at Wayve, we are looking for the following skills and experience:

Essential

• Demonstrated success independently delivering full-cycle recruitment within a fast-paced or scaling organization.

• Experience recruiting across a broad range of roles, including high-volume, professional, or manager-level positions.

• The confidence and judgment to advise senior stakeholders, constructively challenge assumptions, and translate business needs into effective hiring strategies.

• Strong direct-sourcing skills and experience using multiple attraction channels to build candidate pipelines.

• A hands-on, adaptable, and highly organized approach, with the ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail.

• Confidence using applicant tracking systems, recruitment data, and market insights to inform decisions and communicate progress effectively.

Desirable

• Experience recruiting within fleet operations, automotive, logistics, manufacturing, field operations, mobility, customer operations, or another high-volume operational environment.

• Experience supporting hiring across multiple locations or working with globally distributed stakeholders.

• Familiarity with Ashby or a similar applicant tracking system.

• Experience designing or improving volume-hiring campaigns, recruitment events, or structured assessment processes.

• Experience working in a startup environment where priorities and processes continue to evolve.

This is a full-time, permanent role based in Sunnyvale, California. At Wayve, we want the best of all worlds, so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines a minimum of two days each week in the office with time spent working from home. Time together in our offices and operational environments helps fuel innovation, culture, relationships, and learning.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $130,000 to $150,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. This range should be confirmed against current market data before publication.

.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive – Warehouse Robotics (North America)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.

Position Overview

We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to own new business across North America, selling our autonomous mobile robot (AMR) fleets, delivered as robotics-as-a-service (RaaS), into large fulfillment and distribution operations. Reporting to the Global Commercial Director, you will build your own pipeline, run complex multi-stakeholder evaluations, and structure and negotiate subscription agreements with a typical annual contract value around $500K. You will partner closely with sales engineering, who own system modeling and solution design, while you own the relationship, the deal strategy, and the close. This role offers the opportunity to shape Skild AI's reference base, pricing, and product roadmap as one of a small, senior go-to-market team.

Responsibilities

• Own a North American territory and build a self-sourced pipeline of enterprise 3PLs, retailers, e-commerce brands, and parts distributors.

• Prospect through direct outreach, industry events and trade shows (such as MODEX and ProMat), and channel partners.

• Lead deals from first meeting through discovery, site visits, solution design, proposal, pilot or proof of concept, and signature.

• Run structured discovery on order profiles, labor constraints, peak dynamics, and current automation estate.

• Build and present business cases tied to measurable outcomes, including labor productivity, cost per unit, throughput, and payback.

• Differentiate against competing AMR, goods-to-person, and fixed automation vendors in competitive evaluations.

• Structure RaaS subscription agreements, including fleet sizing, term, pricing, and expansion paths, and guide capital-purchase buyers through adopting a subscription model.

• Navigate enterprise procurement, legal, and security review alongside outside counsel on commercial terms.

• Maintain an accurate forecast and disciplined CRM hygiene so leadership can plan against your numbers.

• Collaborate with sales engineering, customer success, and deployment teams to hand off cleanly and drive fleet expansions and new sites.

• Bring structured win/loss and customer feedback to product and engineering to inform the roadmap.

• Regular travel to customer sites, pilots, and industry trade shows across North America, plus periodic visits to our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding targets.

• Track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in the $250K–$1M+ range with 6–12 month sales cycles.

• Experience selling to operations, engineering, finance, and executive buyers in the same deal.

• Proven ability to build pipeline from scratch rather than inheriting a book of business.

• Strong business acumen; able to build and defend an ROI case on labor cost, throughput, and payback.

• Skilled negotiator who can hold price and structure terms that protect long-term value.

• Proficiency with a CRM and a structured sales methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, or similar).

• Working knowledge of warehouse and distribution operations, or the curiosity and speed to learn them quickly.

• Experience selling supply chain automation (AMRs, goods-to-person, AS/RS, conveyor and sortation, or warehouse software) is a plus.

• Experience selling subscription, RaaS, or recurring-revenue models into buyers accustomed to capital purchases is a plus.

• An existing network of operations and supply chain leaders across North American distribution is a plus.

• Owner mindset; self-directed, effective working remotely, and willing to qualify out deals that aren't a fit.

Outside of base salary, this role has on-target earnings (OTE), plus uncapped variable compensation tied to bookings.

Base Salary Range

$150,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.title: Director of Product, Payments and Wallet
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The Payments and Wallet team owns how money moves on Roblox starting with how players pay in, ending with how developers get paid out, and the wallet infrastructure that connects the two. Consumer facing payments are also the high impact area for driving revenue growth for the company. As Director of Product for Payments and Wallet, you will own this business end to end: setting the long-term strategy, standing up new banking and wallet products from zero users to all developers, and running the P&L for a meaningful revenue line at Roblox. You will lead a team of product managers and partner closely with Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Business Development to build payment and wallet products that work at global scale. This is a builder's role for someone who has taken a financial product from an idea to a business and wants to do it again on one of the largest user-generated platforms in the world.

This role is based in San Mateo, CA (hybrid with Tues-Thurs in office) and reports to the Sr. Director Product, Monetization and Payments.

You will:

• Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Wallet, spanning consumer payment methods, developer and creator payouts, and the underlying wallet platform. This role also encompasses risk management and payment operations leadership.

• Launch new banking and wallet products from 0 to 1, and scale it into a durable revenue stream.

• Own the P&L for the Payments and Wallet business, including revenue and margin targets, cost of payments, and the investment tradeoffs required to hit them.

• Build, lead, and grow a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, execution, and career development.

• Ensure operational excellence for risk ops and payment ops

• Partner with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business Development to expand payment coverage internationally and to launch products that meet regulatory and licensing requirements in each market.

• Establish the strategy for payments risk and fraud management, balancing authorization rates and user experience against loss, chargeback, and compliance exposure.

• Represent the Payments and Wallet business to Roblox executive leadership and to external partners including processors, banking partners, and payment networks.

You have:

• 10+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading and growing product teams.

• A track record of launching a banking, wallet, or financial product from 0 to 1 and growing it into a meaningful business.

• Direct P&L ownership, with demonstrated results driving revenue and managing cost structure for a product line.

• Experience building and scaling global payments products, including working with processors, banking partners, alternative payment methods, and cross-border money movement.

• Risk management and fraud expertise, including chargebacks, authorization optimization, KYC/AML, and regulatory compliance in financial products.

• A technical approach: comfort going deep on platform and implementation details, and the ability to partner with engineering on scalable, extensible architecture.

• A data-driven approach: proficiency identifying, defining, tracking, and acting on the metrics that move a financial business, plus familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills: the ability to convey strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs to an executive audience, and to produce clear, detailed product specifications for the team.

• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a technical, business, or related field.

You are:

• Entrepreneurial: you propose ambitious ideas and then go build them, without waiting for permission.

• Comfortable operating with incomplete information and making the call anyway.

• Rigorous about risk without being slowed by it; you know where to hold the line and where to move fast.

• A strong collaborator who can align Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Business Development behind a single plan.

• Hands-on, creative, data-obsessed, and detail-oriented.

$383,120—$439,280 USD

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero
jobs.description:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

What would you do if hired?

• Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.

• Drive adoption of Celigo's own products (agents, MCP, Ora/CLI, integrations) inside GTO's GTM, CX, and G&A systems. When you run into friction, you dig into it before being asked. Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.

• Use Celigo's AI-powered platform as part of how you work every day. You will be one of the first people inside the company to push on new agentic capabilities, give Product honest feedback on where they deliver and where they fall short, and help define what "AI-first" actually looks like inside an enterprise workflow. Your daily use is part of the feedback loop.

• Bring product discipline to every workstream: defined requirements, clear success criteria, and prioritization grounded in adoption and business value. Committed dates should hold because you've done the thinking up front, shipping the smallest version that delivers real value and iterating from there rather than waiting for a perfect build.

• Operate in both hats simultaneously: design the underlying business processes and own the solution as a product manager. You're the person who figures out how the process should work and the person accountable for whether what ships delivers an outstanding experience.

• Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.

• Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

Who are we looking for?

Skills & Abilities

• You're energized by building something that doesn't fully exist yet. You ask the questions others skip past, including the uncomfortable ones about what's actually broken, and you treat ambiguity as the job, not an obstacle to it.

• You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why Customer Zero matters to the company, and you make decisions that serve that outcome, including the trade-offs nobody told you to make. You ask "why" before "how."

• You ship the smallest version that delivers real value and iterate on real feedback. A 10-slide internal use case that lands in one deal is better than a perfect playbook no one has read. You recover quickly when something doesn't land, without drama.

• You treat the program's problems as your own. You move on things before being asked, you measure yourself by outcomes rather than activity, and you find the faster path and take it.

• You drive results through influence, not authority. You create alignment with engineering teams, Sales, and the CPO's org by understanding what each team needs and making it easy for them to say yes.

• You're comfortable applying AI to your own work: drafting, research, analysis, and wherever else it frees you for the judgment calls that matter. Genuine curiosity about what AI can and cannot do is part of what makes someone thrive here, especially in a role that's also responsible for making AI credible to customers.

• You translate clearly between business stakeholders (GTM, CX, G&A) and technical teams. You know enough about the systems to design processes, not just manage a backlog.

• You're credible on stage and in a boardroom. Executive presence is real for this role: you will represent Celigo externally and need customers and prospects to trust what you say.

• You use data (adoption, usage, outcomes) to prioritize, to influence colleagues and executives, and to know early when something isn't working.

Education & Experience

• 8+ years in product management, comfortable operating hands-on as a Principal individual contributor while owning a program end-to-end.

• Deep functional experience in GTM and/or CX operations and the systems that run them (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or similar), sufficient to design the processes, not just manage the backlog.

• Track record of running an internal-as-first-customer, dogfooding, or Customer Zero program, or standing up a Product function where one didn't exist.

• Experience building and packaging reference stories or proof points that Sales and Marketing can use externally.

• Preferred: background with SaaS, iPaaS, integration, or automation platforms, and comfort with AI-first or agentic products.

• Preferred: hands-on experience using the product you support internally.

• Preferred: close partnership with a CPO or Product org to influence a public roadmap.

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base salary between $175,000 and $200,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.

Celigo is proud to be

• A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS. The only vendor to receive this award.

• Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year

• Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management.

• Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you'll experience

• Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency

• A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented

• Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field

• Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily

• Competitive compensation and benefits, including:

• Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)

• Wellness days and holidays to recharge

• Parental leave and a generous benefits package

• Monthly tech stipend

• Recognition and career development opportunities

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility

As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. jobs.title: Associate Director, Service Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

The Associate Director of Service Engineering leads the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of Natera’s lab-facing platforms. This role ensures that clinical systems, laboratory equipment workflows, and data pipelines operate with high reliability, scalability, and compliance in a regulated healthcare environment.

You will lead a team responsible for production stability, incident response, and service health, partnering closely with Production Engineering, Lab Operations, Bioinformatics, Infrastructure, Facilities, and Compliance to support mission-critical genetic testing and diagnostics.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, mentor, and scale a team of Service Engineers / SREs supporting clinical production systems

• Establish clear expectations around ownership, on-call readiness, and operational excellence

• Drive hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career growth

• Foster a blameless, learning-oriented culture focused on patient impact and reliability

Service Reliability & Production Operations

• Own reliability and availability for production services supporting laboratory operations, reporting, and customer delivery

• Define and manage SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs aligned with clinical and business priorities

• Lead major incident response, ensuring rapid triage, clear communication, and thorough post-incident reviews

• Oversee on-call rotations, escalation paths, and operational playbooks

• Ensure operational readiness and go-live support for new assays, pipelines, and platform capabilities

Technical Strategy & Execution

• Partner with Engineering and Development teams to design resilient, fault-tolerant systems

• Drive best practices for monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability across lab and cloud platforms

• Reduce operational toil through automation, tooling, and process improvements

• Advocate for reliability, performance, and scalability requirements early in the development lifecycle

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as a primary operational partner to Lab Operations, Bioinformatics, Engineering, and Development.

• Translate clinical, regulatory, and operational needs into technical reliability requirements

• Provide clear, executive-level updates on service health, incidents, and risk mitigation plans

Compliance, Security & Risk Management

• Ensure systems meet healthcare and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, CLIA, CAP, SOX)

• Partner with Quality and Compliance on audits, access controls, change management, and incident response

• Own disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and periodic testing for critical systems

• Ensure production changes follow validated and compliant release processes

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in service engineering, engineering roles

• 5+ years of people management experience leading technical teams

• Strong experience operating highly available, mission-critical production systems

• Proven expertise in incident management and root cause analysis

• Hands-on experience with CMMS and LIMs environments

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in high-stakes situations

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in healthcare, biotech, or other regulated environments

• Familiarity with laboratory information systems (LIMS), data pipelines, or bioinformatics workflows

• Experience with infrastructure and automation tools

• Experience defining SLOs/SLAs for systems with clinical or patient impact

What Success Looks Like

• Reliable, predictable operation of lab-facing systems

• Reduced incident frequency and faster recovery times

• Strong partnership with Lab Ops, Engineering, and Compliance

• A high-performing Service Engineering team that proactively improves system reliability

• Clear visibility into operational risk and service health across Natera platforms

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.
