jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
PLATFORM ENGINEER

New York, NY • Full-time • Hybrid (3+ days/week in office)




ABOUT GOVSIGNALS

GovSignals is the AI system of work for government contracting. It can take the government longer to buy a capability than an adversary takes to field one, and we exist to close that gap.



We're the only startup managing government contract data with AI in both FedRAMP High and DoW Impact Level 5 environments. Our platform monitors 5,000+ live government data sources, 100,000+ federal and state agencies, and 2,000,000+ government contracts in real time. Our customers in government include offices like DIU and SOCOM, and our customers in industry range from small contractors to Fortune 500 primes with billions in annual awards. In the past 18 months, we've earned FedRAMP High and IL5 authorizations, joined GSA MAS and the MDA SHIELD IDIQ, and signed some of the biggest names in government contracting.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Platform Engineer to expand our platform engineering team. You'll work directly with the CTO and own the infrastructure and security of a platform that runs in commercial cloud, FedRAMP High, and IL5 environments.

Every GovSignals deployment runs on the infrastructure you'll own. You'll build and operate it daily, and you'll own it once it's in production. When a customer's security team asks how a control works, you are the one who can show them. The work arrives as a requirement rather than a design, and you decide how the platform meets it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run the same product in three places at once: commercial cloud, FedRAMP High in AWS GovCloud, and IL5. Where the tooling doesn't work in a restricted network, we make it work. We maintain our own builds of Supabase and Trigger.dev http://Trigger.dev.

 - Run the Kubernetes clusters, GitOps pipelines, networking, and observability for each environment, and make standing up a new environment a repeatable process.

 - Build infrastructure where AI agents are first-class users: agentic harnesses that support how billions in government contract volume gets won and managed, automated remediation loops, and deployment tooling used by engineers and agents alike.

 - Work with our deployment team to integrate customer data, including data underpinning America's warfighting capabilities, and support thousands of users at enterprises managing billions in contracts.

 - Our stack: Kubernetes, AWS GovCloud, UDS, Cloudflare Workers, TypeScript, Postgres.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or security engineering roles.

 - Experience building infrastructure that other engineers depend on.

 - Deep Kubernetes experience in production: cluster operations, networking, GitOps, and upgrades without downtime.

 - You've taken infrastructure through a real migration or scaling event and can walk through what broke.

 - You build secure by default: hardened images, least-privilege access, network policy, and secrets management are where you start.

Nice to have: experience in FedRAMP, IL, HIPAA, or other regulated environments; Postgres operations (replication, backups, migrations); backend TypeScript; open-source infrastructure work.

Clearance: not required. An active or previous clearance is a plus.




THE TEAM

GovSignals was founded by four cofounders who lived with this problem from both sides (selling to the government and serving inside it) with backgrounds across the Defense Intelligence Agency, the Department of Energy, Palantir, Amazon, federal contractors building for missiles, and state contractors building for prisons. You'll work directly with all four. Other team members at GovSignals have shipped to defense companies, scaled venture-backed startups, and founded companies of their own.




HOW WE WORK

Design by HI (Human Intelligence), Work by AI (Artificial Intelligence). Human Intelligence takes responsibility for what we build and how we communicate to customers. Artificial Intelligence does much of the building. We provide unlimited Claude and ChatGPT credits for reasonable use, and we expect you to come in with extensive AI experience.




HOW WE HIRE

 - Intro conversation (30 min): your background and how you work.

 - Technical interview (1 hr): real-world inspired technical exercises.

 - Co-founder conversations (15 min): meet the cofounders.

 - Work trial (1 day): real work with the team.

 - Offer.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Base Salary: $160,000 – $230,000

 - Equity: Meaningful stake in a well-funded, fast-growing startup

 - Benefits: medical, vision, and dental, unlimited PTO

 - Brooklyn Navy Yard office, 3+ days a week in person. The Yard built ships for the Navy from 1801 to 1966, now we build systems for Navy program offices.



Due to the nature of our government work, this role is open only to U.S. citizens and other U.S. Persons. GovSignals is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Investment Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Weiss Asset Management (WAM), a Boston-based investment firm, is seeking an Investment Compliance Analyst to join our Compliance team. This role sits at the intersection of investment compliance, trading, and data, with responsibility for monitoring trade activity, resolving compliance exceptions, and improving the systems and processes that support ongoing compliance monitoring.

Candidates graduating in Summer 2027, as well as those with 1-3 years of relevant professional experience, are encouraged to apply. Working proficiency in SQL is required; experience with Python, automation, AI tools, or order management systems is a plus. This is a full-time, in-office role based in Boston.

Responsibilities:

• Monitor and resolve pre- and post-trade compliance alerts across funds and strategies, using data to spot exceptions and patterns and escalating issues with traders and internal teams as needed.

• Interpret, maintain, and test trading compliance rules in the firm's order management system (OMS), and support investment-related compliance questions.

• Analyze trade, position, and compliance data in SQL to support recurring reviews, reconciliations, and investigations.

• Automate manual tasks with code and AI tools, building solutions that make compliance monitoring more efficient and repeatable.

• Design systematic, scalable workflows for compliance reviews and escalations.

• Maintain restricted securities and issuer lists across firm systems and support wall-crossing and MNPI processes.

• Track regulatory developments and assess their impact on trading activity, compliance rules, policies, and procedures.

• Support regulatory filings, audits, system upgrades, and ad-hoc compliance projects.

Base Salary: $85,000–$125,000 per year, depending on experience. Actual compensation will reflect the candidate's skills, relevant experience, and overall fit for the role. It is unlikely that all new hires will start at the top of this range.

About the Company:

For 34 years, Weiss Asset Management has developed proprietary investment strategies designed to deliver high risk-adjusted returns to our investors, who include charitable foundations, pension plans, endowments, hospitals, government entities and private investors. We manage approximately $4.5 billion across our hedge fund clients. We work collaboratively to solve problems, and to identify undervalued assets through deep fundamental research, statistical analysis and an analytically rigorous approach to decision making. Above all else, we value integrity, uncompromising rationality, creativity and entrepreneurship, and continuous learning and improvement.

Our team of over 140 individuals is the engine of our success, and we welcome truly exceptional candidates from all backgrounds.

WAM is a fit for you if:

• You enjoy a collaborative environment, where decisions are made in diverse teams. At WAM, all employees can expect to work directly with members of other departments representing a range of backgrounds.

• You work well in a flat structure and are comfortable voicing dissenting opinion. Talent and work ethic will dictate what you can achieve at WAM, as evidenced by the fact that our president and the majority of our managing directors began their careers here as interns.

• You are driven to constantly learn, improve, and make rational decisions based in fact and data, and you welcome receiving feedback as well as sharing knowledge with others.

• You prioritize acting ethically in all situations.

WAM is an equal opportunity employer. Women, minorities, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian (Relief) - Horizon West, FL
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous referral reward program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Operating Executive
jobs.description:
Lyra Technology Group is a private equity-backed holding company that invests in and operates industry leading technology service businesses. Our companies are operated independently by exceptional management teams. Companies that join our group retain the employees, name, and culture that have made them successful. As a platform of Evergreen Services Group, we never divest from businesses we partner with and approach every decision with the goal of driving sustainable and healthy growth over the long term.

What sets Lyra apart are two things: our buy and hold strategy, and our company’s autonomous management. Unlike typical Private Equity investments with a three-to-five-year liquidation strategy, we buy businesses and invest in them for the long-term. We believe in the value of our acquisitions and want to grow. We bought our companies because they already had success in the marketplace. Instead of asking them to conform to a unified platform, we allow companies to keep their team, culture and branding in place.

We made our first acquisition at the beginning of 2018. Today, we hold a controlling stake in 120+ companies across the US, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. Our companies employ over 3,000 team members, each led by their own management team, and provide world-class support to over 12,000 clients.

The Role

• Own the business end to end: Set the vision and strategy, run the operating cadence, and answer for the company's overall performance.

• Build and/or optimize an organic growth engine: Build a repeatable growth engine: ideal client profile, pricing, sales and marketing motion, and retention.

• Manage P&L responsibility for a multi-million-dollar business: Own the full P&L, manage margin through delivery efficiency, and drive the budget and board reporting.

• Lead and develop a high-performing team: Develop people into bigger roles, and build a culture ambitious people want to stay in.

The Community

You will not do this alone. You will join a group of peer executives across our businesses who meet regularly, share what is working, and work through problems together. You will have access to shared resources across the platform, alongside direct support from the group's leadership on the decisions that matter most. Most CEOs tell us this supprt is the thing they underestimated going in.

Requirements

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, or related field. MBA a plus, not required.

• Operating track record: Proven ownership of revenue, margin, or delivery results, ideally in tech or services. MSP experience a strong plus.

• Financial Depth: Hands-on experience owning a P&L or managing a budget.

• People leadership: Track record building, developing, and, when needed, restructuring teams.

• Resourceful and hands-on: Comfortable working in the details of a small, lean business with no bench to lean on.

• Communication and client relationships: Confident with senior clients and skilled at translating technical realities into business terms.

• Data-driven mindset: Manages by KPIs and dashboards, comfortable working with imperfect data. Be specific: include metrics you owned or dashboards you built.

• SMB or senior leadership experience: Experience running or in senior leadership at a small or mid-sized business is a strong plus. So is a founder's mindset. If you've built something from scratch and know what it takes to make payroll, we want to hear about it.

This role is targeting a base compensation within the range of $200,000-$250,000 per year, plus bonus.

jobs.title: National Account Manager, Walmart
jobs.description:
National Account Manager — Walmart

Reports to: Director of Key Accounts, Mass
Department: Commercial
Compensation: $80,000 - $140,000 annual salary
Location: Remote, AR
Accounts: Walmart (Stores, Walmart.com, Walmart Marketplace)

Role Summary
We're looking for a Walmart-obsessed, data-driven, action-oriented National Account Manager to own the day-to-day of Walmart. You'll run the commercial drumbeat: forecasting, reporting, item and promo performance, Retail Link hygiene, and retail media briefing. You'll also shape feature and event planning, pitch growth opportunities, and support NPD launches. You'll be our resident expert on everything that makes Walmart tick, from category and competitor dynamics to the digital shelf and Marketplace. This role is highly collaborative, working hand in hand with Marketing, Influencer & Community, Operations, and Ecommerce to deliver 360° retailer support and bring Bubble to life in-store and online.

What You'll Deliver (Key Outcomes)

• Plan & Forecast Accuracy: Tight weekly and monthly LE, with risks and opportunities flagged early and quantified.

• Relentless Basics: Retail Link/Scintilla accuracy, item setup/PIM, PDP excellence, and flawless promo and price execution.

• Growth Moves: Identify, plan, and pitch features, space, and NPD opportunities backed by strong data and ROI.

• Category & Competitor Mastery: Know the Walmart shelf, the competitive set, and market trends better than anyone. Turn that knowledge into a point of view that wins line reviews.

• Digital Shelf Excellence: PDPs, onsite merchandising, and Marketplace run at peak efficiency, with digital treated as a core growth engine and not an afterthought.

• 360° Collaboration: Partner with Marketing to bring trade marketing and retailer activations to life, and share Walmart insight with Influencer & Community to sharpen their programs.

• Walmart Obsession: Deeply understand Walmart's priorities, tools, and rhythms. Anticipate buyer needs and deliver best-in-class execution.

Core Responsibilities

Account Ownership (Walmart)

• Manage the day-to-day business: item setup and maintenance, content/PDPs, price and promo execution, comp shops, and post-event readouts.

• Prepare and lead business plan meetings, line reviews, and weekly touchpoints. Build trust-based buyer relationships.

• Build and maintain Retail Link/Scintilla dashboards for sales, inventory, and supply health. Translate insights into clear actions.

• Strategic Growth Planning: Partner with the Director to shape and pitch feature and event plans, modular and secondary placements, and retail marketing opportunities.

• NPD & Launch Planning: Translate the innovation pipeline into Walmart-ready pitches that secure sell-in, feature support, and merchandising to maximize trial and repeat.

• Stay current on Walmart's corporate strategy, earnings, supplier communications, and event calendar (e.g., Deals events, Walmart+ Week, seasonal resets). Translate these into implications and opportunities for Bubble.

Category, Competitor & Market Intelligence

• Map and maintain current and historical Walmart planograms and modulars across resets. Track space shifts, new entrants, delists, and competitor movement within the category.

• Deep dive Nielsen and other syndicated data to understand Walmart performance against the total market. This covers share, velocity, distribution, pricing gaps, and promo effectiveness by segment and SKU.

• Monitor competitor activity at Walmart, including pricing, rollbacks and promo cadence, NPD, features and secondary placements, retail media presence, and PDP and content quality.

• Run regular in-store and Walmart.com comp shops and document findings with clear "so whats" for Bubble.

• Build a quarterly category point of view that feeds line review strategy, space asks, and assortment recommendations.

Trade Marketing & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Marketing to ideate and execute trade marketing programs that connect retailer activations with social, digital, and community touchpoints.

• Support pitch development for 360° activations, so Walmart receives integrated programs that go beyond the aisle.

• Act as the daily connective tissue between Commercial and Marketing teams, keeping calendars, briefs, and measurement aligned.

Creator & Community Insights

• Serve as the Walmart subject matter expert for the Influencer & Community team. Share what you see in Walmart data and on Walmart.com, such as which products, events, and moments are driving sales, so the team can make smarter creator decisions.

• Flag Walmart-specific opportunities to the team, such as upcoming events or retailer creator programs. The Influencer & Community team owns creator selection, briefing, and execution. This role is about sharing insight, not running creator programs.

Ecommerce, Marketplace & Retail Media

• Co-lead Walmart.com strategy with Marketing and Digital. Own execution excellence across PDPs, images, copy, rich content, and SEO.

• Continuously optimize PDPs for conversion. Run regular content audits, monitor listing quality score, ratings and reviews, search rank, and add-to-cart rates, then fix gaps quickly.

• Own briefs for homepage, brand shop, and onsite merchandising updates, then manage execution on the retailer site from brief through QA and go-live.

• Manage day-to-day Walmart Marketplace operations, including listings, pricing, inventory, fulfillment (incl. WFS where applicable), and seller performance metrics.

• Support development of Walmart Marketplace strategy with the Director and Ecommerce team. Identify assortment, bundle, and fulfillment opportunities that complement the 1P business.

• Brief and QA Walmart Connect campaigns (search, display, SV/SB when available). Track ROAS, share of search, and conversion.

Forecasting, Supply & Risk Management

• Partner with Sales Planning and Ops on stock and sales plans. Monitor OTIF, constraints, and E&O, and recommend mitigations.

• Track item productivity, rate of sale, and door-level performance. Propose actions by SKU and mod.

Reporting & Insights

• Produce weekly performance packs covering sell-in vs sell-out, velocity, mix, and promo ROI. Escalate risks with data-backed options.

• Mine data to spot whitespace and defend shelf through new doors, secondary space, pack and price tests, and kits/bundles.

Qualifications

• Experience: 6+ years in beauty/personal care account management with proven Walmart ownership. No marketing or influencer background required.

• Tools: Retail Link, Walmart Connect fundamentals, and strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (INDEX/MATCH, PIVOTs), plus data storytelling. Hands-on experience with Nielsen or other syndicated data and Walmart Seller Center/Marketplace.

• Execution: Demonstrated strength in forecasting, PIM/item setup, PDP/content management, and promo operations.

• Analytical Curiosity: Experience mapping planograms and building category and competitor analyses that shape retailer strategy.

• Strategic Skills: Able to build compelling growth stories for features, space, NPD, and trade marketing, and to translate insights into buyer-ready pitches.

• Collaboration: Strong partnership mindset. Comfortable working daily with Marketing, Influencer & Community, Ops/Supply, and Ecommerce.

• Mindset: Walmart obsessed, proactive, detail-obsessed, and calm under pressure. Turns analysis into action with speed and is energized by knowing everything that makes Walmart tick.

Primary Evaluation Metrics
Forecast Accuracy, Retail Sales/Net Sales, Item Productivity (ROS/UPD), OTIF & In-Stock %, Promo ROI, Share of Search/.com Conversion, Category Share at Walmart, PDP/Listing Quality Score, Marketplace Sales & Seller Performance, Buyer Relationship Health (Walmart), Trade Marketing Activation ROI

jobs.title: Paralegal
jobs.description:
#MaesaMagic

The next-gen beauty company, Maesa is transforming the industry by incubating and growing meaningful, innovative brands and making prestige beauty accessible. Maesa believes beauty ignites inspiration, creativity, imagination, and connection—sparking new ideas and possibilities and meeting unmet consumer needs. Through best-in-class design, formulation, brand creation, and marketing capabilities, Maesa delivers new, better, and different products with unsurpassed speed to market. Maesa works with a variety of retailers to create and launch brands across beauty and wellness categories. Our portfolio includes Kristin Ess, Hairitage by Mindy McKnight, Fine’ry, Being Frenshe, and Niches & Nooks, among other brands.

POSITION OVERVIEW

This role supports Maesa’s Legal team, with primary responsibility for global trademark portfolio administration and meaningful support for general corporate and commercial matters. The ideal candidate brings substantial hands-on trademark experience, strong transactional paralegal skills, excellent judgment, and the ability to independently manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.

Per the Maesa hybrid policy, this role mandates the minimum of three (3) days in the NYC office.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Trademark

• Manage and maintain the global trademark portfolio, including filings, office action deadlines, renewals, and post-registration maintenance filings in the U.S. and internationally.

• Conduct preliminary trademark clearance searches, including federal, state, domain name, marketplace, and common-law searches, and prepare concise written summaries for attorney review.

• Support product and brand naming initiatives by tracking proposed names, coordinating clearance timelines, organizing search results, and communicating status and deadlines to internal stakeholders.

• Maintain the trademark docket and accurate portfolio records.

• Coordinate with outside and foreign counsel on prosecution, oppositions, and enforcement matters.

• Prepare and coordinate trademark filings and supporting documentation, including gathering specimens and evidence of use.

• Review trademark watch notices and online marketplace activity; escalate potential conflicts or infringement; and assist with takedown requests, cease-and-desist letters, and enforcement files.

• Maintain organized electronic files for trademark searches, opinions, prosecution records, correspondence, and evidence of use.

Corporate and Commercial Support

• Draft, review, and revise routine nondisclosure agreements using approved templates and playbooks, and identify nonstandard terms for attorney review.

jobs.description:
Overview

Esri is seeking an experienced FP&A professional to serve as a finance business partner to our Marketing divisions. In this role, you will work directly with Marketing leaders and operational stakeholders to connect business plans, resource decisions, and Marketing investments to their financial impact.

The successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of Marketing priorities, evaluate financial performance, and provide actionable financial guidance. This requires moving beyond reporting what happened, to explaining why results changed, anticipating future financial implications, and helping business partners align investments and resource decisions with strategic priorities.

This is a relationship-driven corporate finance role for someone who is comfortable working with non-financial leaders, asking thoughtful questions, and translating complex financial information into practical recommendations. Success in this role is measured by the ability to translate financial insight into clear recommendations, influence business decisions, and drive better financial outcomes.

Join our collaborative FP&A team onsite at our campus in Redlands, California.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a primary FP&A partner to assigned Marketing teams, developing a strong understanding of their strategies, activities, business and financial drivers, and decision needs

• Translate Marketing operating plans, programs, staffing assumptions, and investment priorities into budgets and financial forecasts

• Develop financial models and scenario analyses to evaluate investments, resource decisions, business assumptions, and alternative courses of action

• Analyze performance against plan, identifying the operational drivers behind material variances and changes in outlook

• Identify emerging financial risks and opportunities and partner with stakeholders to evaluate appropriate actions

• Facilitate recurring financial reviews with Marketing stakeholders, clearly communicating performance, outlook, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions

• Provide financial guidance and constructive challenge, testing business assumptions and helping stakeholders evaluate whether proposed spending and investments deliver sufficient business value

• Prepare executive-level reports and presentations that translate detailed financial analysis into concise conclusions and actionable recommendations

• Build trusted relationships across Marketing, Accounting, and Finance to support coordinated planning and informed decision-making

• Improve the quality and efficiency of planning, reporting, and financial decision-support processes through standardization, simplification, and automation

Requirements

• 5+ years of progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), corporate finance, or a closely related financial role, including direct responsibility for budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, performance-to-plan analysis, and business partnership with non-financial stakeholders

• Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret business needs and connect financial outcomes to operational drivers

• Demonstrated experience partnering with non‑financial stakeholders, building trusted relationships, and influencing decisions through financial insights

• Excellent interpersonal skills including diplomacy, negotiation, reasoning, problem-solving, and influence

• Skilled at developing and presenting executive-level communications and data visualizations that translate business needs and financial analysis into clear, actionable insights

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and handle sensitive financial information

• Ability to develop strong interdepartmental and cross-functional working relationships

• Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling and data analysis

• Visa sponsorship is not available for this posting. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration with a finance or accounting concentration, or a related field

Recommended Qualifications

• Experience supporting Marketing or another commercial function in an FP&A capacity

• Experience with enterprise budgeting, forecasting, and planning processes and tools

• Experience working with SAP

• Experience using BI and financial-reporting tools to support management reporting and financial decisions

• Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases

• MBA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent advanced analytical or business training preferred

• Helps identify ES&H stakeholders and resolve their concerns.
• Participates in meetings, as required, with customers, project team members, and contractors/subcontractors to advise them of industrial hygiene requirements.
• Conducts inspections, sampling, and monitoring to help evaluate ES&H performance, identify the need for corrective actions, and confirm compliance with contract, regulatory, project, and Bechtel ES&H requirements.
• Assists in tracking ES&H performance and trends, prepares reports, and enters data in Bechtel's Industrial Hygiene Records System.
• Supports other ES&H team members and tasks, inclusive of all ES&H disciplines.

Education and Experience Requirements:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science (BS) degree, or Master of Science (MS) degree, from an accredited university in Industrial Hygiene, Occupational Health, or a related scientific field.
• Excellent technical writing and oral communication skills.
• Knowledge and experience with industrial hygiene monitoring, risk assessment, and control methods.
• Computer skills for preparing presentations, data management, and report preparation.
• Analytical skills related to sampling, monitoring, and recordkeeping.
• Experience teaching and training others.

Required Knowledge and Skills:

• Ability to research and comprehend organizational and regulatory requirements.
• Knowledge of industrial hygiene principles, standards, regulations, instrumentation, and sampling methods.
• Knowledge of engineering control systems, administrative controls, and personal protective equipment to mitigate hazards.
• Knowledge of ISO 45001 Management System standards.
• Adaptable and able to work outdoors in a field environment under various weather conditions.

Project Overview:

Louisiana LNG is located approximately 11 miles southwest of Lake Charles, Louisiana. The project includes a mid-scale, mixed-refrigerant Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) production and export facility on the west side of the Calcasieu River. There are five identical process plants. Each process plant consists of one gas pre-treatment unit, one condensate stabilization unit, and four Chart heavy hydrocarbon (HHC) removal and liquefaction groups. The facility will include associated utilities, refrigerant storage, three 235,000m3 full-containment LNG storage tanks, and three marine berths.

Job Summary:

The Commercial Specialist supports Commercial Management in the administration of the project's commercial management processes, helping to identify, assess, track, and report matters that may affect cost recovery, contract compliance, or commercial exposure. The role provides day-to-day support across commercial issue management, including subcontractor and supplier claims, owner claims, backcharges, Agreement Change Notices, trends, notices, entitlement issues, and other commercial matters.

Working across disciplines, the Commercial Specialist helps ensure issues are captured early, assigned to the appropriate owner, supported by the right documentation, and progressed toward resolution or escalation. The role maintains visibility of key risks, deadlines, and action items throughout the project lifecycle, and is expected to work with a degree of independence within the priorities and direction set by Commercial Management.  #LI-CS1

jobs.description:
Who we are

Picogrid is a leading venture-backed defense technology company founded to bridge the decades-long gap between modern technology and the critical demands of national security. Today, we're building the essential infrastructure to unify sensors, autonomy, and operators with our technology deployed in active operations around the world. Our mission is to deliver an operational advantage to secure the United States and its allies.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Picogrid is seeking a Strategic Finance Lead to build and own the financial operating system that supports our next stage of growth. This is a senior, hands-on role at the center of company planning, resource allocation, capital strategy, and business performance. You will partner directly with leadership to turn ambiguous business questions into rigorous financial models and clear recommendations.

We’re looking for a high-agency finance builder who can move fluidly between strategic thinking and detailed execution. You will own the company model, KPI reporting, board and investor materials, and ad hoc analyses that help leadership make sharper decisions about where to invest, how to scale, and how to allocate capital.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Support annual planning, quarterly reforecasting, monthly business reviews, and management reporting, creating the right level of process for a fast-moving startup.

 - Build KPI dashboards and reporting systems that give leadership a clear view of business performance, risks, opportunities, and operating priorities.

 - Business partner on resource allocation, production capacity, program economics, cost structure, and investment tradeoffs.

 - Prepare executive, board, investor, and fundraising materials, translating complex financial and operational inputs into concise, decision-ready narratives.

 - Drive strategic analyses on build-versus-buy decisions, working capital needs, hiring plans, capital expenditures, and long-range growth initiatives.

 - Improve finance systems, tools, and workflows, using automation and AI where useful to increase accuracy, speed, and leverage without overbuilding.

 - Operate as a trusted thought partner to leadership while remaining willing to roll up your sleeves, build models from scratch, and own the details.
   
   


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of progressive experience in strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, corporate development, or a similarly analytical finance role.

 - Exceptional financial modeling, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build clear models from scratch and translate them into practical business recommendations.

 - Strong business judgment and comfort making decisions with incomplete information in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

 - Experience partnering directly with executives and cross-functional leaders across technical, operational, and commercial teams.

 - High ownership, low ego, and a bias toward action, with the willingness to both set strategy and execute the details yourself.

 - Basic understanding of accounting, close processes, revenue recognition, and financial controls needed to connect planning with actual business performance.
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience in investment banking, consulting, private equity, or venture-backed operating finance is a plus.

 - Experience in aerospace & defense tech or another highly technical and operationally complex environment.

 - Experience hardware-enabled business models, including inventory, supply chain, production capacity, working capital, capital expenditures, and program-level profitability.

 - Experience building finance systems, dashboards, planning tools, or BI workflows using modern software, automation, SQL, or AI-enabled workflows.
   
   


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Base salary range: $160,000 - $200,000 per year plus performance incentive. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation package.

 - Significant stock options with a high potential upside as an early-stage company

 - 401(k) with employer matching

You will lead a team of AI Tutors (full-time employees and contractors) responsible for delivering high-quality training data and evaluations that power SpaceXAI’s models. You will set the standard for data quality on your projects, review work in the domain, ensure the accuracy and consistency of the data produced, and build operational excellence at the team level. jobs.title: Technical Enablement Team Lead
jobs.description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

As Technical Enablement Team Lead, you will lead the strategy, execution and continuous improvement of technical enablement programs that help Cato’s pre-sales organization confidently position, demonstrate and articulate the value of our platform.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is equally energized by developing people, building exceptional learning experiences and translating complex technology into practical field guidance. You will be part of a team of technical enablement professionals while partnering closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Revenue Enablement. This is an individual contributor role with functional leadership responsibility and no direct reports.

Your work will directly influence how quickly new team members become productive, how consistently our field teams represent Cato and how effectively they engage customers in technical conversations. Technical Enablement is central to building a confident, capable and consistent pre-sales organization. As Team Lead, you will shape the programs, content and coaching that help our Solutions Engineers move faster, deepen their technical expertise and deliver stronger customer experiences. You will help scale a technical enablement function that scales with Cato, equips the field for every stage of the customer journey and helps bring our vision for the cloud era of networking and security to life.

What You’ll Do

Lead Technical Enablement Strategy & Programs

• Contribute to the technical enablement strategy and roadmap for pre-sales teams, aligned to business priorities, field needs and Cato’s evolving platform

• Design, deliver and continuously improve onboarding, role-based learning paths and ongoing technical training

• Establish clear learning objectives, competency expectations and measures of readiness for Solutions Engineers

• Identify technical knowledge gaps, performance trends and enablement opportunities that improve field effectiveness

• Create scalable programs that support global growth while accounting for regional and segment-specific needs

• Measure program adoption, learner engagement, knowledge retention and business impact to guide continuous improvement

Develop High-Impact Technical Content

• Lead the creation and maintenance of technical enablement content including presentations, demo narratives, videos, labs, guides, internal documentation and facilitator materials

• Translate complex networking, security, cloud and SASE concepts into clear, practical guidance for customer-facing technical teams

• Ensure content accurately reflects current product capabilities, positioning, competitive context and pre-sales best practices

• Establish content standards, governance and refresh cycles that keep enablement materials relevant, accurate and easy to find

• Partner with Product Marketing and Revenue Enablement to connect technical depth with compelling customer value

Lead Through Influence & Enablement Excellence

• Lead technical enablement initiatives by setting clear priorities, defining ownership and driving execution across the organization

• Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter leader for technical enablement strategy, content and program design

• Model excellent program design, content creation and training delivery while remaining hands-on in key initiatives

• Partner with stakeholders across Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Sales and Marketing to align enablement efforts with field needs and business priorities

• Foster a collaborative, accountable and learner-centered culture across the technical enablement community

• Mentor and support technical enablement colleagues and field subject matter experts, helping strengthen facilitation skills, technical expertise and content quality

• Help shape the future capacity and operating model of the technical enablement function as the organization grows

Partner Across the Business

• Build trusted partnerships with Solutions Engineering leadership and field teams to ensure enablement reflects real customer conversations and sales motions

• Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate launches, roadmap changes and new capabilities into field-ready enablement

• Partner with Sales, Marketing and Revenue Enablement on integrated go-to-market initiatives

• Serve as a credible technical enablement leader in internal meetings, events and strategic programs

• Establish feedback loops that bring field insights back to product, messaging and enablement stakeholders

Enablement Platforms & Operations

• Own the effective use and evolution of technical enablement platforms, including the LMS, demo automation tools and centralized content hubs

• Ensure learning paths, technical content, reporting and user experiences are organized, current and scalable

• Use platform data and field feedback to improve content discoverability, learner adoption and program effectiveness

• Help define the operating rhythm, processes and standards that enable the team to deliver consistently at scale

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in technical enablement, sales engineering, technical training, solutions consulting or a related customer-facing technical role

• Experience leading complex initiatives, mentoring peers and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong technical foundation in networking, cybersecurity, cloud or SASE technologies

• Proven ability to develop and deliver technical learning programs for pre-sales or customer-facing technical audiences

• Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills with the ability to make complex concepts understandable and actionable

• Experience creating technical content across multiple formats, including presentations, labs, demo scripts, videos and documentation

• Strong program management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment

• A collaborative leadership style and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

• A data-informed approach to measuring enablement effectiveness and improving outcomes

• A growth mindset, high ownership and genuine passion for developing people

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

• Experience supporting global or distributed pre-sales organizations

• Experience with learning management systems, enablement platforms, demo automation tools or content management systems

• Experience building technical labs, demo environments or hands-on learning experiences

• Networking or security certifications such as CCNA, Security+ or equivalent

• Experience in cybersecurity, networking, cloud networking, SSE, SASE or adjacent markets

• Experience with change management, product launch enablement or technical certification programs

Cato provides a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits plan. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), stock options, Health Savings/Flexible Spending Accounts, flexible time-off, paid parental leave and disability benefits.

jobs.title: Director, Governance, Risk & Compliance
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Doppel is looking for a Director, Governance, Risk & Compliance to lead and scale our GRC function as the company grows. You will set the company-wide strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap for governance, risk, compliance, privacy, third-party risk, control assurance, and customer trust.

As the leader accountable for GRC at Doppel, you will ensure our security and compliance programs scale with the complexity of our business, customers, products, and regulatory environment. You will own the strategy for SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and future frameworks while building the systems, team, and governance structure required to operate them efficiently at scale.

You will serve as a strategic advisor to the CISO and executive leadership on enterprise risk and compliance, provide visibility into material risks and control posture, and represent Doppel with auditors, strategic customers, and other external stakeholders. You will partner closely with Security, Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, People, Finance, and Sales to embed effective risk management into how the company operates without creating unnecessary friction.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the GRC strategy: Define and execute Doppel's multi-year GRC strategy, operating model, and roadmap. Establish priorities, investment areas, tooling and automation strategy, KPIs, and governance mechanisms that allow the function to scale with the business.

 - Build and lead the GRC organization: Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing GRC team. Define organizational structure, roles, ownership, and career paths; hire and develop talent; establish clear accountability; and build future leaders as the function expands.

 - Own compliance and certification strategy: Maintain executive accountability for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and future frameworks required by the business. Establish the approach to audit readiness, management systems, control ownership, remediation, and external auditor relationships while ensuring the team can execute certification programs effectively.

 - Lead enterprise risk governance: Establish and evolve Doppel's enterprise and security risk management framework, including risk appetite, risk assessment methodology, escalation thresholds, risk acceptance, and executive review. Ensure material risks are clearly surfaced to senior leadership and that accountable owners drive remediation.

 - Scale control assurance and security governance: Set the strategy for Doppel's common control framework and continuous assurance program across ISO, SOC 2, NIST, privacy, and other regulatory or customer requirements. Establish governance for control testing, access risk, exceptions, corrective actions, and evidence quality while increasing automation and reducing manual compliance work.

 - Own third-party and emerging risk strategy: Establish the governance model for vendor, partner, and AI-related risk, including risk tiering, due diligence standards, contractual requirements, ongoing monitoring, and escalation. Ensure Doppel can adopt new technologies and vendors quickly while maintaining appropriate risk controls.

 - Lead customer trust strategy: Own the strategy and operating model for customer security and privacy assurance, including enterprise diligence, Trust Center content, security reviews, and RFP support. Serve as the senior security and risk counterpart for strategic customers and partner with Sales and Customer Success to reduce security-related friction in enterprise deals.

 - Shape privacy and AI governance: Partner with Legal, Product, Engineering, and Security to establish scalable privacy and responsible AI governance. Ensure programs such as privacy impact assessments, data governance, and ISO 42001 evolve alongside Doppel's products and emerging regulatory requirements.

 - Strengthen organizational resilience: Provide executive oversight of security governance related to incident preparedness, business continuity, disaster recovery, and other operational resilience programs. Ensure material findings and gaps have clear ownership and remediation plans.

 - Advise executives and the board: Deliver clear, decision-oriented reporting on enterprise risk, compliance posture, control effectiveness, third-party risk, and certification status. Translate technical and regulatory complexity into business impact and recommendations for senior leadership and the board.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of experience across GRC, security risk, compliance, security audit, or related disciplines, including significant experience leading teams and owning a GRC function or similarly broad program.

 - Experience building and scaling GRC programs and teams in a high-growth technology, SaaS, cybersecurity, or similarly complex environment.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior executives, translating security, compliance, and regulatory risk into clear business decisions and priorities.

 - Executive ownership of SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 through multiple certification and surveillance cycles, including program strategy, scoping, auditor management, remediation, and management review. Experience with ISO 27701, ISO 42001, or comparable privacy and AI governance programs is strongly preferred.

 - Deep understanding of management systems (ISMS/PIMS/AIMS), Trust Services Criteria, common control frameworks, control assurance, and evidence requirements within cloud-first environments.

 - Experience designing and operating enterprise risk management programs, including risk appetite, risk registers, governance forums, escalation, remediation, and formal risk acceptance.

 - Experience overseeing third-party risk, access governance, privacy, customer security assurance, and other core GRC programs at scale.

 - Track record building high-performing teams, developing talent, establishing clear ownership models, and determining how organizational structure should evolve as a company grows.

 - Experience developing GRC tooling and automation strategies that improve assurance while reducing manual work and operational friction.

 - Strong executive communication and influence skills, including experience presenting risk and compliance posture to executive leadership, boards, auditors, and enterprise customers.

 - Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, prioritize across competing business and risk requirements, and build durable systems in a rapidly scaling environment.

 - Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CIPP, or CIPM are a plus.


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Doppel's customers trust us to protect their brands, people, and data. As Doppel grows, the systems that demonstrate and govern that trust must scale with the company.

The Director of Governance, Risk & Compliance will build the organizational capability that enables Doppel to enter new markets, meet increasingly complex enterprise and regulatory requirements, and make informed decisions about risk without slowing the business down.

Your leadership will shape how Doppel approaches risk, compliance, privacy, customer trust, and responsible AI at scale. You will build the team and operating model behind these programs, give executives and the board clear visibility into material risk, and help ensure security and compliance remain an advantage as Doppel grows.




JOIN DOPPEL

Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective.



We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Client Delivery
jobs.description:
ABOUT GMR MARKETING

We are the Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity

NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL. EXPERIENCE.

The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.

NOT JUST TELLING. MAKING.

The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they’ll never forget.

NOT JUST CONSUMERS. HUMANS.

It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

As our Supervisor, Client Delivery, you will serve as a key leader supporting HPE's global events, hospitality, and executive engagement portfolio. Partnering closely with the Director, you will lead the planning and execution of complex, high-visibility programs that strengthen customer relationships and advance HPE's business objectives. Many of these initiatives are highly curated, white-glove experiences designed for C-suite executives, senior decision-makers, and key customers, requiring exceptional attention to detail, discretion, and executive presence.

You have a proven track record in corporate hospitality and event management, along with experience activating sponsorship and experiential assets. A proactive, self-directed leader who can confidently manage multiple programs with limited oversight while building strong relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders. To thrive in this role requires exceptional organization, sound judgment, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering premium experience and outstanding client service.

TEAM DESCRIPTION

At GMR, we immerse ourselves in our client’s brand and leverage our years of premier global event expertise (across the Olympic and Paralympic Games, FIFA Women’s World Cup and FIFA Men’s World Cup, the Super Bowl, Ryder Cup, Wimbledon, Formula 1 and more) to navigate complex and cluttered ecosystems developing best-in-class experiences and showcasing our clients in the best possible light. We create unique once-in-a-lifetime moments on a global stage for their key audiences, bringing fresh thinking and meticulous attention to detail to the table. The team works at a fast pace and in high pressure situations to deliver exceptional results. No detail is overlooked. We succeed together and are ready to lend a hand and support each other wherever needed.

REQUIRED SKILLS

• Multi-Program Portfolio Management: You have extensive experience planning and executing domestic and international corporate hospitality programs, ensuring seamless delivery across overlapping timelines. You’ll research, define, and pitch high-impact customer engagement and premium hosting recommendations tailored to client objectives.

• End-to-End Event Logistics: You’ll monitor global industry trends and B2B engagement strategies to continually elevate premium guest experience. You’ll direct comprehensive event lifecycle operations, including commercial sell-in, contract negotiations, hotel blocks, food and beverage, ground transportation, registration systems, gifting, uniforms, marketing collateral, signage, and guest itineraries.

• Client Management and Communication. You have exceptional interpersonal acumen with a proven ability to manage high-value client accounts and navigate corporate relationships effectively. You’ll maintain high-touch daily verbal and written communications with clients, producing sophisticated strategic documents and deliverables for executive presentations. You’ll draft executive-level internal and external communications, while optimizing the utilization and placement of high-value sponsorship assets.

• Program Management: You’re self-motivated, solutions-oriented leader who excels in fast-paced, fluid environments by rapidly mastering complex new systems. You’ll implement structured, scalable project execution workflows using detailed project plans and timelines, while establishing KPIs to evaluate post-event success and optimization areas.

• Fiscal Stewardship and Time Management: You’ll manage individual program budgets, tracking expenditures to drive efficiency and executing meticulous final spend reconciliations. You have superior time-management skills with a demonstrated capacity to manage multiple competing priorities, clients, and projects simultaneously.

• Collaboration. You are comfortable collaborating with multiple internal teams and external partners to deliver unforgettable experiences. You can build strong working relationships with clients, partner agencies, and internal teams to collaborate on the development and execution of client programs. You’ll orchestrate internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource groups, including creative, digital, procurement, finance, logistics, and global operations teams.

• Travel. You have full authorization and readiness to travel internationally for site inspections and extended onsite execution periods of up to 90 days.

The annual range for this role varies between $70,000- $80,000 and may vary depending on the candidate’s experience. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401k, employee stock purchase plan, vacation, personal days and paid holiday time. You are also eligible to participate in disability, life insurance, FSA/HSA plans subject to the terms and conditions of such benefit plans.

IMPACT & INCLUSION

Our workplace is for ALL. We foster a culture where every background and perspective is valued so we can create meaningful memories that resonate with everyone. We aim to cultivate belonging by meeting people where they are, removing obstacles, and building on their strengths to unlock their fullest contributions. We are committed to recognizing, nurturing, and unleashing the potential in every individual on our team. Together, we're creating something powerful with purpose and impact.

Our guiding principles can be found here.

To view our compliance policies, please go to the main menu on our site GMR Marketing: Experience Marketing Agency.

Location: Open to NYC, SF Bay Area, or Seattle candidates (Hybrid - 3 days onsite)

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to help grow Sia’s Legal AI & Technology practice and lead transformation programs for corporate legal departments and law firms. You will advise legal leaders, shape technology decisions, and lead multidisciplinary teams from opportunity assessment through implementation and adoption.

The role combines client delivery, business development, and practice leadership. You will work closely with Sia’s legal operations, AI, data, and engineering specialists to improve legal service delivery, reduce manual work, and build capabilities clients can sustain.

Key responsibilities

Advise legal leaders and shape transformation programs

• Partner with General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations, and technology leaders to assess workflows, systems, data, and organizational readiness for AI.
• Develop business cases, prioritized use cases, technology roadmaps, and operating models, including Legal AI Centers of Excellence.
• Shape initiatives across contracting, legal intake and triage, knowledge management, matter and spend management, litigation support, and legal reporting.

Lead legal AI and technology delivery

• Lead client engagements across workstreams, owning scope, staffing, budgets, delivery quality, and executive communications.
• Guide build-versus-buy decisions, vendor assessments, pilots, and implementation of legal AI platforms, contract lifecycle management systems, and custom AI agents.
• Translate legal requirements into workflows, product backlogs, contract playbooks, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, and deployment with technical teams.
• Establish evaluation methods with legal reviewers to assess accuracy, completeness, source reliability, and business usefulness. Address confidentiality, privilege, access controls, and human oversight in solution design.

Drive adoption and demonstrate value

• Lead practical workshops, training, and change programs that help lawyers and legal operations teams use AI effectively in their daily work.
• Track adoption, quality, turnaround times, capacity gains, and cost savings. Use feedback and performance data to improve solutions and establish ongoing ownership and support.

Grow the practice and develop client relationships

• Identify and qualify opportunities, expand existing accounts, and lead discovery sessions, proposals, statements of work, and pricing with Sia leadership.
• Develop offerings, demonstrations, reusable delivery methods, and client credentials that turn project experience into repeatable services.
• Build relationships with legal technology providers and collaborate across Sia’s international teams. Contribute to campaigns, thought leadership, and industry events.

Build and lead teams

• Coach consultants and managers, oversee work quality, support recruitment, and develop the team’s legal technology and applied AI capabilities.
• Coordinate internal initiatives across legal operations and technical specialists, with clear priorities, owners, and deliverables.

• 8+ years of relevant experience in consulting, legal operations, legal technology, or technology transformation, including substantial work with legal departments or law firms.
• 3+ years leading teams or complex client programs, with accountability for delivery, senior stakeholder relationships, and team development.
• A track record of implementing legal technology or AI solutions through rollout and adoption, with measurable operational improvements.
• Strong understanding of legal workflows, particularly contracting and legal service delivery, and the ability to translate legal requirements into practical technology solutions.
• Practical experience evaluating and using generative AI tools, designing workflows, and assessing outputs. Working knowledge of AI agents, retrieval from enterprise knowledge sources, and integration considerations.
• Experience developing proposals, scoping engagements, and contributing to account growth or new business.
• Strong workshop facilitation, executive communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect legal, business, and technical teams.
• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience. A law degree is welcome but not required.

Preferred experience

• Experience with platforms such as Harvey, Ivo, Legora, or enterprise CLM solutions, alongside general-purpose AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot.
• Experience developing contract playbooks, legal knowledge repositories, AI evaluation frameworks, or Legal AI governance and operating models.
• Ability to prototype workflows using low-code tools or code, and familiarity with APIs, data models, and enterprise systems.
• An established network in legal operations or legal technology, and experience building offerings or participating in communities such as CLOC or ACC.

Why join Sia

Help shape a growing Legal AI & Technology practice, work directly with legal leaders on implementation and adoption, and collaborate with consulting, data, and engineering teams to bring new solutions to market.

Compensation & Benefits

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

• Base Salary: $180,000 - $210,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.

• Annual Performance Bonus
• Personal Sales Bonus (uncapped)

Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

• College savings and student loan repayment programs

• Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday

• Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Workplace

Our Commitment
