Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

jobs.title: Director, Client Delivery
jobs.description:
ABOUT GMR MARKETING

We are the Experience Agency Making Unforgettable Stories Born of Humanity

NOT JUST EXPERIENTIAL. EXPERIENCE.

The lines have blurred. People live in the physical, digital, and social worlds all at once, and your brand experiences should do the same.

NOT JUST TELLING. MAKING.

The best stories are lived, not heard. Make an immersive world for people to explore so they can experience something they’ll never forget.

NOT JUST CONSUMERS. HUMANS.

It all starts with the human. If you want to make a lasting impact, look beyond the wallet to understand what motivates and inspires people.

As our Director, Client Delivery, you will lead the delivery of Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s (HPE) global events and hospitality portfolio, serving as a strategic advisor to the client and providing end-to-end ownership of complex, high-visibility programs. You will be responsible for guiding initiatives from strategy and planning through execution, ensuring every experience aligns with HPE's business objectives and reflects the highest standards of operational excellence.

In addition to driving program success, you will cultivate team growth, mentor direct reports, and lead cross-functional teams throughout the execution journey. By partnering closely with GMR's network of subject matter experts, you will champion internal alignment, innovation, and collaboration to deliver exceptional results for one of the agency's most important client relationships.

TEAM DESCRIPTION

At GMR, we immerse ourselves in our client’s brand and leverage our years of premier global event expertise (across the Olympic and Paralympic Games, FIFA Women’s World Cup and FIFA Men’s World Cup, the Super Bowl, Ryder Cup, Wimbledon, Formula 1 and more) to navigate complex and cluttered ecosystems developing best-in-class experiences and showcasing our clients in the best possible light. We create unique once-in-a-lifetime moments on a global stage for their key audiences, bringing fresh thinking and meticulous attention to detail to the table. The team works at a fast pace and in high pressure situations to deliver exceptional results. No detail is overlooked. We succeed together and are ready to lend a hand and support each other wherever needed.

REQUIRED SKILLS

• End-to-End Hospitality Management: You have a proven track record in B2B corporate hospitality and global event management. You’ll direct the strategic planning and flawless execution of global hospitality programs, managing end-to-end logistics including itineraries, accommodations, international transport, ticketing, and accreditation. You’ll cultivate and manage key global vendor partnerships, negotiating contracts and enforcing rigorous quality-assurance benchmarks.

• Guest Experience & Logistics Experience: You’ll oversee guest registration, VIP communications, food and beverage operations, curated cultural itineraries, customized gifting programs, and onsite staffing. You’ll manage complex, multi-currency program budgets, driving financial accuracy across Statements of Work (SOWs), invoicing, tracking, and final reconciliation

• Executive Client Leadership: You’ll serve as the primary partner for senior-level clients, leading status meetings and delivering high-impact executive presentations. You have exceptional interpersonal capabilities with a demonstrated ability to advise, manage, and retain high-value clients.

• Team Leadership & Talent Development: You have demonstrated success leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams. You have the proven ability to foster strong team culture, provide effective coaching and feedback, and support employees' professional growth while maintaining exceptional client service standards. You will lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing account team by fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous growth. You’ll provide ongoing coaching, career development guidance, and performance feedback while creating an inclusive, supportive environment where team members feel empowered, valued, and positioned for long-term success.

• Self-Starter. You’re self-motivated, solutions-oriented leader who excels in fast-paced, fluid environments by rapidly mastering complex new systems.

• Operational Excellence. You’ll maintain deep mastery of client brand ecosystems, sponsorship integrations, and emerging VIP hospitality trends to continually innovate the guest experience. You’ll implement standardized, scalable execution frameworks, utilizing advanced project plans, detailed timelines, and structured administrative tracking.

• Collaboration. You are comfortable collaborating with multiple internal teams and external partners to deliver unforgettable experiences. You can build strong working relationships with clients, partner agencies, and internal teams to collaborate on the development and execution of client programs. You’ll orchestrate internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource groups, including creative, digital, procurement, finance, logistics, and global operations teams.

• Travel. You have full authorization and readiness to travel internationally for site inspections and extended onsite execution periods of up to 90 days.

The annual range for this role varies between $90K- $110K and may vary depending on the candidate’s experience. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401k, employee stock purchase plan, vacation, personal days and paid holiday time. You are also eligible to participate in disability, life insurance, FSA/HSA plans subject to the terms and conditions of such benefit plans.

IMPACT & INCLUSION

Our workplace is for ALL. We foster a culture where every background and perspective is valued so we can create meaningful memories that resonate with everyone. We aim to cultivate belonging by meeting people where they are, removing obstacles, and building on their strengths to unlock their fullest contributions. We are committed to recognizing, nurturing, and unleashing the potential in every individual on our team. Together, we're creating something powerful with purpose and impact.

Our guiding principles can be found here.

To view our compliance policies, please go to the main menu on our site GMR Marketing: Experience Marketing Agency.

jobs.title: Director of Development, National Capital Region Chapter
jobs.description:
Job Title: Director of Development, National Capital Region Chapter

Department: Chapter Impact

Location: Remote/Virtual, within the DC Metro area

Reports to: Chapter Executive Director

Direct Reports: None

Classification: Exempt

Position type: Full-Time Employee

Anticipated Pay Range at Commencement of Employment: $87,000 - 120,000 per year

Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families is the largest nonprofit dedicated to making military life better for families. Each year, we support over 1.5 million military- and veteran-connected family members through a national network of 300,000+ members and local chapters in communities across the country.

Our mission is simple and bold: We make military life awesome for families.

We listen, share, partner, and act to deliver evidence-based, data-driven solutions that work for real people. We’re a lifestyle organization, a friend and neighbor, and a trusted partner. Our approach is collaborative, human-centered, and designed with the whole family in mind.

A Blue Star Family is one with an immediate family member — a spouse, parent, or child — actively serving in the U.S. Armed Forces, including the Guard and Reserves. These families face unique challenges: frequent relocations, deployments, career disruption, and isolation. We respond with research-informed programs that create connection, build resilience, and foster a true sense of belonging.

We serve with urgency but build trust over time — because change happens at the speed of trust. Whether we’re driving spouse employment, supporting caregivers, or helping communities welcome military families, we strive for upstream solutions.

Who We’re Looking For:

• Bold thinkers. Fast movers. Smart collaborators. People who want to build, lead, and drive measurable change — and who care deeply about making an impact that matters.

What You’ll Do Here:

• Solve complex challenges with data, heart, and humility

• Build cross-sector partnerships that get things done

• Help military families feel at home wherever they live

If you're ready to work in a high-performance, mission-driven environment — and to make life better for those who serve — Blue Star Families is where you belong.

General Description

The Director, Development for the National Capital Region “Flagship” Chapter is responsible for assisting in  local fundraising efforts, cultivating donor relationships, and supporting the development of strategic partnerships to support the chapter’s financial sustainability and growth. This role partners closely with the Chapter Executive Director and the national Development team to align local fundraising strategies with Blue Star Families’ mission and organizational goals.

The Director will steward a portfolio of individual, corporate, and foundation donors and support grant writing and reporting in collaboration with the national team.

While this role is remote, periodic out-of-town, overnight travel is an essential function. In-person time is critical to how we work — enabling deep collaboration, team alignment, creative problem-solving, and a shared sense of purpose. Team members are expected to travel several times per year for offsites, planning sessions, and company-wide gatherings. These events are essential for contributing to team outcomes, building trust across the organization, and staying aligned in a distributed environment. Participation in these in-person gatherings is a required part of the role and integral to successful performance in our remote-first organization.

*The Director must reside in the local community the Chapter serves. Preference will be given to candidates who have resided in the designated Chapter community for a minimum of the past three years.

Key Job Functions

• Assist the Executive Director with the local fundraising strategy to meet or exceed chapter revenue goals.

• Meet or exceed an annual fundraising goal of at least $100,000.

• Build, qualify, and actively manage a portfolio of at least 30 new major gift prospects (distinct from existing pipelines), with responsibility for identifying, cultivating, and advancing these individuals through the full donor lifecycle toward solicitation and long-term engagement

• Cultivate, solicit, and steward relationships with individual donors, corporate sponsors, and foundations.

• Collaborate with the Executive Director and national Development team to identify and pursue funding opportunities aligned with chapter programs and goals.

• Collaborate with the Executive Director on donor recognition and ensure consistent, high-quality communication with funders and supporters.

• Support the development and execution of donor engagement events and activities.

• Maintain accurate donor records and activity tracking in CRM (e.g., Salesforce).

• Assist with grant proposal writing and reporting.

• Partner with local program staff to align fundraising with community impact.

• Represent Blue Star Families at Chapter sponsored events, community events, and networking opportunities to elevate the chapter’s visibility and mission.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Experience, Skills & Background

• 7+ years of relevant experience in fundraising for a nonprofit organization

• Demonstrated success in individual giving, corporate sponsorships, grant writing, and/or planning and executing major fundraising events.

• Strong relationship-building and communication skills.

• Self-starter with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

• Experience with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce).

• Local travel requirements required outside of your home office will be up to 40% or less depending on business needs.

• Ability to travel out of town overnight several times per year for staff offsites, planning retreats, and company-wide events. These gatherings are essential for connection, brainstorming, and staying strategically aligned across teams. Participation is required as a core part of the role.

• May be required to work nights, weekends, and holidays as necessary to carry out key job functions.

Desired Experience, Skills & Background

• Bachelor’s degree preferred

• Knowledge of the military family experience

• Familiarity with membership-driven organizations

• Demonstrated community involvement through social, civic, and/or political organizations

• Knowledge of the local philanthropic landscape and funding community

More About Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families empowers military and Veteran families to thrive by connecting them with their civilian neighbors — both people and organizations — to create strong communities of mutual support. We believe we're all stronger when we take care of one another.

Our groundbreaking research is raising the nation's awareness of the unique challenges of military family life. With the help of neighbors across the country, Blue Star Families is overcoming the isolation and alienation of frequent moves, deployments, and reduced support from the government. Our innovative programs are solving specific challenges for military families, including fighting economic insecurity with resources that foster spouse career development, creating family strength with rich family programming, and providing critical peer support for caregivers, whose numbers are only increasing.

Blue Star Families is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

EEO Policy

Blue Star Families is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Why Blue Star Families?

Virtual/remote nonprofit organization that moves with you (position specific)
Career growth opportunities
Excellent benefits (403(b) with matching, Flexible Spending, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Communications Allowance, and more)
Permanent Change of Station (PCS) Leave for Active Duty Military Spouses
On-the-job professional development training
Front-line opportunity to positively impact the military experience
Competitive salaries
Workplace flexibility

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Invoicing and Billing
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

We're looking for seasoned backend software engineers to join the teams behind Gusto's Invoicing and Billing platform — the billing platform that generates accurate invoices for our customers and integrates with our revenue and accounting systems.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll operate across the full lifecycle of Gusto’s commerce systems: shaping architecture early in the design process, improving and maintaining a high throughput transactional billing platform, building self-service internal features and APIs, and owning their performance long after launch. That means engineering the core commerce engine, enabling product teams to launch new products and Gusto to monetize its offering. Support new billing models for Gusto like multi-entity, multi-currency anniversary billing.

If you're drawn to work that combines technical craft with real-world impact — helping power the livelihoods of millions using Gusto products — join us!

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Design, build, and test Gusto core billing platform – usage jobs, subscriptions, orders, invoice generation, payments, reporting, accounting integrations.

• Mentor other engineers to help solve some of the hardest technical problems out there in very complex domains and at a large scale.

• Help scale one of the largest Ruby/Rails and Javascript/React applications in the world.

• Collaborate with our Product Engineering, Product Management, Data, and Design teams to understand customer pain points, come up with solutions, and then prototype, iterate, and launch daily.

• Build products that our customers genuinely love.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

• Successful applicants typically have 8+ years of software development experience.

• Passion for creating scalable, efficient platforms for users.

• Experience leveraging AI tools or systems to accelerate development, improve testing, and deliver new platform capabilities.

• Curiosity and experimentation with emerging AI frameworks, applying and sharing best practices to evaluate and scale AI use safely across teams

• Experience in building large high throughput distributed systems.

• Experience in the Commerce domain: invoicing, commerce, payment processing space revenue recognition.

• Experience owning multi-quarter projects that solve complex engineering problems and make measurable user impact at scale.

• Experience with large scale refactors, performance and reliability issues, and a strong sense of ownership over all aspects of your platform area.

• Ability to mentor engineers to maximize their performance and impact.

• Experience in, or interest working in, Ruby on Rails.

• Ability to effectively communicate across engineering teams and with business stakeholders.

Please note that travel to Gusto's office for onboarding is required for this position. If you have any questions regarding this requirement, please share with your recruiter.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $163,000–$204,000 in Denver & most remote locations, and $197,000–$247,000 for San Francisco & New York. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

jobs.title: Associate Approvals Manager
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

In the role of Associate Approvals Manager (Collectibles), you will report to the Director, Approvals.

We are considering applicants for the location of Dallas, Texas.

The Collectibles team at Crunchyroll is dedicated to bringing outstanding experiences, products, and game collaborations to anime fans around the world. In your role as Associate Approvals Manager, you will shepherd product, marketing, and event approvals from start to finish, working closely with our licensees and master rights holders in Japan to ensure all licensed goods adhere to prescribed guidelines, are processed in a timely manner, and meet all necessary quality standards. This role partners closely with external vendors across Europe and the Middle East; as a result, the primary working schedule is 6:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m.

Core Areas of Responsibility

• Manage end-to-end global approvals for product, packaging, marketing, and event materials across assigned titles, ensuring submissions align with brand guidelines, licensing requirements, and quality expectations.

• Serve as a day-to-day approvals partner to domestic and international stakeholders—including internal teams, licensees, vendors, and master rights holders.

• Develop, maintain, and socialize IP-specific style guides, usage guidelines, and reference materials that enable consistent, on-brand execution across licensed products and consumer-facing activations.

• Track, curate, and interpret approvals data—including submission volume, approval rates, turnaround times, and response speed—to identify trends and support process improvements.

• Curate artwork and creative assets by collecting, organizing, and maintaining approved materials; coordinate artwork requests and commissions as needed to support product development and marketing needs.

• Support additional approvals, licensing, and cross-functional projects as business priorities evolve.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

• 5+ years of professional work experience.

• 2 years of experience in product approvals, licensing, brand management, or a related function.

• Experience working with IPs.

• Experience working with international partners or vendors.

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly with Photoshop and Illustrator.

• Experience with product approvals software (i.e. MyMediaBox, Flowhaven)

• Experience working at an anime, entertainment, or gaming company.

• Able to lift and move materials weighing up to 30 lbs.

• Available to work a 6am-3pm schedule to support collaboration with international partners.

• (Nice to Have) French, German, and/or Japanese language skills

About the Team

The Collectibles Approvals team at Crunchyroll is made up of pop culture fans who love bringing brands to life through innovative products and experiences, retail and digital marketing activations, and gaming collaborations. In close partnership with the Consumer Products Sales team and internal Product Development teams, we carve the path to help launch products across all categories from home entertainment, toys and games, fashion, and home decor to experiences, digital games, and goods.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program

• Health care and dependent care FSA

• 401(k) plan, with employer match

• Employer paid commuter benefit

• Support program for new parents

• Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

• Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

• Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

• Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

• Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

The City of Fort Worth is one of the fastest growing large cities in the U.S. Our employees serve the needs of over 1,000,000 residents, promoting our values of exceptional customer experience, mutual respect, embracing our diversity, continuous improvement, ethical behavior, and accountability. 🌆

The City of Fort Worth Water Department’s Capital Delivery Division is seeking a detail-oriented Construction Inspector I to help ensure the quality and integrity of the City’s water and wastewater infrastructure. Working as part of a collaborative inspection team, the selected candidate will monitor construction activities and verify that contractors comply with approved plans, specifications, safety requirements, and City standards.

This position offers an opportunity to work in the field, support essential infrastructure projects, and directly contribute to reliable water and wastewater services for the Fort Worth community.

Minimum Qualifications:

• High School Diploma/GED

• Valid Class “C” driver’s license

• Possession of, or ability to obtain, within one (1) year of employment, a Class D Water Distribution certification from the State of Texas

• Must pass the City of Fort Worth Human Performance Evaluation (HPE) prior to job placement and a drug screen

Preferred Qualifications:

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook

• Availability to work overtime and respond to call-backs on weekdays, weekends, and holidays

• Completion of relevant Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) training courses

The Construction Inspector I job responsibilities include:

• Monitor assigned construction projects and maintain accurate daily records, including preparing partial and final contractor payment estimates

• Collect and deliver potable water samples to the laboratory for bacteriological testing to help ensure water quality and safety

• Collaborate with inspection team members by providing coverage and support across multiple construction projects

• Partner with in-house design and GIS staff to accurately document the locations of underground bends, valves, and other appurtenances during installation

Working Conditions and Physical Demand

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product, Security and Privacy
jobs.description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

We are seeking a Product Counsel to partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security, and Go-To-Market teams to ensure our products are designed, built, and delivered in compliance with applicable laws and aligned with our risk tolerance.

This role is embedded in the product lifecycle, from roadmap planning and feature design through launch, customer adoption, and ongoing iteration, and is critical to enabling fast, responsible innovation in a global, enterprise software environment.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Engineering Support

• Act as the primary legal partner for product and engineering teams across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid offerings.

• Advise on legal issues throughout the product development lifecycle, including feature design, data flows, APIs, integrations, and platform architecture.

• Review and help shape product requirements, specifications, and launch plans to proactively manage legal risk.

Open Source & Licensing

• Advise on open-source software (OSS) usage, contributions, and licensing models (e.g., GPL, AGPL, Apache, MIT, dual licensing).

• Support compliance with open-source obligations and guide product teams on inbound and outbound licensing strategies.

• Partner with engineering and security on OSS governance and tooling.

Privacy, Security & Data

• Provide guidance on privacy and data protection matters (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, global data transfer frameworks).

• Advise on product-embedded privacy features, security controls, and data-handling practices.

• Partner with Security, Trust, and Compliance teams on incident response, customer security inquiries, and audits.

Commercial & GTM Enablement

• Support product-led go-to-market initiatives.

• Help develop scalable legal frameworks that enable enterprise sales while supporting self-serve and cloud motions.

Regulatory & Risk Management

• Monitor emerging laws and regulations affecting enterprise software, AI, data, and cloud services, and translate them into practical guidance for product teams.

• Identify and assess legal risks associated with new technologies, features, and business models, and propose mitigation strategies.

• Contribute to internal policies, guidelines, and playbooks related to product development and delivery.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior product and engineering leaders.

• Educate and empower non-legal stakeholders through training and clear, pragmatic guidance.

• Help scale legal processes to support a fast-growing, global organization.

Qualifications

Required

• JD or equivalent law degree; licensed and in good standing in at least one jurisdiction.

• 10+ years of relevant legal experience, with a significant focus on product, technology, or commercial matters.

• Experience supporting enterprise software, cloud services, or developer-focused products.

• Strong working knowledge of: Software licensing and SaaS models Open-source licensing concepts Privacy and data protection frameworks

• Ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, actionable guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

• In-house experience at a B2B SaaS or open-source company.

• Familiarity with database technologies, developer platforms, or infrastructure software.

• Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, or regulated enterprise customers.

• Comfort working in a fast-paced, globally distributed organization.

What Success Looks Like

• Product teams view Legal as a strategic partner, not a blocker.

• Legal risks are identified early and addressed pragmatically, enabling faster launches.

• Clear, scalable legal frameworks support both enterprise sales and product-led growth.

• The company confidently navigates open-source, privacy, and regulatory complexity while continuing to innovate

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, AI Agents
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Salient builds AI agents for regulated financial services. Our agents automate loan servicing, compliance, collections, recovery, insurance claims, and disputes for banks, captives, and specialty lenders.

We are:

 - Backed by a16z and Y Combinator, with $75M raised in Series A funding

 - Cash flow positive and profitable, with mid eight figure ARR achieved in under two years

 - Already serving more than 20% of the auto lending industry

 - Processing millions of real customer calls and transactions every day

 - Fully deployed in production with major financial institutions

 - Actively expanding into new financial services segments

 - Building together in person in San Francisco

We are deeply integrated with our customers, own the full technology stack, and move quickly to bring modern AI into regulated industries where precision, reliability, and performance matter.


THE ROLE

We're hiring the Lead Product Manager for the agent product itself, omni-channel. You will own what the agent can do, how well it does it, and how quickly a new lender can get it live. This is the most important surface at the company, and today it's a set of very capable channels that needs to become one coherent product.



This is a hands-on role. You'll be listening to call recordings, sitting with servicing teams, writing specs an engineer respects, and defining what "good" means for an agent that talks to people about their money. You'll have the option to build a product team around you over time, but the first year is about your own judgment and throughput.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• The roadmap and strategy for the agent across voice, text, email, and chat — including the hard part: making a conversation that starts in one channel finish cleanly in another.

• Agent quality. You define the metrics — containment, resolution rate, escalation, handle time, CSAT, error and hallucination rates — build the evaluation loop, and move the numbers.

• The servicing workflow catalog. Turning payments, payoffs, hardship, collections, title, and insurance from bespoke deployments into configurable product.

• Time-to-live. Getting a new lender from signed to in-production faster every quarter.

• Guardrails and compliance posture in the product: disclosures, audit trails, human handoff thresholds, and the design decisions that keep us inside FDCPA, TCPA, UDAAP, and state servicing rules.

• The bar for discovery, specs, and instrumentation that the rest of the product org will inherit.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You've shipped LLM-powered products to real users — not demos. You can reason about prompting, evals, retrieval, tool use, and latency/cost tradeoffs, and you know where models break.

• You own outcomes, not artifacts. You move fast, decide with incomplete information, and are comfortable being the most accountable person in the room.

• You go to the source. You'll listen to hundreds of calls and sit with ops teams because that's where the real workflow lives.

• You're rigorous about measurement. You can tell a model problem from a product problem from a data problem.

• You hold your own with engineers. You can read a trace, debate an architecture decision, and write a spec that doesn't need translating.

• You have instincts for risk. You know how to design a system that's allowed to be wrong sometimes without that being catastrophic.

• You can say no to a large customer and keep the relationship.

• You write and present clearly enough to stand in front of a lender's risk committee.




NICE TO HAVE

• Voice, IVR, contact center, or conversational AI experience — telephony constraints, barge-in, latency budgets, transcription error, call QA.

• Background in lending, servicing, collections, or adjacent financial operations.

• Experience hiring or mentoring product managers.




WHY THIS ROLE

Most AI product roles are features bolted onto an existing business. This is the product. The agent is the company, the market is enormous and underserved, and the problems are genuinely hard — real-time voice, regulated conversations, and a quality bar set by people's mortgages and car payments. You'll have the scope to define how an entire industry talks to its customers.

At Salient, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace. Our team typically works around 60 hours per week, beginning at 8:00 AM, with four days spent collaborating in person at our San Francisco office.

We also offer a benefits package designed to support our full-time employees: medical, dental, and vision coverage, a generous 401(k), and catered lunches.

By applying, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.trysalient.com/legal/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Support Engineer - Veterinary HealthTech (Santo Domingo)
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRUELOGIC

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.




OUR CLIENT

We are a veterinary software company that helps practices enhance patient care, improve staff efficiency, and minimize burnout. We were founded in 2017 and are a mid-size company (50-100 people) that has used Elixir from the start. Our back-end runs fully in Elixir with our front-end in React, with GraphQL connecting the two.



JOB SUMMARY

The Support Engineer is an independent contractor who sits within the Platform organization and serves as a dedicated technical resource for the Customer Experience (CX) team. This role owns the resolution of technical tickets opened by CX, including customer onboarding and decommissioning workflows, data migrations, and a broad range of infrastructure and platform-level requests. The Support Engineer is not embedded in CX but works in close partnership with them, translating operational needs into reliable technical execution. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically skilled individual who enjoys working at the intersection of platform engineering and customer operations, and who can operate with a high degree of autonomy. The Support Engineer will gain deep exposure to the company's infrastructure and product ecosystem while directly impacting customer satisfaction and time-to-resolution. Due to the production access required for this role, a background check is a condition of engagement.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Customer Onboarding: Execute technical onboarding workflows for new Instinct customers, including environment provisioning, configuration, integration setup, and data imports to ensure a seamless go-live experience.

 - Decommissioning: Manage the technical offboarding of customers, including data exports, environment teardown, access revocation, and formal documentation of closure procedures.

 - Data Migrations: Perform structured data migrations between systems or environments—handling validation, transformation, and quality assurance checks to ensure absolute data integrity. Occasionally join live customer calls to address data validation questions directly with key stakeholders.

 - Technical Ticket Resolution: Own and lead the queue of technical tickets escalated by the CX team; triage, prioritize, and resolve complex issues outside CX's scope, including environment configuration, integration troubleshooting, bulk data updates, and platform-level issues.

 - CX Partnership: Partner closely with Customer Success Managers and Implementation Managers to understand the context behind incoming requests, set clear resolution timelines, and communicate technical outcomes in accessible, plain language.

 - Documentation: Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of processes, runbooks, and customer-specific configurations to drive repeatability and preserve institutional knowledge.

 - Process Improvement: Analyze patterns in recurring CX-submitted tickets to proactively develop tooling, automation, or updated documentation—reducing overall ticket volume and resolution times.

 - Adaptability: Adapt to and actively contribute to new tasks, priorities, or projects as organizational needs evolve.

 


QUALIFICATIONS AND JOB REQUIREMENTS

Must-Have (Required):

 - AWS: Hands-on ability to verify environment changes and execute smoke tests; practical familiarity with core services (e.g., RDS, S3, EC2, ECS) to independently validate that workflows have completed successfully.

 - Git / GitHub: Proficient in creating, reviewing, merging, and verifying pull requests within GitHub as an integral part of standard customer onboarding and offboarding workflows.

 - Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills; capable of leading customer calls with confidence, translating complex technical concepts into plain language for non-technical stakeholders, and drafting high-quality documentation.

 - Basic Security Hygiene: Solid foundational understanding of data privacy best practices, the principle of least-privilege access, and secure data handling protocols.

 - Ticketing Systems: Hands-on experience navigating support and helpdesk platforms such as Jira, Intercom, Front, or equivalent ticketing systems.

Nice-to-Have (A Plus):

 - Terraform: Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles to review, update, or provision infrastructure configurations.

 - Kubernetes: Basic understanding of container orchestration, pod management, and inspecting workloads within Kubernetes clusters.

 - Helm: Experience using Helm charts to deploy, upgrade, and manage Kubernetes applications and services.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

 - Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

 - Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

 - Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

 - Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.




WHY YOU’LL LIKE WORKING HERE

 - A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

 - Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

 - Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.



Apply now!

jobs.description:
About the Role

Descript helps creators and companies tell stories through video. The creative team ensures that our brand lives up to the ethos of our customers. We ship work that’s brave, creative, and a bit uncomfortable, pushing with conviction where human creativity matters.

As the Brand Design Lead, you will evolve the brand as you create for campaigns, web experiences, and events. You’ll move between big picture concepting, building brand systems, and designing with an expert level of craft. Reporting to the Director of Brand & Content, you will be trusted and supported to create daring work that reminds people of the joy of telling stories.

What You'll Do

• Set a high bar and execute work that exceeds it Evolve and extend the Descript brand to show up well in campaigns, web, and events Lead concept and design for launches and campaigns, from brief through delivery

• Build a brand system that scales Develop brand systems and toolkits that allow the work to scale in expected (and some unexpected) ways Enable product, marketing, and sales partners to create on-brand assets without relying on you

• Multiply your creative impact Use AI tools and processes to deliver scale without compromising quality Direct internal and external creative partners from illustrators to design engineers Mentor designers around you and be an ambassador for your craft around the company

What You Bring

• Minimum Qualifications 6+ years in brand design, in-house or agency Portfolio showcasing a range of both strategic thinking and executional craft across web, social, and paid channels Strong command of typography, color, and composition Evidence of building a brand system that scaled beyond your output Experience directing outside creative partners Fluency with AI tools to produce and scale work alongside a clear perspective of where not to use them

• Preferred Qualifications Brand work within a SaaS company (especially the creative software space) Motion, front-end dev, or illustration skills Experience creating generative brand tooling Comfort with being on camera and sharing your work publicly

Success In This Role

First 12 months:

• Our identity feels evolved because you challenged it, pushed it, and fought for something outside any project brief you were given

• You launched a brand campaign that did numbers in your ex-coworker group chat (hopefully for good, but that’s not guaranteed)

• Sure, the Descript website is more on brand and converts well, but there are also immersive moments you are genuinely proud of pulling off

• You regularly spend time with people around the company you never thought you’d be collaborating with

• You shipped something you weren’t proud of, picked yourself up and learned from it

• There’s some Descript merch around you that you actually want

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $185,000. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, level, and may vary from the amount above.

About Descript

Descript is building a simple, intuitive, fully-powered editing tool for video and audio — an editing tool built for the age of AI. We are a team of 150 and the backing of some of the world's greatest investors (OpenAI, Andreessen Horowitz, Redpoint Ventures, Spark Capital).

Descript is the special company that's in possession of both product market fit and the raw materials (passionate user community, great product, large market) for growth, but is still early enough that each new employee has a measurable influence on the direction of the company.

Benefits include a generous healthcare package, 401k matching program, catered lunches, and flexible vacation time. Our headquarters are located in the Mission District of San Francisco, CA. We're hiring for a mix of remote roles and hybrid roles.  For those who are remote, we have a handful of opportunities throughout the year for in person collaboration.  For our hybrid roles, we're flexible, and you're an adult—we don't expect or mandate that you're in the office every day. We do believe there are valuable and serendipitous moments of discovery and collaboration that come from working together in person.

Descript is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We believe in actively building a team rich in diverse backgrounds, experiences, and opinions to better allow our employees, products, and community to thrive.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

We’re seeking a Senior Solutions Consultant to partner with our Sales team in driving both new customer acquisition and long-term value realization. In this strategic pre-sales role, you’ll help prospects understand how Celigo serves as the foundation for their integration, automation, and digital transformation strategies.

As the technical counterpart in the sales cycle, you’ll lead discovery, design scalable solutions, and deliver high-impact demonstrations that drive confidence and clarity. You’ll also help prospects evaluate how intelligent and agentic automation can unlock new efficiencies beyond traditional integration logic. You'll be instrumental in landing new logos while laying the groundwork for expanded adoption across APIs, integrations, EDI, and data pipelines.

What would you do if hired?

• Lead technical discovery sessions and design scalable integration, automation, and API-led solutions aligned to customer needs

• Deliver high-impact product demonstrations and solution deep-dives tailored to both technical and business stakeholders

• Collaborate with Account Executives to shape winning strategies for new business and long-term account expansion

• Act as the voice of the customer, translating real-world use cases into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering

• Create and maintain sales enablement assets, including demo environments, reusable templates, and technical collateral

• Contribute to the development of standardized integration patterns and repeatable architectures that scale across use cases

• Help customers understand the evolving role of AI and agentic behavior within integration, including when and how to apply intelligent automation

• Operate with autonomy while collaborating cross-functionally to support a high-performing, customer-focused sales motion

Who are we looking for?

Skills & Abilities

• Strong communication skills with the ability to convey technical and business concepts to both IT and executive-level stakeholders

• Familiarity with business challenges in areas such as order orchestration, finance automation, inventory sync, or multi-channel commerce

• Understanding of how AI or intelligent automation can be applied in enterprise workflows, including practical limitations and guardrails

Education & Experience

• 5+ years of experience in pre-sales, solutions consulting, sales engineering, or enterprise software implementation

• Strong understanding of business systems such as ERP, CRM, eCommerce, WMS, and 3PL platforms

• Hands-on experience designing or deploying cloud integrations, APIs, or automation solutions

• Familiarity with integration and messaging protocols such as REST, SOAP, EDI (X12/EDIFACT), Webhooks, and FTP/SFTP

• Experience scoping and articulating solutions within complex sales cycles involving both technical and business stakeholders

• Experience supporting consultative SaaS sales cycles, ideally with a platform or integration-focused product

• Exposure to API management platforms, data pipeline architecture, or EDI/B2B integration workflows

• Experience developing standardized or repeatable solution architectures

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base salary between $145,000 and $170,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.

Celigo is proud to be

• Celigo is the #1 ranked iPaaS platform (G2, 8 quarters running)

• Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year

• Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management

• Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you'll experience

• Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency

• A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented

• Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field

• Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily

• Competitive compensation and benefits, including:

• Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)

• Wellness days and holidays to recharge

• Parental leave and a generous benefits package

• Monthly tech stipend

• Recognition and career development opportunities

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility

As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. We believe, unequivocally, that everyone deserves to be in a place where they feel welcome as they are. Learn more about Taking a Stand.

Celigo is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Expert Team Lead, Medicine
jobs.location: Palo Alto, CA; Asia; Australia; Canada; Europe; Remote International; Remote US; US
jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will lead a team of AI Tutors responsible for delivering high-quality training data and evaluations that power SpaceXAI’s models. You will set the standard for data quality on your projects, review work in the domain, ensure the accuracy and consistency of the data produced, and build operational excellence at the team level. This is a hands-on leadership role — you will both execute labeling/review work and continuously improve processes as we scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own end-to-end quality and delivery for assigned Human Data projects — personally reviewing work in the domain, ensuring accuracy, consistency, guideline adherence, and high-quality data production at scale.

• Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of AI Tutors, including conducting regular performance reviews, maintaining records, creating action plans, managing shadow sessions, and driving continuous improvement.

• Oversee and actively participate in labeling and reviewing tasks to maintain high standards and model best practices.

• Ensure strict guideline adherence, taxonomy management, and quality assurance processes.

• Drive efficiency by identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks, implementing process improvements, and tracking performance via KPI dashboards (e.g., quality metrics, throughput, send-back rates).

• Collaborate closely with Human Data Managers, fellow Team Leads, and Engineering to translate model needs into clear labeling strategies and requirements.

• Coach and develop talent while maintaining strong accountability and a high-performance culture; support disciplinary actions as needed.

• Document outcomes, suggest process iterations, and report project status, risks, and results.

• Act as the voice of your tutors while fostering strong collaboration across the broader Human Data organization.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 8 months or more of hands-on experience in data labeling, annotation, AI training/evaluation, content quality, or similar operational domains.

• Basic understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and how high-quality training data impacts model performance.

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in a clinical or medicine-adjacent field (e.g., medicine, nursing, public health, health administration, biomedical engineering), including graduate degrees such as MPH or MHA, or 5+ years of experience in lieu of a degree.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Previous people leadership experience.

• Medical Doctorate (MD, DO, MBBS, or equivalent physician qualification) or other completed clinical doctoral degrees (eg PharmD, DDS, certain PhDs).

• Residency or postgraduate clinical experience is a plus, as is familiarity with clinical data and workflows, including laboratory results, medical imaging, electronic health records (EHRs), and clinical documentation.

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong track record of reviewing domain work, ensuring data quality, and improving operational processes.

• Experience with performance management, coaching, training program development, and certification frameworks.

• Proficiency in data analysis and associated tools (SQL a plus); ability to use metrics and KPIs to drive continuous improvement.

• Experience managing mixed employment types (full-time employees and contractors) or distributed teams.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly and align stakeholders.

• Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as Notion, Axiom, JIRA, Linear, or equivalent.

• Strong organizational skills, high attention to detail, proactive problem-solving mindset, and focus on continuous improvement.

• Strategic thinking combined with strong hands-on execution.

• Passion for building high-performing teams and scaling high-quality Human Data operations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Candidates must be based in one of the following countries where SpaceXAI has a physical office; remote work is also possible - United States - Dubai - Ireland - United Kingdom - Ireland - Japan - India - Indonesia - South Korea - Philippines - Singapore

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US based candidates: $104,000 - $170,400 USD depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. Benefits vary based on employment type, location and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible U.S. based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRINC:

At BRINC, we are building the technology that will define the future of emergency response. As a vertically integrated U.S. drone technology company, BRINC designs and manufactures unmanned aircraft systems, autonomous drone stations, command-and-control software, and advanced autonomy for public safety. Today, BRINC deploys Drone as First Responder (DFR) networks that dispatch drones directly to 911 calls, providing real-time aerial intelligence before ground units arrive and helping first responders make faster, safer decisions. BRINC serves more than 1,000 public safety customers across all 50 states, is the sole drone supplier to Motorola Solutions, and has raised more than $280 million from leading strategic and technology investors, including Motorola Solutions, Index Ventures, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, and others. BRINC is recruiting exceptional engineers to build the next generation of autonomous emergency-response technology, including flight-critical firmware and advanced pilot-assistance capabilities.




ABOUT THIS ROLE:

BRINC is looking for a Human Resources Business Partner to help shape how we support, develop, and scale our people as the company grows. You’ll partner closely with leaders and employees across the organization, serving as a trusted advisor on everything from performance management and employee relations to organizational design, compensation, talent planning, and team effectiveness. This is not a traditional HRBP role where established processes and playbooks are already in place, you’ll help build them. We’re looking for someone who can balance strong judgment and sound people practices with the speed, pragmatism, and flexibility of a high-growth startup. You should be equally comfortable advising a senior leader through a complex people decision, coaching a manager through a difficult conversation, and rolling up your sleeves to create the process, framework, or solution the business needs. Above all, you’ll help us scale BRINC thoughtfully without losing the ownership, urgency, and mission-driven culture that makes us who we are.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Partner closely with employees, managers, and senior leaders to provide strategic HR guidance across employee relations, performance management, organizational effectiveness and other core people matters.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, team effectiveness, leadership development and people-related business decisions.

 - Coach and develop leaders at all levels, from frontline managers to senior executives, strengthening leadership capabilities and building high-performing teams across the U.S. and Canada.

 - Provide thoughtful, solutions-oriented guidance on employee relations matters, balancing employee experience, company values and business needs and applicable employment laws and regulations.

 - Lead and advise on performance management processes, including goal setting, performance concerns, development plans, promotions and other talent decisions.

 - Own and evolve the company’s compensation philosophy and career architecture, including job levels, career paths, pay ranges, promotion frameworks, and practices that support internal equity, market competitiveness, and employee growth.

 - Partner with leaders on organizational change and strategic people initiatives, translating business needs into practical HR programs and recommendations and supporting effective implementation.

 - Analyze workforce and employee data to identify trends, risks and opportunities related to retention, engagement, performance, organizational health and talent development.

 - Balance strategic partnership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, growing organization, proactively identifying opportunities to improve people practices and business outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
About Tensordyne:

Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications. Tensordyne is a well-funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Recruiter to help scale our organization as we build next-generation AI compute technology.

This is a hands-on, full-cycle recruiting role with broad ownership across ASIC, Hardware, Software, Operations, and SG&A, including highly specialized technical and leadership searches. The ideal candidate brings deep experience recruiting engineering talent—particularly within semiconductor, hardware, or AI infrastructure—while also being comfortable recruiting across business and operational functions.

You will partner directly with engineering leaders, executives, and functional hiring managers to translate business and technical requirements into effective recruiting strategies, build targeted talent pipelines, and deliver high-quality hires in a highly competitive market.

What You'll Do

• Own end-to-end recruiting across multiple functions, including:

• ASIC / Silicon Engineering

• Hardware Engineering

• Software & Systems Engineering

• SDK / Compiler Engineering

• Applications / Field Engineering

• Operations

• Sales & Business Development

• Product Management

• Finance, HR and other SG&A functions

• Technical and functional leadership

• Partner closely with hiring managers to define role requirements, distinguish must-have vs. nice-to-have qualifications, establish interview processes, and develop realistic search strategies.

• Build and execute sourcing strategies for highly specialized ASIC, hardware, software, AI infrastructure, and business talent.

• Proactively identify and engage passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications.

• Conduct talent mapping across semiconductor, AI infrastructure, hyperscale computing, networking, software, and adjacent technology companies.

• Conduct substantive recruiter screens covering technical or functional alignment, career motivations, compensation expectations, location requirements, and overall fit.

• Manage candidates through the recruiting lifecycle—from initial outreach through interviews, comp expectations, closing, and pre-onboarding.

• Partner with hiring teams to continuously calibrate candidate profiles based on funnel performance and market feedback.

• Develop recruiting strategies for both immediate openings and anticipated future workforce needs.

• Provide leadership with market intelligence regarding talent availability, compensation, competitor hiring activity, and candidate sentiment.

• Maintain a highly organized and data-driven approach while managing multiple concurrent searches.

• Deliver a high-quality candidate experience throughout the recruiting process.

What We're Looking For

• 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably within semiconductor, AI, high-performance computing, or another deeply electrical and computer engineering environment.

• Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple engineering disciplines, with particularly strong experience in ASIC, semiconductor, hardware, or silicon recruiting.

• Experience recruiting Software, Systems, Infrastructure, or related engineering talent.

• Ability to recruit beyond Engineering, including Operations, Sales, Product, Finance, HR, and other SG&A functions.

• Sufficient technical understanding to effectively recruit and screen candidates across areas such as ASIC Design, Design Verification, microarchitecture, hardware, systems software, AI infrastructure, and related disciplines.

• Demonstrated ability to recruit across levels—from early-career talent through Staff/Principal engineers, managers, directors, and executive-level positions.

• Strong passive sourcing, market-mapping, and competitive intelligence capabilities.

• Experience partnering directly with senior engineering managers.

• Ability to challenge or recalibrate hiring requirements constructively when market data indicates that the original profile is overly restrictive.

• Strong offer management and candidate-closing skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Highly organized, analytical, and comfortable managing a significant requisition portfolio in a fast-moving environment.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Experience recruiting within both high-growth startups and established technology companies would be particularly valuable. We are especially interested in candidates who understand how recruiting for an early-stage or scaling company differs from recruiting for a well-established brand.

The strongest candidates will have experience spanning several talent ecosystems—including semiconductor and silicon, AI infrastructure, software, enterprise technology, and go-to-market—and will be able to move comfortably between a highly specialized ASIC search and a business-critical Sales, Operations, Product, or Finance search.

What Success Looks Like

Success will be measured by more than the number of requisitions closed.

That means consistently producing high-quality and diverse candidate pipelines, improving recruiting velocity, identifying bottlenecks before they affect hiring plans, bringing market data into hiring decisions, and helping managers balance the ideal candidate profile against the realities of the available talent market.

The recruiter should also help us build rather than simply fill—developing pipelines for future hiring needs and identifying strong emerging talent that can grow with the organization.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

• Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

• Ethics and integrity always; Being open, honest, and respectful of everyone.

• Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.

• Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.

• Own it and get it done. Results matter!

• Make each person better together, than they would be as an individual.

• Embrace each others’ differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse team is better at tackling complex problems and coming up with innovative solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

A note to Recruitment Agencies: Please don’t reach out to Tensordyne employees or leaders about our roles -- we’ve got it covered. We don’t accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline and Instructions:

• Please submit your resume and cover letter by 5:00 pm EST October 9th, 2026

• Please answer the following prompt in your cover letter: Tell us about a policy or program that you played a role in changing, developing or creating from the original idea to the execution. Please include what you learned from that experience.

Under NPR’s Employee Code of Conduct, this employee will be considered an “Outward-Facing Employee”, and as such should (i) avoid public participation in political and partisan activities in order to protect NPR’s reputation and its ability to pursue its mission; and (ii) refrain from public statements or actions that might call into question NPR’s commitment to accuracy and fairness.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain a sophisticated political network across Capitol Hill and federal agencies, serving as a registered lobbyist; manage LDA compliance activities pertaining to ACPR.

• Proactively manage a dynamic advocacy strategy for ACPR federal initiatives in support of public radio stations.

• Track, analyze, and brief internal leadership on legislative, regulatory, and policy developments impacting ACPR’s federal strategy.

• Design and execute proactive engagement plans, including policy briefings, staff delegations, and advocacy days that support public radio station relationships with Capitol Hill.

• Regularly meet with Hill staff, including all Committees relevant to public radio, to educate them, utilizing all available communications means to keep them informed on relevant public radio updates.

• Conduct in-depth research on Members of Congress and executive branch officials to develop effective political and advocacy strategies.

• Research and track upcoming congressional hearings, monitor administrative policy announcements, and distribute notes to internal teams and coalition partners.

• Partner with the ACPR Sr. Manager for Communications & Engagement to develop and transmit ACPR advocacy materials, including hill blasts, factsheets, testimony, and blog posts.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

• 5-7 years experience in a government affairs or advocacy role

• Time spent working in Congress with an emphasis on the House of Representatives, or working on agriculture or Farm Bill issues

• Existing professional networks on the Hill, with an emphasis on the House of Representatives

• Experience navigating the federal appropriations process

• Experience with nonpartisan advocacy initiatives

• Proficient in the use of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Google suite products

Preferred Qualifications

• Willingness to work collaboratively with an evolving team

The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 3 days a week- Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.
