jobs.title: Software Engineer New Grad, Machine Learning Platform - Quora (Remote)
jobs.description:
[Quora is a privately held, "remote-first" company https://www.quora.com/q/quora/Remote-First-at-Quora. This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Canada or the United States. Please visit careers.quora.com/eligible-countries http://careers.quora.com/eligible-countries for details regarding employment eligibility by country.]




ABOUT QUORA:

Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:

 - Quora http://quora.com: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.

 - Poe https://poe.com/: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.

Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be working on our Quora product.




ABOUT THE TEAM AND ROLE:

Machine Learning is central to Quora's mission of growing the world's collective intelligence. We have 100+ Machine Learning models in production powering various product features. We use a variety of algorithms — everything from linear models to decision trees and deep neural networks. Our production models operate at a huge scale, serving hundreds of millions of people using Quora every month.

Our team owns Quora's ML platform and ranking infrastructure across four areas: serving reliability, ML engineer enablement and developer velocity, business impact, and cost efficiency. We want to empower all ML engineers at Quora to be as impactful as they can be in solving different ML problems at scale. 

As a Software Engineer (New Grad) on this team, you'll work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and GPU serving performance — and your work will have an enormous impact on Quora's long-term success.

No previous ML infrastructure experience is required for this role. You'll be joining a team of senior and staff engineers, learning this stack from the people who built it, with a dedicated mentor and strong technical guidance — and you'll be shipping to production in your first few weeks.

Stack: Python, Go, C++, PyTorch, Kubernetes/EKS, NVIDIA Triton, Ray, AWS

🚀 Excited to see our MLP team's amazing work in action? Check out some of the incredible projects they've completed below! 👇✨
- https://quoraengineering.quora.com/Migrating-from-x86-to-AWS-Graviton-A-Journey-in-Cost-Optimization-and-Performance

- https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/containers/quora-3x-faster-machine-learning-25-lower-costs-with-nvidia-triton-on-amazon-eks/

- https://quoraengineering.quora.com/Building-a-Service-Mesh-in-a-Hybrid-Environment

- https://quoraengineering.quora.com/Building-Embedding-Search-at-Quora

- https://quoraengineering.quora.com/Feature-Engineering-at-Quora-with-Alchemy




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Help build and maintain the core infrastructure that powers Quora's ML platform, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance

 - Build and improve the distributed systems that serve our ML models in production, from Large Recommendation Models (LRMs) to Large Language Models (LLMs)

 - Work on GPU model serving, optimizing latency, throughput, and cost to support larger and more capable models

 - Contribute to platform initiatives such as PyTorch-first standardization and ML ecosystem modernization

 - Improve ML developer velocity by building tooling that helps ML engineers develop, test, and deploy models more efficiently

 - Modernize our feature store so ML engineers can get new features into production faster

 - Participate in the team's on-call rotation, helping resolve production issues as you grow your knowledge and ownership of the platform




MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

 - Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's "coordination hours https://quora.com/coordination_hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)

 - A 2025 or 2026 graduate with or pursuing a B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

 - Genuine interest in large-scale distributed systems, infrastructure, and machine learning

 - Knowledge of Python, Go, or C++, or the ability to learn them quickly

 - A passion for learning and always improving yourself and the team around you




PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:

 - Previous software engineering experience via an internship, work experience, open-source contribution, or coding competition

 - Coursework or hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

 - Exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud technologies like AWS

 - Experience with low-level performance work of any kind: profiling, benchmarking, optimization

 - Passion for Quora's mission and goals

jobs.title: Community Manager - Contract
jobs.description:
Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project-based work.

Sia Title: Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)

Project Title: Community Manager

Project Length: This is a temporary position with an expected duration through 6/30/27, may extend

Project Hours: 40 hours per week

Rate: $75-95/hour

The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.

Location: Open to remote candidates

About the Role

Sia is partnering with one of the world's leading technology companies to help build the community around a next-generation consumer AI product at the frontier of artificial intelligence.

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a new community experience from the ground up, powered by cutting-edge AI and designed for people looking to get more out of life with the help of AI agents. The product is already generating real organic energy: users are showing up, experimenting, sharing what they create, and forming their own pockets of culture without much prompting. Now, the opportunity is to turn that momentum into a community that lasts, scales globally, and meaningfully influences where the product goes next.

You'll play a critical role in defining how people connect, collaborate, learn, and create value within an AI-enabled ecosystem with the potential to reach millions. You'll work at the intersection of AI, consumer technology, community, product, and culture, combining the creative freedom of building something new with the reach and resources of one of the world's largest technology companies.

We're looking for someone who thinks like both a strategist and a builder. Someone who is equally energized by understanding community behavior through data, designing engagement programs, testing new ideas, and leveraging AI to create smarter, more personalized community experiences.

This isn't just about managing a community. It's about helping define what community looks like for a new generation of AI products and creating a direct connection between some of the product's most engaged users and the teams building its future.

If you're passionate about emerging technology, human behavior, community growth, and creating experiences people genuinely love, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Own the Community Strategy

• Define what community means for an emerging AI product: who it's for, what members get out of it, and how it grows
• Build a home for the most engaged users that remains valuable, trusted, and well-run as the community scales
• Develop ambassador, advocate, and power-user programs that give highly engaged users a meaningful role in the community
• Design and test engagement programs that deepen participation, connection, and long-term community value
• Make it simple for members to run their own events and meetups through scalable programs and toolkits
• Partner closely with social, brand, and creative teams to bring what the community is creating to a broader audience
• Drive adoption in new markets through community-led outreach, adapting the approach as the product expands internationally
• Explore how AI can enable smarter, more personalized, and more scalable community experiences

Build the Growth Loop

• Partner with growth teams on referral and invite mechanics that feel organic to the community
• Identify creators, advocates, and early adopters producing compelling content and help them continue building
• Turn community participation into sustainable product advocacy, referrals, and organic growth
• Use community behavior, engagement data, and experimentation to understand what drives participation, retention, and advocacy
• Keep authentic user stories, use cases, and emerging behaviors flowing back to marketing and product teams
• Test new ideas quickly, learn from the results, and scale the programs that resonate most with members

Connect the Community to the Product

• Serve as the internal voice of the community, translating user behavior, feedback, emerging AI use cases, requests, and friction into insights Product and Engineering can act on quickly
• Identify how people are actually using and experimenting with the product, including behaviors and use cases the team may not have anticipated
• Build feedback loops between early adopters and the teams shaping the product roadmap
• Own community health metrics including activity, retention, sentiment, advocacy, and community-driven growth
• Combine qualitative feedback with participation and behavioral data to identify patterns, opportunities, and emerging needs
• Help ensure the path from product to community, and from community back to product, actually works

What You Bring

• 8+ years of experience across community, social, developer relations, creator programs, product advocacy, or related areas
• Experience supporting at least one consumer technology product at meaningful scale
• Demonstrated experience building an ambassador, advocate, creator, or superuser program from the ground up
• A builder mindset with experience taking community programs from idea to launch, testing what works, and iterating quickly
• Strong interest in artificial intelligence and how AI products are changing the way people create, communicate, and interact with technology
• Experience building community around an AI, generative AI, emerging technology, or highly technical product is strongly preferred
• Ideally, experience engaging early adopters or technically curious users around rapidly evolving products
• Experience scaling an online community beyond manual moderation through automation, community roles, governance, escalation paths, and scalable processes
• Strong analytical instincts and the ability to use community behavior, engagement data, and qualitative feedback to inform strategy
• Ability to translate community insights into clear, actionable recommendations for Product and Engineering
• Strong writing skills and a distinct, authentic voice. You understand internet culture, can read a room, and know how to communicate in a way that feels human rather than corporate
• Comfort operating in an early-stage environment where the product, community, and playbook are still evolving
• A track record of building trust as a core part of the community experience

Nice to Have

• Direct experience with AI, generative AI, AI-powered consumer products, AI agents, or emerging technology communities
• Experience launching or managing beta, early-access, or design-partner programs
• Experience working with highly engaged early adopters and translating their feedback into product insights
• Experience using AI, automation, or personalization to improve community engagement or operations
• Experience building community internationally
• Experience with creator-led or user-generated content ecosystems
• Experience working with a product built around a distinct character, identity, or persona

What Success Looks Like

• A thriving community that grows organically, where people initially show up for the AI product and stay for the community around it
• A community experience that helps people connect, collaborate, learn, and discover new ways to get value from AI
• A recognizable power-user or ambassador program that members genuinely want to join
• Early adopters and highly engaged users consistently influencing the product roadmap
• A steady flow of emerging AI use cases, user behaviors, and community insights reaching Product and Engineering
• Community programs that are continuously tested and improved using engagement data, member behavior, and feedback
• The most engaged users becoming some of the product's strongest advocates and sources of organic growth
• A scalable community model that can grow alongside the product as it reaches millions of users across new markets

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At Sia Partners, we are committed to treating all Applicants and Associates fairly based on their abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer - NQA-1 Program Development
jobs.description:
The Nuclear Company is the fastest growing AI tech-enabled startup in the nuclear and energy space, pioneering a fleet-scale approach to building the next generation of nuclear reactors. Through our design-once, build-many model, we're accelerating the deployment of safe, reliable, and affordable nuclear energy.

We operate with an AI-first mindset. Every employee is expected to leverage AI, technology, and the Nuclear Operating System (NOS) as integral components of their role to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We expect every team member to continuously identify opportunities to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NOS as a strategic operating capability that enables The Nuclear Company to scale with excellence.

We hire people who are driven by purpose, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building what has never been built before. Our team combines intellectual curiosity with high agency, embraces candid feedback and continuous learning, and holds themselves and others to exceptional standards. Our values—Transparency, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappy, and Tenacity—guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions every day. They are not words on a wall; they are the standard by which we operate. TRUST is the foundation of our safety culture, fostering intellectual honesty, accountability, and open communication, while our values challenge every team member to execute with urgency, humility, resilience, and an unwavering commitment to our mission.

About the role

The QA Engineer’s first assignment is to build out TNC’s NQA-1 quality program — writing the implementing procedures that every department, from Engineering and Procurement to Construction and Licensing, will work under. The engineer partners with each department’s subject-matter experts to draft these procedures, carries them through cross-functional review, and drives them to approval and issue on schedule. As the procedure set matures and field work begins, the role shifts to core quality engineering: reviewing inspection and test procedures, setting acceptance criteria from design requirements, and placing witness and hold points in inspection and test plans. The position reports to the Senior Manager of Quality, carries the independence the work demands — including stop-work authority and direct access to the CNO — and offers a mid-career engineer the chance to help write the quality program a fleet-scale nuclear company will run on.

Responsibilities

Key Areas: Cross-Functional NQA-1 Program Development (near-term focus); Inspection & Test Technical Basis; Codes & Standards; Conditions Adverse to Quality; Program Interfaces & Qualifications

• Generate the NQA-1 program cross-functionally — author and develop Tier-3 implementing procedures with every TNC department (Procurement & Supply Chain, PMO, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Construction Management, Nuclear Deployment, Testing & Start-Up, Training, and the corporate functions), translating each organization’s function scope into issued procedures through SME input, cross-functional review, and approval.

• Author or provide SME input to procedures, records, and technical documents in the assigned discipline.

• Review inspection and test procedures and acceptance criteria for nuclear systems and components; verify design outputs meet specified requirements.

• Identify inspection requirements and the applicable codes and standards, with references; extract acceptance criteria from design with quantitative limits, specific values, and tolerances.

• Set witness and hold points in inspection and test plans.

• Support the QAPD and parent-suite artifacts maintained audit-ready, and the phased QA plans for Services, BOO project development, and JV support.

• Identify and report conditions adverse to quality promptly through the CAP; feed procedure-production status and quality metrics into the QA metrics pack and the CNO performance-indicator set.

• Maintain personal qualifications, training, and certifications current.

Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline, or 10+ years field experience in the discipline.

• 3+ years working under ASME NQA-1 and/or 10 CFR 50 Appendix B programs, with demonstrated procedure development — has authored implementing procedures that survived review and implementation.

• Proficient in the applicable codes and standards for the assigned scope (e.g., ASME NQA-1; ASME Section III/V/IX, ACI 318, AISC 360, IEEE/ISA series as applicable).

• Strong technical writing and cross-functional coordination — can pull SME input from any department and drive a document through a multi-reviewer approval chain on schedule.

• Ability to qualify to governing TNC procedures.

Note: NQA-1 Lead Auditor certification is not required — audit execution is provided through a contracted, qualified audit service. Discipline depth (civil, mechanical, electrical, or NDE) shapes assigned scope as the role transitions to inspection and test engineering.

Preferred Experience

• Nuclear new-build, construction, or commissioning experience (AP1000, SMR/MMR, or other first-of-a-kind programs).

• Discipline depth in civil/structural, mechanical, electrical, or NDE with the associated code sets (ACI/AISC, ASME Section III/V/IX, IEEE/ISA, SNT-TC-1A / CP-189).

• ASQ CQE or CQA; auditor training or audit-team participation.

• Experience developing procedures in a startup or program build-out environment; EDMS and document-control workflow fluency.

• Familiarity with ISO 9001 / ISO 19443; metrics and dashboard tools (Excel, Power BI).

Benefits

• Competitive compensation packages

• 401k with company match

• Medical, dental, vision plans

• Generous vacation policy, plus holidays

Estimated Starting Salary Range
The estimated starting salary range for this role is $121,000 - $143,000 annually less applicable withholdings and deductions, paid on a bi-weekly basis. The actual salary offered may vary based on relevant factors as determined in the Company’s discretion, which may include experience, qualifications, tenure, skill set, availability of qualified candidates, geographic location, certifications held, and other criteria deemed pertinent to the particular role.

EEO Statement
The Nuclear Company is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an environment of inclusion in the workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We prohibit discrimination in all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, transfer, compensation, and termination.

Export Control
Certain positions at The Nuclear Company may involve access to information and technology subject to export controls under U.S. law. Compliance with these export controls may result in The Nuclear Company limiting its consideration of certain applicants.

Recruiting Fraud Alert
Your safety is our priority. We want to ensure your job search stays secure. Please note that the team at The Nuclear Company only communicates through official @thenuclearcompany.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive financial information at any stage of our recruitment process. For your peace of mind, please verify all openings and submit your applications directly through our official careers page.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Director, Head of Private Equity
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Partnerships at Brex:

The primary focus of the Partnerships team at Brex is to drive net new pipeline and revenue. We originate, launch, and scale partnerships across emerging distribution channels, embedded models, and other strategic bets that accelerate Brex's growth trajectory.

As Brex nears $1B in revenue, we are building a best-in-class Partnerships organization grounded in clear priorities and disciplined execution. Every member of our team directly contributes to top-line growth by expanding Brex's reach across key ecosystems, from technology platforms to financial sponsors who influence large customer networks.Within Business Development, the Private Equity Channel team is responsible for building partnerships with PE firms to drive new customer growth, generate pipeline, and increase engagement and monetization of existing customers.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do:

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work:

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:

• Hire, develop, and manage a team of Partner Managers across East Coast, West Coast, and emerging PE geographies, setting the bar for performance and career growth

• Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models

Requirements:

• 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.

• 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.

• Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.

• Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.

• Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.

• High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.

• Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.

• Self-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate with high autonomy while maintaining tight alignment with Partnerships leadership.

jobs.title: Deputy Chief Engineer, X-BAT
jobs.description:
Job Description
Are you an experienced aircraft-development leader looking to help build a new class of autonomous combat aircraft? Are you energized by technically difficult problems, rapid execution, and the opportunity to redefine airpower? Shield AI may be the place for you.
The Deputy Chief Engineer for X-BAT will report to the Air Vehicle Lead / Chief Engineer X-BAT and serve as their primary technical deputy across the design, development, integration, test, and maturation of the X-BAT air vehicle.
This individual will help maintain the technical integrity of the aircraft while driving day-to-day engineering execution across structures, aerodynamics, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, electrical systems, flight controls, software, autonomy integration, manufacturing, and flight test.
The ideal candidate combines broad aircraft technical depth with strong systems thinking, sound engineering judgment, and a demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through ambiguity. They must be comfortable moving between system-level decisions and detailed technical problem-solving while balancing performance, safety, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and mission requirements.
What You’ll Do
Serve as the primary technical deputy to the X-BAT Air Vehicle Lead, acting on their behalf when necessary and helping translate program objectives into clear engineering priorities.
Maintain the integrity of the air vehicle’s technical baseline, including system requirements, architecture, interfaces, configuration, performance, verification, and airworthiness evidence.
Lead the day-to-day integration of engineering activities across aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, electrical systems, flight controls, software, autonomy, manufacturing, and test.
Drive aircraft-level technical decisions and trade studies, ensuring decisions are grounded in first-principles analysis and consider downstream effects on performance, safety, cost, schedule, producibility, maintainability, and operations.
Establish and maintain a disciplined technical-risk process, ensuring risks are identified early, assigned accountable owners, supported by mitigation plans, and retired through analysis or test.
Lead major technical and design reviews, ensuring the aircraft is sufficiently mature to progress through fabrication, ground test, flight test, qualification, and production.
Partner with Program Management to align technical scope with schedule, budget, staffing, supplier, and customer commitments.
Work closely with Manufacturing and Supply Chain to ensure designs are producible, scalable, and supported by a resilient supplier base.
Partner with Test and Flight Operations to define verification strategies, ground- and flight-test objectives, instrumentation requirements, test readiness criteria, and issue-resolution plans.
Lead rapid root-cause investigations and corrective actions for complex aircraft-level problems identified during integration, ground test, flight test, production, or operations.
Ensure technical decisions and engineering changes are documented, communicated, and reflected in the controlled product baseline.
Develop the technical leadership capabilities of engineering managers, functional leads, integrated product team leads, and senior individual contributors.
Communicate aircraft status, technical risks, decision recommendations, and recovery plans clearly to program leadership, executives, customers, and external partners.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, urgency, ownership, intellectual honesty, and constructive challenge.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of progressive experience developing complex aircraft, military aerospace systems, autonomous aircraft, or similarly integrated aerospace products.
Demonstrated technical leadership on an aircraft-development program, preferably as a Chief Engineer, Deputy Chief Engineer, Air Vehicle Lead, Systems Engineering Lead, Integrated Product Team Lead, or equivalent.
Broad understanding of aircraft design and integration across multiple engineering disciplines, with the technical judgment to identify critical interfaces and system-level consequences.
Experience taking an aircraft or similarly complex aerospace system through multiple lifecycle stages, such as requirements development, preliminary and critical design, fabrication, integration, ground test, flight test, qualification, or production.
Experience establishing and managing system requirements, technical baselines, interface definitions, design reviews, verification plans, and engineering risks.
Demonstrated ability to make high-quality technical decisions with incomplete information and under aggressive program timelines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues and recommendations to executive and customer audiences.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams in a fast-paced development environment.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Engineering Management, or a related discipline.
Experience developing clean-sheet military aircraft, fighter aircraft, collaborative combat aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems, or advanced VTOL platforms.
Experience with propulsion integration, flight controls, vehicle management systems, autonomy integration, low-observable aircraft, or weapons and mission-systems integration.
Experience supporting aircraft ground test, envelope expansion, developmental flight test, airworthiness, and mishap-risk reduction.
Familiarity with military airworthiness frameworks, verification and validation processes, configuration management, and model-based systems engineering.
Experience transitioning an aircraft from rapid prototype development into qualification, rate production, and operational deployment.
Experience working directly with the Department of Defense, military service customers, external suppliers, and strategic industry partners.
Background in a high-growth aerospace organization where speed, individual ownership, and first-principles thinking were essential to program success.

jobs.title: Signage and Wayfinding Coordinator
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend are seeking an experienced Signage & Wayfinding Coordinator to support the delivery of the resort-wide signage and wayfinding program for a major hospitality and entertainment development in Las Vegas.

The role will be responsible for coordinating signage and wayfinding from design development through procurement, fabrication, installation, punch list and project closeout. The successful candidate will act as a key point of coordination between the Client, design consultants, contractors, signage vendors and operational stakeholders to ensure that signage packages are coordinated, approved and delivered in accordance with the project design intent, schedule, budget and operational requirements.

The role will include coordination of interior, exterior, site, wayfinding, operational, regulatory and specialty signage across the project.

Design and Coordination Services

• Coordinate the development and implementation of the project-wide signage and wayfinding program.
• Coordinate signage design requirements with architectural, interior design, landscape, lighting, AV/technology and other relevant design disciplines.
• Coordinate sign location plans, message schedules, sign type schedules and other signage design documentation.
• Manage signage reviews and stakeholder approvals, including coordination with Owner representatives and operational stakeholders.
• Review signage packages for consistency with project standards, approved design intent and operational requirements.
• Identify signage scope gaps, overlaps and interface issues between design consultants, contractors and vendors.
• Coordinate signage requirements across public areas, back-of-house areas, exterior/site areas and other project spaces.
• Support coordination of code-required, life-safety and accessibility signage with the appropriate design and construction teams.
• Track design decisions, comments, approvals and outstanding information required to maintain progress.
• Participate in design coordination meetings and signage-specific workshops as required.

Procurement and Fabrication

• Support the development and coordination of signage procurement packages and scopes of work.
• Coordinate with procurement, commercial and project teams to track signage packages through award, fabrication and delivery.
• Review and coordinate signage shop drawings, product data, material samples, prototypes and mock-ups.
• Coordinate design consultant and Owner review of vendor submittals and track comments through to closure.
• Monitor fabrication progress and identify potential impacts to project milestones and installation dates.
• Coordinate long-lead signage items and required-on-site dates with the overall project schedule.
• Support evaluation and coordination of signage changes, scope adjustments and associated cost and schedule impacts.
• Maintain visibility of signage budget, commitments and changes in coordination with the project cost team.

Installation, Closeout and Handover

• Coordinate signage installation activities with contractors, vendors and the broader construction team.
• Monitor site readiness and installation sequencing to ensure signage installation is coordinated with surrounding construction activities and finishes.
• Conduct site walks and quality reviews to confirm installations align with approved locations, shop drawings, backing, and design intent.
• Identify and track signage deficiencies, installation issues and punch list items through resolution.
• Coordinate field changes or required signage modifications with the appropriate stakeholders.
• Track signage installation progress against the project schedule and escalate risks or delays as required.
• Coordinate final inspections, acceptance and turnover of completed signage packages.
• Support the collection and organization of signage closeout documentation, warranties, maintenance information and final record documentation.
• Coordinate handover of the completed signage and wayfinding program to the Owner and operational teams.

Project Controls and Reporting

• Maintain a comprehensive signage tracker identifying design status, approvals, procurement, fabrication, delivery, installation and closeout status.
• Maintain signage schedules, action logs, risk registers and decision logs as required.
• Track key signage milestones and dependencies against the overall project schedule.
• Prepare regular status updates highlighting progress, upcoming activities, outstanding decisions, risks and critical actions.
• Coordinate with project controls, cost, construction and document control teams to maintain accurate project records.
• Ensure signage correspondence, approvals, submittals and supporting documentation are appropriately recorded within the project document management system.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Relevant experience in signage, wayfinding, FF&E, design coordination, project management, construction management or a related discipline.
• Experience delivering signage and wayfinding programs on large-scale hospitality, gaming, entertainment, commercial or mixed-use developments preferred.
• Experience coordinating signage from design through fabrication, installation and closeout.
• Working knowledge of construction documentation, shop drawings, submittals and installation coordination.
• Experience working within multidisciplinary design and construction teams.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.

Skills and Qualifications

• Strong organizational and coordination skills with the ability to manage a large volume of signage across multiple areas, packages and stakeholders.
• Takes ownership of responsibilities and proactively addresses priorities to ensure successful completion of objectives.
• Ability to effectively coordinate designers, contractors, vendors, consultants and Owner stakeholders.

jobs.title: Territory Account Executive, Eastern Canada
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: This is a Remote Role for candidates based in Montreal, Quebec

About the Department

The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.  Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences.

What you'll do

You'll drive new business by identifying and qualifying target commercial accounts for Cloudflare’s Enterprise service plan. This is a great opportunity for a Sales Professional to help build the business in Eastern Canada. You will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.

Responsibilities

• Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan

• Increase sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets

• Create and articulate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services

• Manage contract negotiations

• Maintain a robust sales pipeline

• Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts

• Ensure customer satisfaction

• Develop and maintain partner relationships as it relates to customer base

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• Bilingual

• Minimum 3 years of direct technical sales experience

• Experience selling solutions related to Cyber Security, Networking, Cloud Solutions, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS is a plus

• Mid to advanced understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”

• Aptitude for learning complex technical concepts/terms (technical background in engineering, computer science, or IT strongly desired)

• Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills

• Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit

• Comfortable working in a fast paced, dynamic environment

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. jobs.description:

As an Experienced Heavy Body Technician, you’ll be expected to train other autobody technicians and perform extensive bodywork on multiple panels, including:

• Roof and rocker panel repair

Large area, heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

We have a variety of prep roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Entry-Level Prepper (min 1 year professional experience): perform light bodywork, including prepping, sanding, and buffing vehicles, removing and installing bumpers, single panel repair (including Bondo repair), and minor plastic welding

• Mid-Level Prepper (min 3-5 years professional experience): perform bodywork on multiple panels, including heavy plastic welding, minor metal pulling, roof and rocker panel repair, stud welding, and large area heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)

• Experienced Prepper (min 5 years professional experience): train other autobody technicians and perform extensive bodywork on multiple panels, including plastic welding, metal pulling, roof and rocker panel repair, and stud welding

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

The selected candidate will work closely with professional engineering staff to prepare designs, drawings, specifications, and cost estimates. The ideal candidate can interpret engineering plans, specification manuals, and water and sewer maps while maintaining accurate engineering records.

• High School Diploma/GED

• Valid Class “C” driver’s license and acceptable driving record

• Ability to pass Drug Screen and physical

Preferred Qualifications:

• Three or more months of experience using AutoCAD or Civil 3D

• Associate degree in a technical or related field

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word

• Experience using Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

The Engineer Technician I job responsibilities include:

• Transform survey data and field notes into accurate designs and drawings for engineering and planning projects

• Assist engineering staff with preparing designs, construction drawings, technical specifications, and project cost estimates

• Review plans for compliance with City standards and accepted construction practices

• Provide technical drafting, design, and project support to the In-House Design Group

• Communicate with residents, contractors, and consultants regarding applicable procedures and guidelines

• Conduct project site visits to collect measurements and verify existing field conditions

Apply Now! Come be part of something special in Fort Worth. 🌟

jobs.title: Physician
jobs.description:
Wound Care Physician – No Call, Zero Overhead

Are you tired of hospital politics, crushing administrative overhead, and shrinking clinical autonomy? Being a physician in Louisiana right now comes with unique pressures. Between navigating vague legal landscapes, battling insurance companies, and working with short-staffed teams, it’s easy to feel disconnected from why you entered medicine in the first place.

At Skilled Wound Care, we offer a different path. We are a leading national wound care physician group seeking motivated MDs and DOs who want to step off the hospital treadmill, leave the legal and administrative burnout behind, and get back to practicing pure medicine.

As a mobile wound care physician and independent contractor, you will provide critical, hands-on care to a vulnerable geriatric population in nursing facilities. You make the clinical decisions. You manage your outcomes. We handle the rest.

Why Transition to Skilled Wound Care?

• True Autonomy as an Independent Contractor: As a 1099 provider, you are truly your own boss. Enjoy the ultimate freedom, flexibility, and tax advantages of independent practice without the crippling overhead of running a traditional brick-and-mortar clinic.

• Practice Pure Medicine, Free from Politics: Leave the legal ambiguity and hospital micromanagement behind. Your only focus is healing the patient in front of you, utilizing the latest advancements in wound healing.

• Zero Overhead & Uncapped Earning Potential: Escape the financial strain of private practice. We handle the facility contracts and billing. Full-time physicians earn an average starting pay of $220,000 - $250,000 annually, with the potential to earn up to $300,000+ through additional services, performance-based bonuses, and no earning cap.

• Reclaim Your Time (No Call, No Weekends): Stop sacrificing your personal life. There are no nights, no on-call emergencies, and no weekend rounds.

• Say Goodbye to Data-Entry Burnout: We utilize a custom software system specifically designed to drastically reduce physician administrative and documentation time, so you can spend your time treating patients, not screens.

Compensation & Comprehensive Support

We invest heavily in our physicians so you feel confident and supported from day one:

• Pay Structure: Per-patient visit pay, per-procedure pay.

• Bonus Program: Quarterly bonus program with the potential to earn up to 30% extra income.

• Company-Provided Training: Comprehensive wound care training provided, including biannual CME conferences.

Requirements

• Medical degree (MD or DO) from an accredited institution.

• Active, clear, and unrestricted Louisiana medical license.

• Active and unrestricted DEA license.

• Note: You do not need to have completed a full residency program and do not need to be Board Certified/Eligible to thrive in this role.

A Supportive, Dynamic Environment

Wound care is a rapidly advancing field, and the current energy among our providers is electric. But don't just take our word for it:

"I love the camaraderie and support I receive from my colleagues at Skilled Wound Care. The last team retreat weekend in Miami was a great way to connect and learn from each other, developing greater enjoyment through our evening events." > – Dr. Tim O., former surgery resident and current SWC Physician.

If you are a compassionate, skilled physician ready to make a lasting impact on your community while reclaiming your career and personal life, we encourage you to apply.

Apply Today: Please visit https://www.skilledwoundcare.com/learnmorephysicianapplication to submit your CV and learn more about this exciting opportunity.

jobs.title: People Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Alloy is where you belong!

Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here.

About the team

Alloy's People team is small, senior, and rebuilding the function from the systems up. We run on Rippling and Ashby, we are actively replacing the tools we have outgrown, and we are wiring people data into the same business intelligence the rest of the company runs on. This role is the first of its kind at Alloy, which means the architecture is yours to define rather than inherit.

Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

What you'll do

Our People function is moving toward operating like a GTM motion: networked, data-fluent, and quick to act. You will be the infrastructure that makes that possible, and the technical partner the CPO leans on to turn people problems into systems and data solutions.

• Own the end-to-end architecture of Alloy's People tech stack, from Rippling and Ashby through to adjacent tools, so data flows cleanly and every system has a single source of truth

• Evaluate, pilot, and implement AI-native, agentic tooling across the employee and candidate lifecycle, and automate the manual work of onboarding, offboarding, org changes, and comp cycles that currently absorbs the People team

• Lead the overhaul and replacement of legacy People systems, and independently drive the build-versus-buy decisions that come with it

• Build the integrations and data pipelines connecting People systems to business intelligence and revenue systems, so talent data can be read against business outcomes the way pipeline data is read against revenue

• Design and maintain self-service reporting for workforce planning, hiring funnel health, retention, performance, and org design, so leaders answer their own questions instead of waiting on a report

• Establish data governance across every People system: access controls, audit trails, and quality standards, with lineage clear enough that any number traces back to its source

• Partner with IT and Security on system security, SSO, and compliance requirements including SOC 2 and data privacy

What we’re looking for

Must-haves:

• 4+ years in People Systems, People Analytics, HRIS, or a comparable technical operations role, ideally at a high-growth tech or fintech company

• Hands-on depth with modern HR tech stacks such as Rippling and Ashby, or comparable HRIS and ATS platforms, including configuration, API and integration work, and data architecture

• Strong SQL and data modeling skills, with reporting you have built yourself in Looker, Tableau, or a similar BI tool

• A track record of leading system migrations or consolidations, not just maintaining what already exists

• Sharp judgment on data privacy, access, and governance in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment

• The ability to translate technical systems work into business impact for non-technical stakeholders, including executives

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience integrating HR systems with business and revenue systems such as Salesforce or Gong

• Experience evaluating or implementing AI-native automation tools

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry

• Experience building talent intelligence or workforce planning models, or familiarity with compensation and equity systems

Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!

This position has a salary range of $180,000 to $200,000.

Benefits and Perks

• Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy

• Employee stock options

• Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options

• 401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation

• Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave

• Home office stipend for new employees

• Annual Learning & Development annual stipend

• Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health

• Hybrid work environment: employees are expected to work Tuesdays through Thursdays from our HQ in Union Square, Manhattan. Tasty lunches catered from a variety of local restaurants and frequent employee-organized cultural events contribute to our positive office energy. On Monday/Friday most employees Zoom into work from home while some take advantage of the quieter office.

How to apply

Apply right here! You've found the application!

Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.

All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an alloy.com email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Program Manager, Business Acceleration
jobs.description:
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.

About Astera Labs

Astera Labs is a global leader in semiconductor-based connectivity solutions that enable AI and cloud infrastructure. Our products help the world's leading technology companies build scalable, high-performance computing and AI systems.

We are looking for a technical, high-energy Senior Principal Program Manager, Business Acceleration to help drive execution across some of Astera Labs' most strategically important customer and business initiatives.

This is a highly visible role that works directly with senior leadership and partners across Sales, Product, Engineering, Field Applications, Supply Chain, and other functions to identify execution gaps, drive accountability, and accelerate business outcomes.

The Opportunity

The ideal candidate is more than a traditional program manager. You are technically credible, highly organized, comfortable operating with senior executives, and willing to relentlessly drive teams toward resolution.

You will bring structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives across strategic sales opportunities and product development operations involving semiconductor connectivity programs. You will identify blockers, establish clear ownership, track progress, escalate issues, and ensure that critical actions are completed.

Success in this role requires someone who can walk into a room with engineers, product leaders, sales executives, and senior management and quickly understand what roadblocks are in the company's strategic sales opportunities, ask the right questions, and drive the organization toward action and execution so that those opportunities convert into revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Program Management

• Lead recurring executive reviews of strategically important sales and business initiatives.

• Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, FAE, and other teams to identify blockers, dependencies, and execution risks.

• Establish clear action owners, timelines, and follow-through mechanisms.

• Track open issues to resolution and proactively escalate stalled or high-impact items.

• Develop concise executive-level reporting that clearly communicates progress, risks, blockers, and required leadership actions.

• Hold cross-functional stakeholders accountable for commitments and drive timely resolution of critical issues.

Customer & Market Program Intelligence

• Develop and maintain a view of major AI infrastructure buildout programs across key customers and market segments.

• Work with Sales, Product Marketing, Product Management, and other teams to understand customer programs, product adoption, competitive dynamics, and whitespace opportunities.

• Build customer and market heatmaps that identify where Astera Labs products are deployed today and where future opportunities may exist.

• Lead recurring executive readouts on customer program developments and business opportunities.

Business Acceleration & Strategic Planning

• Own programs designed to accelerate growth and close execution gaps against company objectives.

• Develop frameworks that connect customer opportunities, product initiatives, and execution priorities to broader business goals.

• Partner closely with senior leadership to track progress against strategic objectives.

• Identify systemic execution issues and help establish mechanisms to improve organizational responsiveness and accountability.

Semiconductor & Supply Chain Program Management

• Develop an understanding of semiconductor product development and manufacturing processes, including silicon development, validation, tape-out, foundry, packaging, and production.

• Over time, support monitoring of critical semiconductor supply-chain risks and dependencies across foundry, OSAT, substrate, and other key suppliers.

• Establish reporting mechanisms to identify emerging supply constraints and risks.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.

• Significant experience in program management, product operations, business acceleration, product management, or a related cross-functional role within the semiconductor, hardware, connectivity, computing, or AI infrastructure industry.

• Strong understanding of semiconductor and hardware product development processes.

• Ability to understand complex technical issues and communicate them clearly to both technical and executive audiences.

• Exceptional PowerPoint skills, with the ability to build clear, executive-ready slide narratives quickly, and demonstrated fluency with AI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and communication.

• Experience working across Engineering, Product, Sales, FAE, Operations, and/or Supply Chain organizations.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously and maintain rigorous follow-through.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and executive communication skills.

• Experience working with semiconductor, connectivity, networking, compute, storage, or AI infrastructure products is highly desirable.

Leadership Characteristics

We are looking for someone who:

• Drives accountability rather than simply tracking status.

• Is comfortable challenging senior stakeholders and escalating when commitments are not being met.

• Has exceptional executive presence and communication skills.

• Can operate effectively with incomplete information and rapidly changing priorities.

• Is highly persistent and willing to chase down the information needed to move an initiative forward.

• Combines technical depth with strong business judgment.

• Thinks like an operator and takes ownership of outcomes.

• Has the potential to grow into broader business or general management leadership.

Why This Role Matters

This is a highly visible opportunity to work directly with Astera Labs leadership on initiatives that span customers, products, engineering, and the broader business.

You will have the opportunity to build the operating mechanisms that help Astera Labs execute against its next phase of growth while working at the center of the AI infrastructure ecosystem.

This role is designed for a high-impact operator who wants to grow beyond traditional program management and take on increasingly broad business leadership responsibilities.

Salary range is $205,000 to $ 260,000 depending on experience, level, and business need. This role may be eligible for discretionary bonus, incentives and benefits.

We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.description:

Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delinea’s leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle – across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities – including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines – assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com http://Delinea.com, LinkedIn https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fdelinea%2F&data=05%7C02%7CMichele.Eaton%40delinea.com%7C766420d58b9a492d94ca08ddd6949f59%7C18d6ed03f0e5486183d2bb7b6c7c2bb2%7C0%7C0%7C638902656186877399%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=b1LCPIWSjxvblUYLlabUnRZ43S8rcspTQcBZsz0UbmU%3D&reserved=0, X https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fdelineainc&data=05%7C02%7CMichele.Eaton%40delinea.com%7C766420d58b9a492d94ca08ddd6949f59%7C18d6ed03f0e5486183d2bb7b6c7c2bb2%7C0%7C0%7C638902656186902236%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=goZhva9hWR8F0P5pO6SQUEwigdbvbZiWqmw5%2BHhhf1A%3D&reserved=0, and YouTube https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40Delinea&data=05%7C02%7CMichele.Eaton%40delinea.com%7C766420d58b9a492d94ca08ddd6949f59%7C18d6ed03f0e5486183d2bb7b6c7c2bb2%7C0%7C0%7C638902656186928751%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=uXgjuXTFu4kHWBJZ1XdNWN88Mrk5iT9Y24Ejw8fFBi8%3D&reserved=0.



Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS 

FY27 potentially takes our overall event portfolio from 20 events to 30, and program spend from $4.1M to $4.7M (excluding global major events)  

 

That growth needs more than additional hands. Two capabilities that decide whether a larger portfolio produces pipeline or just activity have never been formally staffed here: event measurement and a speakers bureau. This role is being created to build both — and to take direct ownership of our flagship Customer Conference.  

 

You will join a small, senior team of two event managers reporting to the Senior Director of Strategic & Major Events. This is a builder's role with an unusual amount of white space, in a function with real executive visibility and a budget to match. 

 


WHAT YOU WILL OWN 

1.  Customer Conference 

End-to-end ownership of our flagship customer event — a multi-day owned conference with a nine-to-twelve month runway. Venue sourcing and contracting, attendee journey design, content and agenda, production, and direct management of executive stakeholders and speakers. This is roughly 45% of the role. 

 

2. Core event strategy and execution 

Lead strategic planning and delivery for assigned major events. Set each event’s audience, objectives, budget, experience and measures of success. Build integrated plans with sales, demand generation, brand and communications, including promotion and post-event follow-up. Manage delivery against those plans and use results to improve future investment. 

 

3.  Event measurement, attribution and executive reporting 

Build the event scorecard and pipeline attribution model that this function does not have today, to a standard our finance organization will accept. Own the reporting cadence that tells marketing leadership what $7M of event spend returned, event by event and tier by tier. Your output is what every downstream investment conversation will be argued with. 



4.  Speaker’s bureau 

Build and run a speaker’s bureau for executive and subject matter expert participation across the portfolio. Maintain a speaker roster and CFP calendar, develop abstracts, and coordinate speaker preparation with the communications team.

 


WHAT YOU WILL BRING 

Required 

 - Eight or more years in B2B event marketing, with progressive ownership of larger and more complex events. 

 - Direct, end-to-end ownership of a multi-day owned conference — several hundred attendees or more — covering venue, content, production and executive stakeholders. Not a supporting role on someone else's event. 

 - You have built event measurement and pipeline attribution that a finance organization accepted and used. You can describe the model, not just the dashboard. 

 - You have run a speakers bureau or CFP program, including sourcing, preparing and coaching senior executive speakers. 

 - Experience at $5M or greater annual event program scale, across a mix of owned events and third-party sponsorships. 

 - Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders outside your reporting line — sales leadership and executive speakers in particular. 

Preferred 

 - Cybersecurity, identity security, or enterprise infrastructure software background. 

 - Experience running an event series for an acquired brand alongside a parent-company portfolio. 

 - Working fluency in Salesforce campaigns, campaign member status and lead flow. 

 - Global event experience, particularly EMEA.

Why work at Delinea? 

 - We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

 - We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

 - What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.



At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

 - Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

 - Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

 - Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

 - Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

 - Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

 - Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays. 

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Intern, MS/PhD, Software Engineering, Sys Intel & ML
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. If you’re a software engineer or researcher who’s curious and passionate about Level 4 autonomous driving, we'd like to meet you.

The subteam for this role will be:

Software non-determinism diagnostics team.

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

You will:

• Design and build infrastructure and tooling to diagnose software non-determinism across autonomous driving systems

• Investigate and resolve non-deterministic execution patterns across Waymo codebases

You have:

• Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD in software engineering or a related technical field

• Strong programming skills in C++

• Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and systems debugging

We prefer:

• Experience with statistical data analysis, anomaly detection, or tracing tools

• Understanding of common sources of software non-determinism (e.g., concurrency/race conditions, floating-point determinism, etc.)

• Experience with graph execution frameworks

General Perks

• Help solve challenging problems with a direct impact on the company

• Competitive compensation packages with a housing/relocation bonus (if applicable)

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Fun intern events and networking opportunities

Onsite Perks

• Free breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

• Free access to Google shuttles

• Onsite gym

Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.
