jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT SEMGREP

Semgrep, the leader in code security for builders, empowers invention without friction. Teams catch, flag, and fix real issues before they ship, powered by security that learns as they build. Semgrep secures code as it’s written and provides guardrails that pave the road for developers to move fast and stay secure. Built for builders and trusted by security, Semgrep lives where developers work, delivering fixes without breaking flow, and giving security teams visibility, control, and confidence. Semgrep gets smarter as you build, with AI that learns your context to cut false positives and prioritize reachable vulnerabilities, validated by 95% of security reviewers across 6M+ findings. Semgrep makes zero false positives a reality with AppSec teams triaging 80% fewer false positives across Code and Supply Chain, dramatically shrinking the backlog.


Founded in San Francisco and backed by Menlo Ventures, Felicis Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and Sequoia Capital, Semgrep is recognized by Gartner in Application Security Testing and is trusted by leading organizations, including Vanta, Lyft, and Dropbox. Learn more at semgrep.dev http://semgrep.dev.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to help build and scale our GTM operations. You will own the strategic direction and architecture of our revenue systems through our transition from seat-based to consumption-based pricing. You will partner with Sales, Finance, and Legal to design our systems with an AI native mentality. This is a cross-functional, high visibility role with real authority over the architecture of our systems and processes.

You’ll report to the Head of Revenue Operations and partner closely with GTM leaders. You’ll serve as a strategic operations leader and builder across GTM. 





WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the strategy, data model, architecture, and roadmap for our revenue systems, including our AI automaton GTM platform, CRM, and data enrichment platform

 - Own the systems design for an evolving pricing model across revenue systems, including consumption, usage-based rating, minimum commitments, true-ups, and proration

 - Redesign the deal approval process end-to-end: approval matrix, discount thresholds, escalation paths, and exception handling

 - Own contract design and operationalizing of new products and SKUs

 - Direct and prioritize work for the 3rd-party Salesforce admin team; translate business requirements into technical specs they can execute

 - Evaluate and implement automation/agentic tools to reduce manual deal desk and admin workload

 - Partner with Finance and Legal on contract structuring and billing system integration as needed for evolving pricing strategy and revenue recognition polices

 - Define reporting and forecasting requirements tied to the new pricing models

 - Maintain and enhance our current Salesforce instance (flows, processes, integrations), while directing the admin team's day-to-day execution
   




YOU ARE IDEAL FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE

 - 6+ years in RevOps, Sales Systems, or revenue systems architecture roles, ideally including CPQ/ARM implementation

 - Experience redesigning deal approval or pricing processes at a B2B SaaS company

 - Direct experience with a seat-to-consumption (or usage-based) pricing transition strongly preferred

 - Strong Salesforce/CPQ/ARM configuration knowledge, with the judgment to direct, evaluate, and course-correct a technical team's work

 - Experience managing or directing outsourced/contracted technical resources

 - Comfortable operating as a strategic partner to Sales, Finance, and Legal leadership
   
   


LOCATION EXPECTATIONS:

 - Our expectation is that this role will be based in our San Francisco office (Hybrid Model)
   
   


COMPENSATION

 - The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $162,000-$203,000 USD

 - Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, location, internal equity, and market data. Total compensation may also include equity and benefits. We view equity as a meaningful part of our compensation philosophy and an opportunity for employees to share in the long-term value they help create.







WHAT WE OFFER (FTE ONLY)

Our goal is to competitively and fairly compensate every Semgrep employee with a system that equally rewards those who are vocal and those who are less comfortable making demands during the final steps of the hiring process. To that end, we generate internal compensation bands that are used when discussing and negotiating salaries. We update these based on market data to make sure they’re above the average for comparable roles.

We invest in our employees’ well-being and long-term success through a competitive, market-aligned benefits program that meets or exceeds local market standards across all of the regions in which we hire. Benefits offerings vary by location to reflect local requirements and norms. For more detailed, location-specific information, please visit Semgrep Benefits https://www.notion.so/semgrep/Semgrep-Benefits-1593009241a88029bd7edf1fed1dfde2.




WHO WE ARE

We bring together people from a wide range of backgrounds and disciplines—from physics and philosophy to formal methods research and full-fledged corporations. We’re new parents and new grads, dog lovers and dogfooders. We get together often to bike, bake, and meet up in parks. In our interactions, we believe respect and honesty go hand in hand, and prioritize both.

Semgrep is an equal-opportunity employer seeking a diverse range of backgrounds. We value who you are — including your cultural heritage, your socioeconomic status, your age, your race, your gender, your sexual orientation, your disabilities. We value what’s vitally important to you — your family, your religion, your politics. We value what you love in this world — your music, your weekend pursuits. We believe in welcoming varied professional backgrounds, educations, and interests. If you’re exceptional in your role, believe in Semgrep’s mission, and treat Semgrep’s values as your own, you belong here.

Please Note: For US-based roles open to remote work, we are currently able to hire employees in the following states only: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

jobs.title: Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary

As part of the Electrical, Instrumentation & Controls (EI&C) Engineering, you will work collaboratively

with a cross-functional engineering team executing custom project designs, meeting customer expectations, quality, schedule, budget, and ensuring project risks are mitigated. This is a Senior role within the team, the chosen individual will complete the electrical and/or instrumentation design for a wide range of water technologies on complex projects in addition to acting as a technical lead and mentor new/junior team members. There is also the possibility of leading a team of EI&C Engineers on large, complex projects. This role will include performing instrument selections, instrument/automatic valve lists and datasheets, instrument installation details, electrical panel design including panel schematics, I/O lists, VFD/Starter selections, supporting our production facilities, participating in customer facing factory acceptance tests and assisting through commissioning.

Key Characteristics

• Ability to collaborate in and lead cross-functional project team discussions and client meetings.
• Proven ability to develop and follow procedures and standards, while extrapolating new concepts from established standards.
• Knowledge of and/or demonstrated ability to learn equipment and processes related to Veolia products and systems.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Read, interpret and comment on engineering documents, including P&IDs, GAs, process design guidelines, return of experience, and engineering best practices guides.
• Interpret, comment and follow complex, extensive contract and customer specifications.
• Perform required calculations and select the appropriate instrumentation for water treatment facilities as well as all supporting documentation (instrument lists, termination drawings, instrument datasheets, etc.) with operator and equipment safety in mind. Manage budget, scope, schedule and proactively report risks and opportunities to project teams.
• Select equipment and design complex low voltage industrial control systems in compliance with UL and CEC for water treatment facilities, including; single line diagrams/load lists, I/O lists, panel design and schematics, and network architectures, loop diagrams, etc.
• Support project bids, provide technical guidance and lead creative solutions to meet customer requirements.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Experience with design of complex low voltage industrial control systems in compliance with UL and CEC
• Experience designing control panels and selecting equipment for use in Class 1 Div 2 areas
• Excellent problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (including coordinating, reporting, documentation, and presentations).

Education & Experience

Required:

• Bachelor of Electrical Engineering or equivalent degree.
• Experienced with complex industrial control system design.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant or related experience.
• Valid passport and driver’s license.

Preferred:

• Understanding of hydraulics and fundamentals of fluid mechanics.
• Understanding of basic water chemistry.
• Strong focus on customer relationships (external/internal). Understands balance between customer and Veolia teams.
• Experience with control systems, Programmable Logic Controllers, HMI and SCADA design and programming.
• Basic technical knowledge in the field of industrial control systems.
• Understanding of Low Voltage Power Distribution System design.

Working Conditions

• Occasional travel (15%) for client meetings, customer site visits and/or visits to other Veolia offices.
• Hybrid office work. Three days a week in the office.

At Veolia, we realize diverse teams make smarter decisions, deliver better results, and build stronger

communities. We’re an organization that champions diversity and inclusion at every rung of the ladder

and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Because our people are our greatest assets, we

also offer competitive compensation and benefits that include:

The range is not an absolute, but a guide, and offers will be based on the individual candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions, as well as internal peer equity. Depending upon all the preceding considerations for the final selected individual candidate, the offer may be lower or higher than the stated range: $90,000 - $110,000 USD

• Flexible Spending & Health Saving Accounts
• AD&D Insurance

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this

posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable

law.

****Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not

sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H-1B visa) for this opportunity****

jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS.AI http://Nooks.ai:

Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.



Today, over 1,500 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We’ve raised $70M+ from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, which made its first sales-tech investment in over a decade with us. Since then, we’ve tripled ARR each year for 3 years running and grown a high-caliber team turning the art of sales into a scalable science.



About the role:
Location: Hybrid / 3 days Onsite – San Francisco, CA

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and ambitious People Operations Generalist to to help build and run the People infrastructure that supports our team as we scale. You’ll own and support many of the operational programs employees interact with throughout their time at Nooks - including HRIS, onboarding, benefits, leaves, immigration, Total Rewards administration, and employee lifecycle operations.

This role is a great fit for someone who loves making complicated things simple. You’re highly organized, operationally rigorous, and genuinely care about creating a great employee experience. You notice when something doesn’t work, dig into why, and build a better process rather than accepting unnecessary friction.

As Nooks scales, you’ll help us make sure our People operations scale with it - without losing the speed, thoughtfulness, and employee experience that matter to us.

What you'll do:

 - Own and develop core people operations processes, including onboarding, offboarding, benefits, compliance, and employee lifecycle management.

 - Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers navigating People programs, policies, and systems.

 - Help own our HRIS and broader People tech stack, including system configuration, employee data, workflows, integrations, reporting, and troubleshooting.

 - Own the operational side of onboarding and ensure every new hire has a smooth experience from signed offer through their first weeks at Nooks.

 - Administer benefits programs and support employees with enrollment, eligibility, qualifying life events, and benefits questions.

 - Manage employee leaves and accommodations in partnership with employees, managers, vendors, and Legal as needed.

 - Own the operational coordination of our immigration program in partnership with external immigration counsel.

 - Point of contact for employee questions and matters related to benefits, onboarding, immigration, leaves of absence, and time off.

 - Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal labor laws - and stay ahead of changes that impact our business and people.

 - Other People or general operations responsibilities as required by the People team on an ad-hoc basis.

We're looking for someone who has:

 - 3+ years of practical experience in a People or HR-related role - ideally in a high-growth startup environment.

 - Detail-oriented and data-driven mindset - ability to identify potential areas of improvement in our operational cadence.

 - Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple recurring processes, deadlines, and employee needs simultaneously.

 - Experience owning or significantly contributing to employee onboarding and lifecycle operations.

 - Working knowledge of employee leaves and core employment compliance requirements.

 - Experience administering employee benefits and partnering with benefits brokers and vendors.

 - System-mindset - look for ways to simplify, automate, document, and improve processes

 - Proactivity in problem-solving - you don’t just spot gaps; you fill them.

Nice to haves:

 - Knowledge of HR compliance and regulations.

 - Direct involvement in scaling startups from early-stage to larger organizational structures.

 - Experience with HRIS systems, people analytics tools, and large datasets.

You might be a great fit if:

You care about both sides of People Operations: operational rigor and employee experience. You want the data to be right, the process to be scalable, and the employee on the other end to feel supported.

You’re excited to join a small People team where you’ll have real ownership, broad exposure, and the opportunity to build systems that will support the next stage of Nooks’ growth!




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.  

Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

jobs.title: Upsell Representative
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARKETA

Arketa is building the operating system for modern fitness and wellness. Our mission is to make wellness more accessible by empowering studios and wellness entrepreneurs to grow beyond in-person classes. We provide a powerful, all-in-one platform to manage and scale hybrid wellness businesses, whether online, in-person, or both.

With Arketa, studios can manage schedules, accept bookings and payments, build on-demand video libraries, host retreats, run automated marketing, and launch fully branded apps and websites. We make it simple for founders to deliver a seamless, professional experience across every customer touchpoint. We've raised $15M in Series A funding and are growing quickly. It's a unique moment to join us. We're building a category-defining company in a fast-moving space, and we're looking for a leader who is excited to help shape what world-class partner support looks like in the wellness category.





ABOUT THE ROLE


As our Upsell Representative, you'll grow revenue inside our existing customer base by selling Arketa's full suite of add-on products, including our branded app, website, marketing, and phone products. As the flagship of this role, you'll pioneer our brand-new Payroll product as one of the very first people ever to sell it.

You'll help shape the pitch, the playbook, and the motion from the ground up. Working closely with Customer Success, you'll identify the right accounts, run tailored value conversations, and own the full expansion cycle from opportunity to close. This is a high-impact, ground-floor role for a seller who is energized by brand-new products and a clear path to grow revenue per customer.






ABOUT THE TEAM 

You'll sit on the Sales team and work shoulder to shoulder with Customer Success, who know our install base better than anyone and will be your closest partner in spotting the right accounts. You'll also work directly with the Payroll and Product teams, feeding real customer signal back into a product that is still taking shape.

This is a small, fast-moving team where the person doing the work also writes the playbook. If you like having a real say in how a motion gets built rather than inheriting one, this is that seat. You'll be given all inbound expansion interest, so your time goes into conversations and closing, not cold prospecting.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own the full expansion cycle, from spotting the opportunity to close, for Arketa's add-on products across the existing customer base

 - Pioneer our brand-new Payroll product as the flagship, alongside the full add-on suite (branded app, website, marketing, phone, and more)

 - Partner with Customer Success to identify and prioritize the right accounts using product usage and account data

 - Run tailored demos and ROI conversations that connect each add-on to the studio's goals

 - Meet and exceed your expansion and upsell quota

 - Maintain accurate pipeline management and expert-level forecasting in HubSpot

 - Help build the playbook: messaging, objection handling, and best practices for brand-new products

 - Feed structured product feedback back to the Payroll and Product teams

 - Use AI (Claude) to research accounts, personalize outreach, and move deals faster

 - Be an exemplary ambassador for Arketa, both internally and externally   




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

We believe in setting our team up to thrive.

 - 30 days: onboarded and fluent in Payroll, the add-on suite, and our install base. You're shadowing Customer Success and learning the accounts.

 - 60 days: an active expansion pipeline is built, your first Payroll and add-on deals are closed, and the early playbook is taking shape.

 - 90 days: you're consistently at or above expansion quota with reliable forecasting, and you have a repeatable motion for selling add-ons into the base. 




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 -    2+ years in SaaS sales, account management, or expansion and upsell, ideally selling into an existing customer base

 - Comfortable being an early seller of new products, where you help define the pitch and playbook

 - Strong at value and ROI conversations, and at multi-product storytelling

 - Excellent pipeline discipline and forecasting. You keep HubSpot immaculate

 - A relationship-led seller with a track record of exceeding quota

 - Strong written and verbal communicator. Scrappy and resourceful

 - Hands-on with AI (Claude) and comfortable with a modern sales stack (HubSpot, Avoma, Nooks)

 - Passion for fitness, wellness, and helping studios grow

 - BA/BS preferred.




BONUS: 

 -  Exposure to payroll, fintech, accounting, or embedded finance products

 - Experience selling payroll or financial software to small businesses

 - Experience launching a brand-new product line or expansion motion

 - Familiarity with the wellness and studio space (Mindbody, WellnessLiving, Mariana Tek, Momence)

 - Based in or near NYC, where our office is

 -  
   
   


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

 - You want to be the first person to ever sell a product, and you want your fingerprints on the pitch and the playbook

 - You'd rather work a warm install base and inbound interest than grind cold outbound

 - You're motivated by uncapped commission and want a clear line between your effort and your earnings

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity and can build structure where none exists yet

 - You're mission-driven and excited about wellness becoming more accessible
   
   


YOU MAY NOT WANT TO APPLY IF

 - You need a finished playbook, established messaging, and proven objection handling on day one

 - You prefer net-new logo hunting over expanding existing relationships

 - You want a large sales org with clear specialization and a defined promotion ladder already in place

 - You want a slower pace or a more established later-stage environment



What We Offer:

 - Ownership and Opportunity for Advancement

 - Competitive Salary and Stock Options and uncapped, performance-based commission

 - Unlimited PTO: our policy is designed to give you the flexibility to rest, recharge, and take care of personal needs, while staying aligned with your team and responsibilities.

 - Medical, dental and vision health insurance

 - Fitness Class Reimbursement: we're committed to supporting both employee wellness and our industry relationships. As an Arketa employee we see movement as opportunity.

 - Parental Leave Policy



For this role, the annual base salary is $60,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Commission and variable pay: on-target commission of approximately $35,000 per year at run-rate, paid monthly against an expansion quota. Commission is uncapped. On target earnings: approximately $95,000 per year at 100% of quota, at run-rate. Because commission is paid monthly across the first 12 months of each sale, first-year earnings ramp over the course of the year. In addition to base pay and commission, we offer equity. We believe in compensating fairly and transparently, and we're happy to provide more detail during the interview process.

Arketa is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. We actively encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters innovation and creativity, and we welcome candidates who share our values of respect, collaboration, and excellence.

jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend are looking for a Cost Manager and/or Quantity Surveyor to join our team and support construction cost services for our clients. The ideal candidate will be driven and promote our Turner & Townsend purpose and values.

• Advising client on strategies, managing prequalification of vendors, assessing proposals, bids, and bid levelling documents, making final recommendations to the client, attending & chairing bid interviews, and managing appointment process.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Director, Technology Alliance Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Acquia

Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out.

Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-CertifiedTM company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it!

Career Exploration at Acquia

Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia

You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary.

About the Role

We are looking for a Director to own Acquia's Technology Alliance Partnerships (TAP) ecosystem end to end. Our TAP program is large, diverse and growing: It includes large platform ISVs such as Salesforce and HubSpot, key Martech integrations for our DAM and other products, cloud platforms like AWS, OEM relationships such as Cloudflare and Akamai, and a new class of content-creation partners like Figma.

You will set and own the overall Technology Alliance Partnership strategy with Product for how these partners integrate with and extend the Acquia platform, drive go-to-market with our most important existing partners, and recruit and launch the next key integrations. This is a builder's role for someone who can operate as both a strategist and an operator: shaping the vision, then landing the partnerships and executing the business models that prove it out. You will lead a team and partner closely with Partner team, Product, Marketing, and Sales.

What You Will Do

• Develop and own the Technology Alliance Partner strategy across ISV, DAM, platform, OEM, and content-creator partner types.

• Manage Acquia's most strategic technology partnerships including joint planning.

• Own the AWS partnership, including co-sell, marketplace, and platform alignment.

• Build and execute joint go-to-market plans with key partners that generate qualified leads and sourced pipeline.

• Identify, recruit, and launch new technology partners, from initial evaluation through integration and GTM readiness.

• Build out a new business model for OEM relationships that scales revenue and clarifies packaging, pricing, and motion.

• Work cross-functionally with Product to understand the roadmap, prioritize key integrations, and align partner investments to where the platform is going.

• Partner with Marketing on joint campaigns and participation in marketing and partner events.

• Partner with Sales on OEM partnerships and co-sell deals, supporting the field where partner leverage moves opportunities forward.

What You Bring

• 5+ years in technology alliances, ISV partnerships, business development, or ecosystem strategy, with progressive leadership responsibility.

• A track record of building and scaling technology partner programs and generating measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.

• Direct experience owning or building co-sell motions with a hyperscaler (AWS strongly preferred) and familiarity with cloud marketplace mechanics.

• Fluency across multiple partner models: ISV integrations, OEM and embed relationships, and platform alliances.

• Strong cross-functional influence with Product, Marketing, and Sales, and comfort operating at the executive level internally and with partners.

• Commercial sensibility: you can construct partnership business models, not just relationships.

• Experience in DXP, CMS, DAM, martech, or adjacent SaaS categories.

• Familiarity with the Drupal or open-source ecosystem.

• Prior experience standing up or reshaping an OEM business model.

• People-leadership experience, with a history of hiring, developing, and retaining strong alliance talent.

What Success Looks Like

• A clear, prioritized technology alliance strategy adopted across the partnership org and validated by Product and Sales.

• A functioning OEM business model with named partners generating revenue.

• A high-performing, well-run team.

We are an organization that embraces innovation and the potential of AI to enhance our processes and improve our work. We are always looking for individuals who are open to learning new technologies and collaborating with AI tools to achieve our goals.

Acquia is proud to provide best-in-class benefits to help our employees and their families maintain a healthy body and mind. Core Benefits include: competitive healthcare coverage, wellness programs, take it when you need it time off, parental leave, recognition programs, and much more!

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Climate Modeling
jobs.description:
Persons in these roles are expected to work from our offices in Seattle. On-site requirements vary based on position and team. If you have questions about on-site work arrangements for this role, please ask your recruiter.

Our base salary range is $167,030 - $260,570, and in addition we have generous bonus plans to provide a competitive compensation package.

Who You Are:

We seek one or more Research Scientists for a new three-year project to develop an AI-powered physics-informed hybrid climate model trained on historical data that is capable of multidecadal forecasts that are more accurate than the current state of the art. We’re looking for someone with experience in AI and earth science who is excited to push the frontier in climate model development.

This position is supported by a grant with a current period of performance ending September 22, 2029. Continuation of the position beyond that date depends on renewal, extension, or identification of additional funding. Ai2 will make reasonable efforts to notify the employee if funding for the position is expected to end.

Who We Are:

Ai2’s Climate Modeling team is an international pioneer in using machine learning (ML) methodologies to improve on current physics-based climate models.  Our fast, accurate autoregressive open-source emulator, ACE, stably reproduces the climate and weather extremes of an existing climate model or a reanalysis. We have coupled ACE to a ML ocean model, trained it to  realistically account  for changing CO2 concentrations, and downscaled (super-resolved) ACE outputs from their 100 km native scale to to km-scale detail. Our tight-knit team of scientists and software engineers works closely with leading physics-based climate modeling centers to obtain unique training and testing data and get expert feedback on our progress. We collaborate with other leading research groups doing related AI work.

Your Next Challenge:

Physically-based climate models discretize equations representing individual time-evolving processes like clouds, rain, wind, land and sea-ice, and ocean currents on a computational grid.  Some processes (e.g. clouds) are less reliably encoded than others (e.g. winds).  Hence such climate models have biases in representing present-day climate and produce an undesirably large range of projections of future climate change for a given human-caused change in CO2 or other climate forcings.  Current AI-based climate models reduce present-day climate bias, but don’t generalize well to future climate change.

We are starting a 3-year project funded by google.org  to develop an open source ‘AI-first’ climate model that can demonstrably project future climates more accurately than current physically-based climate models when trained on historical observations by judicious design of the AI to incorporate physical principles that reliably apply in any climate, seen or unseen.   The model should be lightweight and easy for an ML-savvy climate scientist to train and deploy. Our starting point is the Google Research NeuralGCM model, a hybrid ML model that uses a conventional discretization of winds encoded in JAX and learns a column-local representation of all other atmospheric and land processes from historical data. Compared to other AI climate models, NeuralGCM uses ML in a conceptually simpler way and shows somewhat better future-climate generalization skill.   It is an open-weight model but its training pipeline  and documentation need to be adapted for a broader user community.

You will join a small team to develop the desired NeuralGCM+ model and foster its uptake by the climate modeling community.  This includes coupling it to an ML-based ocean model and designing approaches to demonstrably improve its skill in unseen climates.  This position has a three year term; there is potential for longer-term funding if  the NeuralGCM+ project demonstrates exceptional progress.

You'll get to work on:

• Designing, implementing and testing a strategy for coupling NeuralGCM with the chosen ocean model. Note that NeuralGCM is written in JAX and implemented on TPUs.

• Designing, implementing and testing a strategy for decomposing physical parameterizations and constraints into parts encoded based on physical equations vs. parts that can be learned (even for unseen climates) from historical observations.

• Presenting results at major relevant AI and climate modeling conferences and in peer-reviewed publications.

• Open-source code development as part of a tightly connected team, including daily meetings, code review, design documents and interaction with external collaborators.

• Mentoring postdocs and interns.

What You’ll Need:

• You must have substantial experience building and deploying a relevant ML application in a practical or academic research setting and be fluent in Python and collaborative coding practices.

• You must have a Ph. D. in computer or computational science, applied mathematics/statistics, or atmospheric science or a related geophysical science, with at least one accepted conference paper or peer-reviewed first-authored publication making extensive use of ML.

• Demonstrated excellent communications skills.

It's A Bonus If You:

• Have formal training and/or practical experience with physically-based atmospheric, oceanic, or related model development.

• Have previously held a professional or post-doctoral position using your machine learning skills.

• Have experience writing machine learning code in JAX.

• Formal graduate-level ML coursework.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

• Must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time.

• The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

• The ability to observe details at close range.

• Can work under deadlines.

A Little More About Ai2:

Ai2 is a Seattle based non-profit AI research institute founded in 2014 by the late Paul Allen. Our mission is building breakthrough AI to solve the world’s biggest problems. We develop foundational AI research and innovation to deliver real-world impact through large-scale open models, data, robotics, conservation, and beyond.

In addition to Ai2’s core mission, we also aim to contribute to humanity through our treatment of each member of the Ai2 Team. Some highlights are:

• We are a learning organization – because everything Ai2 does is ground-breaking, we are learning every day. Similarly, through weekly Ai2 Academy lectures, a wide variety of world-class AI experts as guest speakers, and our commitment to your personal on-going education, Ai2 is a place where you will have opportunities to continue learning alongside your coworkers.

• We value diversity - We seek to hire, support, and promote people from all genders, ethnicities, and all levels of experience regardless of age. We particularly encourage applications from women, non-binary individuals, people of color, members of the LGBTQA+ community, and people with disabilities of any kind.

• We value inclusion - We understand the value that people's individual experiences and perspectives can bring to an organization, and we are building a culture in which all voices are heard, respected and considered.

• We emphasize a healthy work/life balance – we believe our team members are happiest and most productive when their work/life balance is optimized. While we value powerful research results which drive our mission forward, we also value dinner with family, weekend time, and vacation time. We offer generous paid vacation and sick leave as well as family leave.

• We are collaborative and transparent – we consider ourselves a team, all moving with a common purpose. We are quick to cheer our successes, and even quicker to share and jointly problem solve our failures.

• We are in Seattle – and our office is on the water! We have mountains, we have lakes, we have four seasons, we bike to work, we have a vibrant theater scene, and we have so much else. We even have kayaks for you to paddle right outside our front door. We welcome interest from applicants from outside of the United States.

jobs.title: AI Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for an AI Transformation Manager to join Sia's ETI practice and help clients across energy, transportation, and industrial sectors successfully adopt and scale AI across their organizations.

This is a business- and strategy-facing role. You'll work with executives and operational leaders to identify where AI can create value, build the roadmap to get there, and lead clients through the change required to make adoption stick. You are not expected to write production code or build models yourself. Your value is knowing what today's AI tools and platforms can realistically do, translating that into a business case, and leading the organizational change that turns a pilot into an operating reality.

You'll join a growing ETI team, working day to day alongside Applied AI Leads and other Sia consultants who own the technical build, so you can focus on where you add the most value: strategy, stakeholder alignment, and delivery leadership.

What You'll Do

Lead AI Transformation Strategy

• Partner with executive and operational stakeholders to identify where AI can improve efficiency, productivity, decision-making, and customer outcomes

• Assess current business processes and operating models to identify high-impact AI use cases

• Develop AI transformation roadmaps aligned to business objectives and measurable outcomes

• Lead client workshops focused on AI strategy, prioritization, and adoption

Drive Delivery & Change Management

• Lead end-to-end delivery of AI-enabled transformation initiatives, partnering with Applied AI Leads and technical teams to translate strategy into execution

• Manage multiple workstreams while balancing scope, timelines, risks, and stakeholder expectations

• Establish governance, KPIs, and reporting to measure business impact and adoption

• Build trusted relationships with business and technology leaders

• Drive organizational adoption through communication, training, and change management

• Present recommendations and progress updates to executive stakeholders

• Mentor junior consultants and contribute to ETI practice development

Evaluate & Guide AI Tool Adoption

• Maintain working knowledge of Generative AI, AI agents, copilots, and automation platforms so you can evaluate options and advise clients, without needing to build or configure them yourself

• Assess vendor and platform options and recommend practical enterprise applications

• Support organizations in moving from pilot to production by aligning stakeholders, timelines, and change readiness, working closely with the technical build team

Business Process Improvement

• Analyze existing workflows and identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement

• Lead process redesign initiatives leveraging AI and digital technologies

• Build repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and documentation that enable sustainable transformation

Required

• 6-10+ years of experience in management consulting, business transformation, technology consulting, operations, or digital transformation

• Experience leading complex cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation

• Experience identifying business process improvement opportunities and driving organizational change

• Working knowledge of Generative AI, AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent automation platforms as a practitioner and evaluator (not required to build or code)

• Experience partnering with both business and technical stakeholders

• Strong executive communication and presentation skills

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client engagements in fast-paced consulting environments

• Bachelor's degree required

Preferred

• Experience serving clients in Energy & Utilities, Transportation & Logistics, Manufacturing, or Industrial Products

• Experience with AI platforms such as OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI, as a user and evaluator

• Experience with Agile delivery methodologies

• PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma, or other project management certification

• Familiarity with data visualization and project tracking tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

• Annual Base Salary Ranges, commensurate with experience and qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law. Associate Manager Level: $142,800 - $147,900Manager Level: $150,000 - $160,000
• Annual Performance Bonus

Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision; company-paid life and AD&D voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP
• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

• College savings and student loan repayment programs

• Paid parental leave; generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday

• Cell phone stipend; well-being and professional development programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Workplace

Sia values in-person collaboration. When serving clients, consultants may be required to work onsite at a client location based on engagement needs. Between client engagements, consultants are expected to work from a Sia office or approved coworking location at least three days per week. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a Sia office or approved coworking location. Sia maintains offices and coworking arrangements across multiple U.S. markets, including New York City, Charlotte, Greater Seattle, San Francisco Greater Bay Area, Los Angeles, Houston, Atlanta, Baltimore, Chicago, Washington D.C.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout their employment. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Our Commitment

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

jobs.description:
Regional Sales Manager, Specialty Injectables (Mid West / West Coast Region)

The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for leading a team of field-based sales professionals focused on large group practices, hospitals, health systems, and IDNs. This position is responsible for driving commercial growth and customer engagement for the Generics Specialty Injectables business vertical.

This role drives sales growth by coaching and developing talent, building strategic customer relationships, and executing customer-focused selling strategies. The ideal candidate brings strong pharmaceutical sales and key account management leadership experience, oncology experience, and a proven ability to lead teams that consistently deliver exceptional commercial results across complex healthcare environments.

Reporting directly to the Head of Sales; preferred candidate currently based in Chicago / Dallas / LA /San Francisco / Seattle / Denver area

Responsibilities:

• Lead, coach, and develop a sales team responsible for large group practices, hospitals, health systems, and IDN customers.

• Partner with the team to develop and execute customer-specific selling strategies and key account planning that drive business growth and maximize product adoption.

• Conduct regular field visits and customer interactions to provide coaching, support, and performance feedback.

• Document field coaching activities and follow-up actions through regular ride-along reports and development plans.

• Identify knowledge, competency, and skill gaps within the sales team and implement targeted development initiatives.

• Recognize and address performance challenges proactively, creating improvement plans and coaching interventions where appropriate.

• Collaborate with the Head of Sales to develop team capabilities and strengthen overall sales effectiveness.

• Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across key accounts, hospitals, health systems, IDNs, GPOs, and other institutional and large group practice customers.

• Support the sales team in navigating complex healthcare organizations, key accounts, large group practices and engaging key decision-makers.

• Drive execution of regional business plans and ensure alignment with organizational sales objectives.

• Utilize CRM systems, sales reports, and forecasting tools to monitor performance and drive accountability.

• Ensure timely and accurate reporting of sales activities, customer insights, and field intelligence.

• Manage regional sales budgets and expenses effectively.

• Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals and business objectives.

• Support successful product launches and portfolio expansion initiatives within assigned accounts.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Market Access, National Accounts, Customer Service, and other internal stakeholders to optimize customer outcomes.

• Play an active role in national and regional sales meetings, leadership discussions, and commercial initiatives.

• Lead all regional sales activities, including personnel management, performance management, and talent development.

Education & Experience:

• Bachelor's degree required

• Minimum 8+ years of successful pharmaceutical sales experience, preferably within Oncology, Specialty, Large Group Practices, Hospital, Health System, or Institutional markets.

• Minimum 3+ years of people leadership experience as a Regional Sales Manager or equivalent role leading Sales Representatives.

• Oncology experience is strongly preferred both large group practice and institutional and may include branded pharmaceutical sales, 505B-2, specialty sales, or oncology-focused healthcare sales experience.

• Experience selling into hospitals, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), physician offices, or institutional healthcare accounts preferred.

• Experience managing or partnering with GPOs and key account management responsibilities is highly desirable.

• Demonstrated success developing and executing customer-focused selling strategies that drive sales growth and market expansion.

• Strong coaching, talent development, and team-building capabilities with a track record of improving sales performance.

• Experience building or scaling high-performing sales teams is a strong plus.

• Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Strong business acumen and proficiency with CRM systems, sales reporting tools, forecasting processes, and Microsoft Office applications.

Must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident of U.S. or otherwise authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring visa transfer or sponsorship, now or in the future.

Dr.Reddy's Laboratories offers a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined on the basis of role, experience, skill set and location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including comprehensive health care coverage, retirement savings plan and leave benefits. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Senior Scientist I / II
jobs.description:
Biologics Drug Product Development (Bio DPD), a part of Development Sciences within AbbVie’s R&D, is a global organization that is responsible for drug product formulation and process development, and definition of the product presentation for biologics and genetic medicine (proteins, conjugates, peptides etc.).

AbbVie is seeking a highly motivated candidate for the position of Senior Scientist I, Biologics Drug Product Development, located in North Chicago, IL. We are seeking an accomplished scientist with a proven track record in biologics formulation and process development, and characterization. This position will be an integral part of the product development and CMC teams and will have strong collaborations with several stakeholders, including discovery research, analytical research and development, bioprocess development, combination products development, science and technology, pilot plants and third-party manufacturers.

Responsibilities

• Lead the design and execution of biologics drug product formulation and process development, characterization and robustness studies.
• Support scale-up and technology transfer activities to internal and external manufacturing sites.
• Keep abreast of the latest advances in biologics formulation and process technologies.
• Initiate and/or support scientific initiatives to drive innovation, continuously enhance capabilities and improve business processes.
• May represent the Bio DPD function in the cross-functional Product Presentation and Device Strategy Team (PPDST) and the CMC team.
• Effectively and timely communicates study plans, risks and mitigation plans to stakeholder and line management.

This position can be hired at Sr. Scientist I or II depending on education and years of experience.

Qualifications for Sr. Scientist I:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education and typically 10 years of experience, Master’s Degree or equivalent education and typically 8 years of experience, PhD 0+ years of industry experience.
• Proven ability to solve critical scientific problems.
• Hands-on experience with biologics formulation development.
• Hands-on experience with analytical and biophysical characterization of proteins and solid-state characterization methods.
• Solid understanding of biologics degradation mechanisms and stabilization strategies.
• Hands-on experience with Design of Experiments (DoE), multivariate statistical analyses and data visualization tools.

Highly Preferred Qualifications:

• Understanding of relevant cGMP and regulatory guidance.
• Experience with sterile manufacturing unit operations (freeze-thaw, mixing, filtration, filling, and lyophilization) development, characterization, scale-up and technology transfer.
• Experience in managing third party manufacturers.
• Experience with quality risk management and drug product control strategies.

Qualifications for the Sr. Scientist II:

• Senior Scientist II: 12+ (Bachelors), 10+ (Masters), or 4+ (PhD) years of relevant industry experience.
• Proven ability to solve critical scientific problems.
• Experience with biologics (proteins, conjugates, peptides and/or neurotoxins), parenteral synthetic molecules and/or genetic medicine (AAV, LNPs, cell therapy) drug product process development.
• Experience with sterile manufacturing unit operations (freeze-thaw, compounding, mixing, filtration and filling, lyophilization), characterization, scale-down models, simulation, scale-up, technology transfer, and batch record authoring.
• Hand-on experience with authoring regulatory filings for biologics and sterile parenteral products
• Experience leading drug product development as the functional lead within cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications:

• Biologics drug product formulation development
• Understanding of relevant cGMP and regulatory guidance for biologics and sterile parenteral products
• Experience in managing third party manufacturers of sterile parenteral products
• Experience with quality risk management and control strategies for biologics and sterile parenteral products

jobs.title: Gaming Producer
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

You will support an engineering systems organization responsible for keeping development workflows, builds, testing, and engineering systems running smoothly. You will coordinate day-to-day execution across engineering, product, and QA partners, facilitate Agile ceremonies, manage sprint planning and backlog health, track team velocity and capacity, and maintain visibility into milestones, dependencies, risks, and blockers. You will also coordinate release readiness, follow up on action items, maintain work-management documentation, and help ensure that critical-path work progresses predictably across teams.

Responsibilities

Agile Program & Sprint Management

• Facilitate sprint ceremonies including stand-ups, sprint planning, triage, office hours, and retrospectives.

• Manage sprint planning, team velocity, capacity, milestones, and delivery commitments.

• Create and maintain sprint and milestone dashboards, calendars, trackers, and transition checklists.

• Monitor backlog health and partner with leads and product managers to remove stale or outdated work.

• Track work-item assignments and feature delivery schedules.

• Identify, track, and escalate risks, dependencies, blockers, and delivery concerns.

Work Management & Documentation

• Create user story stubs, tasks, and bugs in partnership with engineering leads and product managers.

• Maintain accurate work-management documentation and pipeline information.

• Update work items with decisions, owners, status, next steps, and follow-up actions.

• Maintain action logs, reminders, workflows, and other execution-tracking mechanisms.

• Ensure blocked or at-risk work receives appropriate follow-up.

Meetings & Stakeholder Coordination

• Prepare meeting invitations, agendas, pre-reads, and status questions.

• Run meetings either synchronously or asynchronously and ensure clear follow-through.

• Represent features and workstreams in release forums with engineering and product stakeholders.

• Bridge communication across technical teams, creative partners, product stakeholders, and leadership.

• Coordinate partner commitments and cross-team dependencies.

Release & QA Coordination

• Support release readiness activities and track critical-path work.

• Review release queries, clear stale work, update relevant fields, and confirm next actions.

• Consolidate changelog feedback and track outstanding items through completion.

• Partner with QA on validation plans, test plans, reproductions, regression tracking, and release dependencies.

• Track readiness signals, unresolved bugs, validation dependencies, and release risks.

• Escalate decisions and issues when cross-team resolution is required.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience in engineering, product management, technical program management, data analysis, product development, or production.

• Hands-on experience with work-management and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or Confluence.

• Working knowledge of Agile or Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, team velocity, capacity, and milestone delivery.

• Experience coordinating projects, workstreams, or deliverables across multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical groups.

• Ability to bridge communication between creative professionals, programmers, product stakeholders, and executive-level stakeholders.

• Ability to operate effectively in a changing and evolving environment.

• Ability to adapt priorities and execution plans quickly while maintaining a positive and productive approach.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of experience in engineering, product management, technical program management, data analysis, or product development, or equivalent experience.

• Producer or Technical Program Manager experience within a gaming studio.

• 4+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

• Experience coordinating complex technical initiatives involving engineering, QA, product, and other partner teams.

• Demonstrated ability to motivate cross-functional teams and help resolve conflicts under tight deadlines.

• Strong experience with Agile execution, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, and release coordination.

• Experience working in an environment where delivery predictability, milestone attainment, and dependency management are important.

Salary Range

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is $33-$38 USD/hourly. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range.

Location: Remote PST hours

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Competitive paid time off

• Parental leave

• Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
Alloy is where you belong!

Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces, Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers, Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker, year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here.

Why we’re hiring

The Talent Acquisition team shapes who Alloy becomes. We come from different backgrounds and bring different skill sets to the work, we sit close to leadership, and we care about precision over volume. This is not a fill-the-req function. The programs, the process, and the culture of recruiting at Alloy are all still being built, and the people who join get a real hand in building them. Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.

What you’ll do

You'll run full-cycle searches with a center of gravity in GTM, and you'll shape how recruiting works at Alloy rather than only working the reqs in front of you.

• Own the recruiting cycle end to end for your searches, from sourcing and candidate engagement through the interview experience and the offer

• Build pipeline through creative sourcing across databases, referrals, events, and professional communities, treating sourcing as the core craft of the role rather than a step in it

• Partner with hiring managers across GTM, and occasionally other functions, to scope roles, set expectations, and advise on how to run a search well

• Stay embedded in the teams you hire for so you can speak to their work credibly with candidates

• Read the funnel and independently drive the fix when a search stalls, using metrics to locate the problem rather than to report on it

• Keep candidate and search records accurate in our ATS and report on hiring progress to leadership

• Lead the direction of recruiting programs and employer brand work that outlast any single search

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

• 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with real depth in GTM hiring across sales, marketing, client success, and operations

• Strong creative sourcing skills, with a track record of building pipeline for hard searches instead of working inbound applicants

• Experience recruiting at volume without letting candidate experience slip

• The ability to influence senior stakeholders and hold a point of view with hiring managers

• Comfort with recruiting data, using funnel metrics to diagnose a search and change course

• Fluency with modern recruiting tooling, including an applicant tracking system and sourcing platforms

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience at companies between Series B and IPO, where the hiring bar and the process were still being set

• Exposure to technical or G&A hiring alongside a GTM core

• A hand in building recruiting programs, employer brand work, or interviewer training

Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!

This position has a salary range of $139,000 - $164,000.

Benefits and Perks

• Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy

• Employee stock options

• Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options

• 401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation

• Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave

• Home office stipend for new employees

• Annual Learning & Development annual stipend

• Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health

• Hybrid work environment: employees are expected to work Tuesdays through Thursdays from our HQ in Union Square, Manhattan. Tasty lunches catered from a variety of local restaurants and frequent employee-organized cultural events contribute to our positive office energy. On Monday/Friday most employees Zoom into work from home while some take advantage of the quieter office.

jobs.description:
Join our vibrant team at The Mather, where we create meaningful moments every day. As a Lobby Receptionist, you’ll be the first point of contact for residents, families, and guests, providing a warm welcome, ensuring safety, and delivering exceptional concierge services.

This is a full-time hourly position. Weeknight, weekend, and holiday availability required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

• Provides exceptional customer service to all residents, guests, and visitors of the Mather.

• Maintains systems for secure storage and distribution of keys and key cards used by concierge and other experience centers.

• Provides administrative support for the update, storage and distribution of directories, Concierge handbook, safety and emergency procedures, parking assignments, training materials and participation, and other documents necessary to provide exceptional and efficient concierge services.

• Listens to resident concerns and requests; guides to existing solutions, communicates issues to appropriate experience centers; follow up to ensure positive and meaningful experiences for residents.

jobs.title: People Partner
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS.AI http://Nooks.ai:

Nooks is an applied AI lab building the Agent Workspace for GTM. We design AI agents that operate across the full sales action set, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.



Today, over 1,500 customers run on Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We’ve raised $70M+ from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, which made its first sales-tech investment in over a decade with us. Since then, we’ve tripled ARR each year for 3 years running and grown a high-caliber team turning the art of sales into a scalable science.



About the Role:
Location: Hybrid / 3 days Onsite – San Francisco, CA

Nooks is growing quickly, and we’re looking for an experienced, strategic People Business Partner to help us scale our teams, managers, and organization alongside that growth.

This founding role will directly influence leadership, drive cultural impact, and enhance operational excellence across the company. You’ll partner closely with leaders and managers across the employee lifecycle - helping them build strong teams, navigate performance and employee relations, make thoughtful talent decisions, and evolve their organizations as we scale. As a trusted advisor, you will lead key initiatives and support managers and employees to build a strong, high-performing organization.


What you'll do:

 - Own and drive key People functions, including manager enablement (talent management, coaching, training), business strategy alignment (workforce planning, change management, analytics), people program development (performance management, compensation, succession planning), and employee relations (PIPs, investigations, terminations, compliance).

 - Use periodic evaluations and frequent touchpoints to identify individual, team, and manager development needs, make recommendations, and partner closely with managers to implement strategies that measurably improve performance, engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

 - Provide guidance and leadership in the following areas: total rewards, leveling, employee engagement, culture development, organizational design, change management, employee communications, and people development.

 - Coach managers across the full range of people leadership topics, including feedback, performance, team dynamics, career conversations, employee engagement, and difficult conversations.

 - Partner with the broader People team on company-wide programs including performance management, career development, compensation, engagement, and manager enablement.

 - Execute on other People or general operations responsibilities as required by the People team on an ad hoc basis.

We're looking for someone who has:

 - 6-8+ years of HRBP experience within a high-growth tech environment.

 - Strong manager coaching skills and the ability to build credibility with leaders at multiple levels.

 - Deep experience managing employee relations and performance matters, including complex or sensitive situations.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly in sensitive situations.

 - Ability to recognize patterns and build scalable solutions without introducing process for process’s sake.

Nice to haves:

 - Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.

 - Experience partnering with founders to shape people strategies that drive performance, engagement, and organizational success.

 - Experience working in an international company, with a preference for experience in Ireland or London.

You might be a great fit if:

You’re energized by being close to the business. You want to understand how a team actually works, what its leaders are trying to accomplish, and where people or organizational challenges could get in the way.

You’re equally comfortable challenging a senior leader, coaching a first-time manager, navigating a difficult employee situation, and stepping back to ask whether the organization itself needs to change.

Most importantly, you see People partnership as more than responding to issues: you want to help leaders build stronger organizations before those issues happen.

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

They will work closely across functions to ensure alignment and effective execution of pricing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

• Pricing and Packaging: Analyze customer, product, competitive, and financial data to support subscription, usage-based, tiered, and bundled pricing strategies

• Pricing Analytics: Build and automate dashboards, reporting, and analytical frameworks; track performance and identify actionable insights

• Pricing Proposal and Execution: Support pricing proposals and new offering launches by coordinating requirements, timelines, data validation, stakeholder reviews, and post-launch monitoring for packaging and pricing changes

• Market Analysis: Conduct market research and competitive benchmarking to identify trends, gaps, and monetization opportunities

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Enablement, and Business Operations to communicate recommendations and ensure seamless execution

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of relevant experience in pricing, business analytics, finance, economics, strategy, or management consulting

• Experience with SaaS pricing models and frameworks, including subscription, usage-based, and tiered structures

• Strong data analysis and financial modeling skills, with the ability to distill complex datasets into strategic insights

• Ability to clearly communicate findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred

Salary Range: $68,000 - $95,000
