jobs.title: Strategic Leader, Private Equity Relations & Engagement
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role We are looking for a Strategic Leader, Private Equity Relations & Engagement to join our team. This is a Remote (US, preferably Northeast US or NYC metro area) role, reporting to the Global Private Equity Practice Leader in the [MISSING: INSERT DETAIL] department. The Strategic Leader, Private Equity Relations & Engagement builds and drives strategic engagements with key Private Equity (PE) partners to accelerate cyber resiliency, improve EBITDA, and mitigate risk across portfolio companies using the Zscaler Zero Trust platform. Serving as the primary point of contact for PE partners, this role orchestrates value selling, deal structuring, and cross-functional expert teams to demonstrate the impact of technology on investment theses. Through strategic relationship management and operational execution, you will originate pipeline opportunities, conduct performance reviews, and accelerate enterprise digital transformation across portfolio investments.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Build and manage strategic relationships with Private Equity partners, acting as the primary point of contact to execute joint go-to-market plans and conduct periodic QBRs

• Collaborate with account teams and PE portfolio leadership to originate pipeline, influence sales cycles, and drive secure digital transformation adoption

• Lead commercial partnership negotiations, deal structuring, and solution development tailored to PE transactions including add-ons, buyouts, and carveouts

• Partner with Business Value and Sales Operations teams to quantify savings, develop business cases, and track portfolio performance metrics and KPIs

• Mobilize internal product specialists, solution engineers, and advisory partners to advocate technology value propositions to C-level and non-technical PE stakeholders

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• Professional experience in Private Equity, Strategy Consulting, or Investment Banking advising on M&A transactions and influencing decisions in the PE market

• Deep understanding of Private Equity structures, operating models, LBOs, and key investment metrics including IRR, ROI, TCO, and EBITDA improvement

• Track record of leading strategic, value-based discussions with C-level executives and driving digital transformation or cost transformation initiatives

• Foundational understanding of cybersecurity principles, including cyber risk management and network security concepts

• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment with strong communication, analytical, consulting, and sales forecasting skills

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Master of Business Administration or equivalent Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or Management

• Top-tier consulting background with deep expertise in Private Equity, M&A strategy, or enterprise digital transformations

• Established network across top-tier Private Equity firms with demonstrated business development success in PE or VC sectors

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
Prelim is hiring our first dedicated recruiter. We're a profitable, remote-first company doubling revenue year over year, and hiring is now the constraint on growth. You'll learn to run full-cycle recruiting across engineering, sales, and implementations, trained by the people who built our recruiting process.

We’re looking for someone sharp, fast, and relentless about improving. Our interview loops, rubrics, and processes are already built — your job is to master them, run them, and eventually make them better than we could.

What you'll do

 - Run full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and supporting offers through close

 - Fill pipelines with cold outreach, referrals, and events — not just process inbound applications

 - Partner with hiring managers to understand what “exceptional” looks like for each role

 - Help run campus recruiting efforts

 - Track pipeline metrics and report what’s working and what isn’t

 - Protect candidate experience — fast loops, honest communication, clean closes

What we're looking for

 - Clear communicator with strong writing skills: you’ll write JD’s, reports, debriefs, offer letters, and internal documentation

 - Genuine interest in people: reading them, persuading them, advocating for them

 - Output volume you can point to — a role where you handled high throughput (customers served, calls made, events run, tickets closed)

 - Evidence you learn hard things fast — what, how quickly, and what the result was

 - A track record of top-tier performance: early promotion, top ranking, a team you led, a business you started

 - Nice to have: any exposure to recruiting, sales, or fintech

About Prelim

Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation.

We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company offsites.

Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

jobs.title: Discretionary Trading Internship - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Gelber Group -- Passion for Trading. Powered by Technology.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices across the United States and Europe, Gelber has set the bar as one of the industry’s innovative and enduring proprietary trading firms for more than 40 years. Our collaborative and entrepreneurial culture empowers each member of our team to have a meaningful impact from the start. We pride ourselves on a flat organizational structure and focus on meritocracy. If you flourish in a fast-paced environment, have a strong work ethic, and a competitive attitude, Gelber is right for you.

As a Discretionary Trading Intern at Gelber Group, you will begin your 10-week internship with an education portion covering basics of liquid capital markets, the various ways in which Gelber engages these markets, and the tools and technology that link us to the markets. Once you have a grasp of these concepts, you will be assigned directly to a discretionary trading desk.

This internship will begin in June 2027 and last until the first week of August 2027. We are considering recent graduates or candidates that are graduating in 2027 or 2028.

The approximate hourly rate for this position in Chicago, IL is $35/hr. This is a temporary role and is not eligible for employee benefits.

Position Overview

We are seeking highly motivated individuals to participate in a summer program in which they will learn and practice the development and execution of a rates-first macro trading process. Our primary goal in the internship is to evaluate candidates for full-time employment. As a result, our interests are best served by teaching you the necessary skills to demonstrate your talent and potential.

What You’ll Do

• Experience hands-on learning and sit on a trading desk with full-time traders

• Gain a thorough understanding of the financial markets through a robust program that will be intensive, challenging, and fun The classroom portion will be tailored to the topic areas that are useful for beginning to build a discretionary macro process Topics may include a basic understanding of each asset class, macroeconomic fundamentals, technical analysis, and risk management

• Develop a deep understanding of how macro traders engage with the market Pitch weekly trade ideas and receive in-depth feedback on quality and execution Potential for ideas to be turned into live risk taking

• Experience a multi-week simulated trading experience

• Send out daily and weekly reflections as you begin to build your own trading process

• Build the foundation of a macro trading process

Goals

• Gain hands on experience interacting with the market from a macro perspective

• Determine if this is the career you want to pursue

Qualifications

• Rising junior or senior in an undergraduate program, or recent graduate

• Interest in financial markets is a must, but prior experience or knowledge is not required

• Demonstrated interest in economics or a related field, via classwork or extracurricular activities

• Curiosity, self-motivation, strong communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with others in a competitive environment

• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to learn, understand, and apply new concepts

• Superior analytical skills with a proven strong mathematical aptitude

Why Intern at Gelber?

• Brand new office in the heart of Chicago’s River North neighborhood, attached to the Merchandise Mart and “El” stop, and a short walk from both Ogilvie and Union Train Stations

• Comprehensive 10-week program, running from June to August 2027

• Catered lunch provided Tuesday, Wednesday, & Thursdays and stocked pantry daily

• Social events and work/life balance that will allow you time to enjoy the Chicago summer

• Office amenities including a golf simulator, pool table, and company paid on-site gym

• Casual, relaxed dress code

• Comprehensive benefits package available for full-time employees

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read the Gelber Privacy Notice for California Employees and Applicants, linked here.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Encoura is seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help us attract, engage, and hire exceptional talent across our organization. We believe recruiting is a partnership between the Talent Acquisition team and hiring managers, with both equally invested in identifying and retaining top talent. We're looking for an experienced recruiter who excels at sourcing and building relationships with candidates, consulting with hiring leaders, and delivering an exceptional candidate experience. The ideal candidate combines strong recruiting instincts with a data-informed approach to hiring and enjoys supporting a variety of technology and business functions.

A Day in the Life

• Manage end-to-end recruiting for technology and business roles, including intake meetings, job postings, candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer facilitation

• Partner closely with hiring managers to define talent needs, align on hiring strategies, and provide guidance throughout the recruiting and selection process

• Deliver an exceptional, personalized candidate experience that reflects Encoura's values and fosters meaningful candidate relationships

• Collaborate with Total Rewards, Talent Operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure competitive and equitable offers, efficient hiring processes, and a smooth transition from candidate to employee

• Leverage our Applicant Tracking System (ATS), Greenhouse, to support the full recruitment lifecycle, including candidate management, interview coordination, workflow administration, and recruiting analytics

• Analyze recruiting data and trends to identify opportunities, address hiring challenges, and implement strategies that improve recruiting effectiveness and hiring outcomes

• Leverage sourcing platforms, networking strategies, and market research to proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates

• Utilize AI-enabled recruiting tools and sourcing technologies to enhance efficiency, build talent pipelines, and identify qualified candidates while maintaining a human-centered hiring experience

Role Progression

• Within 1 month, you’ll: Build relationships with hiring managers, become proficient in Greenhouse, and begin managing recruiting activities and candidate pipelines.

• Within 3 months, you’ll: Independently manage requisitions, build talent pipelines, and contribute to recruiting goals across assigned functions.

• Within 6 months, you’ll: Be viewed as a reliable recruiting partner, consistently delivering strong candidate experiences and contributing to hiring outcomes through effective sourcing, screening, and process management.

About You

• 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including recruitment for technology and business functions

• Working knowledge of employment laws, recruiting compliance requirements, and hiring best practices

• Ability to analyze recruiting data and identify opportunities to improve hiring outcomes

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills that reflect a high attention to detail

• Strong consultative skills with a demonstrated ability to provide business leaders of all levels with insights that improve hiring outcomes

• Passion for delivering an exceptional candidate experience and building meaningful relationships with candidates throughout the hiring process

• Experience utilizing sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other talent search tools

• Hands-on experience with Greenhouse or a comparable Applicant Tracking System (ATS)

• Experience supporting high-volume recruiting environments preferred, with the flexibility to contribute across a variety of hiring functions and business areas

• Experience in Higher Education preferred

• Successful candidates will be required to complete and pass a CLEAR™ identity verification as part of the pre-employment screening process CLEAR™ Candidate FAQ

The annual base salary range for this exempt position is $65,000–$80,000 and reflects the midpoint through maximum of the established range for this role. Encoura establishes compensation using national market data, internal equity considerations, and organizational budget factors to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization. Certain roles may also be eligible for variable compensation in addition to base salary. Employees in this role are eligible for Encoura’s comprehensive benefits package, which includes health insurance, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other programs that support employee well‑being.

Encoura’s mission is to empower students and institutions to create meaningful connections so everyone can make the most informed decisions to achieve their goals. jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend are looking for an experienced MEPS Senior Cost Manager and/or Quantity Surveyor to act as the key day-to-day client interface, ensuring client objectives are achieved through the delivery of value-added cost management services across advanced manufacturing, industrial, and mission-critical data center projects.

To be successful in this role, you must have excellent communication skills and be comfortable operating in a client-facing role. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently as well as part of a team. In this significant position, you will be responsible for providing leadership and direction, embedding, and promoting the purpose, values, and vision of Turner & Townsend.

Responsibilities:

• Estimate and negotiate change orders throughout the construction lifecycle for MEPS, process utility, and critical infrastructure systems.
• Prepare and present cost plans, estimates, and budgets for MEPS scopes and utility infrastructure.
• Partner with design teams and contractors to develop and validate MEPS cost estimates.
• Review and reconcile cost changes to ensure accuracy and alignment with project requirements.
• Meet with clients, contractors, and project teams to gather project information and prepare cost updates.
• Prepare written reviews and executive summaries of contractor cost submissions.
• Coordinate cost information from suppliers, equipment vendors, subcontractors, and design consultants.
• Support engineering and design decisions through cost analysis, constructability reviews, and commercial insight.
• Proactively identify and resolve MEPS cost and scheduling challenges.
• Perform cost checks, valuations, and cost verification on complex projects.
• Manage post-contract cost variances and change control processes.
• Maintain contingency, commitment, and cost impact tracking logs.
• Prepare funding presentations and support value engineering workshops.
• Develop and update cost plans throughout design and construction phases.
• Provide commercial input into design optioneering and value engineering initiatives.
• Review contractor pricing and lead cost negotiations on behalf of the client.
• Perform quantity surveying, cost controls, and change management activities.
• Manage MEPS cost audits, validation efforts, and financial compliance processes.
• Produce monthly cost reports highlighting project performance, risks, and opportunities.
• Support final account negotiations and project closeout activities.
• Compile benchmark and historical cost data across manufacturing, industrial, and data center projects.
• Identify, coach, and mentor talent to support team growth and development.
• Demonstrate strong leadership and service delivery across client commissions.
• Utilize internal systems to manage forecasts, fee tracking, resource planning, and financial reporting.
• Implement company delivery methodologies and business management systems to ensure best practices.
• Adhere to SOX controls and governance requirements where applicable.
• Foster a collaborative, high-performing culture that delivers exceptional client outcomes.
• Serve as a role model, supporting Turner & Townsend's purpose, values, and vision.

Project/Program Specifications:

• Experience in data center construction, advanced manufacturing, semiconductor, battery, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or large-scale industrial projects is strongly preferred.
• Experience supporting multi-billion-dollar capital programs, including hyperscale data center campuses, semiconductor fabs, battery plants, and advanced manufacturing facilities.
• Extensive experience managing costs associated with MEPS systems, process utilities, and critical infrastructure.
• Familiarity with mission-critical environments where reliability, redundancy, commissioning, and speed to market are key project drivers.

• Bachelor's degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in a cost management role within the construction industry.
• RICS accredited or actively pursuing accreditation is preferred.
• Experience leading cost management efforts on medium to large-scale construction projects of moderate to high complexity.
• Construction consultancy experience is strongly preferred.
• Strong knowledge of procurement strategies, cost planning, value management, value engineering, and construction delivery methodologies.
• Extensive experience with MEPS systems, process utilities, and critical infrastructure on manufacturing, industrial, and/or data center projects.
• Experience reviewing complex mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, controls, and specialty systems estimates.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client-facing skills.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $150K-$190K USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com, saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service.

At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you.

Learn more at www.ada.cx.

About the Role

We are seeking a Partner Sales Director to sit at the center of Ada's co-sell engine, turning partnerships into revenue. You'll be the connective tissue between Sales and Partnerships — embedding with AEs to source and accelerate deals, arming partners to bring Ada into their conversations, and shaping the ecosystem strategy that decides which partners we double down on next. This is a role for someone who's equally energized closing an individual deal this week and building the joint GTM plan that drives the next twenty.

• 7+ years in partnership roles, ideally within B2B SaaS

• Proven track record building and executing co-sell motions with measurable, attributable pipeline and revenue

• Hands-on experience with CRM and partner ecosystem tools, such as Salesforce and PRM platforms

• Excellent communication and enablement skills — able to get both partners and internal sellers deal-ready

• Comfortable operating both in individual deals and at ecosystem strategy level

Outcomes

• Build and run joint GTM plans, account mapping, and territory planning with priority partners across our primary verticals

• Grow marketplace revenue by accelerating wins through AWS and Microsoft

• Drive net new pipeline growth sourced directly from partners

• Increase the share of closed/won business influenced by partners by advising reps on the right partner to engage, when, and how

• Keep partner-supported deals clean and trackable by maintaining accurate partner notes in Salesforce

• Remove friction in deal registration, pricing, and contracting by working cross-functionally with Deal Desk and Sales Ops

• Shape where Ada invests next by spotting white space in the partner ecosystem and recommending new plays to Partnerships leadership

Benefits & Perks

Benefits

jobs.location: United States, UNITED STATES, United States
jobs.description:
Overview

Experian's Fraud Analytics & Commercialization operates across four main functions. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms.

We're looking for a motivated Data Scientist to help build fraud detection models and features that identify high-risk activity while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Core skills for this role include an eagerness to collaborate, and empathy. You will will dig into surprising signals in the data and to learn how that insight becomes a deployed model.

You will help investigate the latest fraud patterns, build features, and train and evaluate machine learning models. You will work with senior data scientists and engineers starting with problem definition through feature engineering, experimentation, and deployment. You will be a developing programmer, ready to translate theoretical principles into production-ready solutions.

We continue to sharpen through research and the engineering that turns those findings into tools and systems built for commercialization.

This is a remote role and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics.

What you'll do

• Investigate large datasets, including exploratory analysis and fraud label development, to identify latest fraud patterns, attack methods, and behavioral signals.
• Translate ambiguous fraud and risk problems into clear hypotheses, analytical plans, model requirements, and measurable success criteria.
• Develop machine learning models for fraud detection across account opening, account takeover, and identity risk.
• Evaluate models using metrics like ROC/AUC/KS/Gini, precision/recall, fraud capture rate, false-positive rate, customer friction, and fraud losses prevented.
• Develop and validate predictive features using identity, transactional, consumer credit history, device, behavioral, temporal, velocity, network, and third-party data.
• Write clean, efficient, well-tested Python and PySpark code, and collaborate with teams to bring models and features into batch, retro, or real-time decisioning environments.
• Monitor feature quality, model performance, population changes, and fraud-pattern drift
• Design and present analyses for model behavior, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations
• Follow appropriate standards for data privacy, model documentation, explainability, validation, and governance.

Qualifications

• At least 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a related quantitative field
• Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, statistics, engineering, data science, or another quantitative discipline
• Direct experience developing fraud-detection, identity-risk, credit-risk, financial-crime, or other adversarial risk models.
• Demonstrated experience creating meaningful fraud features
• Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with experience writing modular and tested code for large datasets and distributed or cloud data systems.
• Experience using common data science and machine-learning tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or comparable technologies.
• Knowledge of supervised learning, model evaluation, feature selection, statistical inference, experimentation, and model calibration.
• Experience navigating challenges common to fraud modeling, including class imbalance, delayed or incomplete labels, changing attack patterns, and model drift.
• Experience moving models beyond experimentation and into production, either directly or in close partnership with engineering teams.
• #LI-Remote

Benefits/Perks:

• Great compensation package and bonus plan
• Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K
• Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office
• Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays
• Explore all our exciting benefits here: https://yourexperianbenefits.com/cand-index.html

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose-driven culture is multi award-winning. We have won World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few.

DiDi's autonomous driving unit was established in 2016 with the mission of developing Level 4 autonomous driving (AD) technology to make transportation safer and more efficient. In August 2019, the unit became an independent company, DiDi Autonomous Driving, dedicated to advanced AD R&D, product application, and business expansion. At DiDi Autonomous Driving, we firmly believe that the future of mobility goes beyond simply "utilizing AI"—it will be fundamentally reimagined and entirely driven by an AI-Native architecture.

We are seeking a visionary, highly technical, and mission-driven Staff or Principal AI Transformation Engineer to act as the ultimate catalyst for our company-wide AI transformation. In this strategic, high-impact leadership role, you will combine cutting-edge Large Language Model (LLM) expertise, robust systems architecture design, and a proven track record of enterprise-level AI scaling. Own the architectural design of our unified, distributed AI platform spanning complex data processing, model training, inference pipelines, and evaluation frameworks.

Pinpoint engineering bottlenecks, eliminate friction, and translate complex AI capabilities into production-ready internal ecosystems (e.g., AI DevOps, AI Copilots).

Optimize GPU cluster utilization, minimize inference latency, and maximize throughput across large-scale production environments.

Qualifications & Experience

Proficiency in core languages such as C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.

• Hardcore AI Infra Experience: Years of deep, practical experience in distributed LLM training/inference optimization and large-scale compute cluster infrastructure & operations (I&O).

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics
jobs.description:
Process Engineers on the Process Engineering team are key partners for customers in the North American market. They are creative technical leaders who support the successful sale, engineering, commissioning, and operation of complete system solutions. To deliver winning solutions, they apply deep technical knowledge of our solutions and technologies combined with an understanding of the customer’s process, the market, regulations, and our competitors to continually balance technical risk with commercial viability.

On complex flow sheets with multiple unit processes, a Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics is included on the project to own the overall solution for our customer in collaboration with one or more Process Engineers with expertise in the various technologies used in the flow sheet. A Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics requires the abilities and expertise of a Process Engineer, and the technical, leadership, and communication skills of an Engineering Project Manager. The Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics requires domain expertise to act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and technical point of contact in customer and internal communications. From a technical perspective, they have responsibility for the overall treatment solution including strategizing on the creation of that solution (safety factors, flow fluctuations, assumptions), identifying and managing the impacts that any given unit process will have on upstream/downstream unit processes as well as process risks, and owning the overall process flow

diagram, accompanying flow and quality balance, and overall process guarantees. From a leadership perspective, they proactively communicate across the team of Process Engineers, manage the process deliverables (schedules, assignments), and represent Process Engineering in review meetings at the

bidding and engineering stages. If process issues arise, they lead the troubleshooting effort and

resolution.

As the focal point of the Process Team for projects, the Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics functions as a dual-path expert. Their time allocation is strategically divided into approximately 60% Communication, Organization, and Coordination, where they manage process deliverables, schedules, and cross-functional representation. The remaining approximately 40% is dedicated to Technical Expertise, acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) who owns the overall treatment solution, including process guarantees and the troubleshooting of complex issues.

The Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics for the Microelectronics market will lead proposals and projects in execution for our Microelectronics customers’ ultrapure water (UPW), wastewater, and reclaim treatment needs.

Key Characteristics:

• Leadership
• Customer focus and commercial mindset
• Analytical mindset
• Creativity
• Responsibility
• Collaboration
• Accountability

Duties and Responsibilities:

Microelectronics Project Technical Leaders lead the process design of ultrapure, wastewater, and reclaim treatment solutions for the Microelectronics industry.

Responsibilities will include:

• Align a team of Process Engineers working together on a flow sheet to a strategy (including influent design basis, safety factors, handling of flow variations, how to meet the customer’s needs, how to win against the competition), a list of deliverables, and a schedule, and ensure that all process deliverables meet quality and schedule for the project
• Lead the design of complete water, wastewater, or waste treatment solutions (flow sheet, unit processes, process parameters) that will meet the customer’s requirements for a given influent and required effluent stream qualities using various in house and industry design tools, acting as the leader for a team of Process Engineers providing technical expertise on specific portions of the overall flowsheet.
• Apply advanced treatment technologies including biological treatment, ammonia removal, solids separation, low- and high-pressure membrane treatment (ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, reverse osmosis - conventional and high-pH), ion exchange, UV treatment, and gas-transfer membrane processes to meet the stringent requirements specific to the microelectronics industry
• Own the overall Process Flow Diagram (PFD), associated flow tables or mass balance, and overall process guarantees, including management of the interconnections between unit processes and consideration of any impacts of one unit process on upstream or downstream unit processes, with input from the Process Engineers on the team.
• Engage in piloting and benchmarking and treatability studies as part of design, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of UPW treatment solutions
• Serve as a lead technical contact with our customers, building partnership relationships, and representing the team of Process Engineers working on the flow sheet together
• Serve as the lead technical contact with other functions working together on the project
• Identify and support management of technical risks related to the treatment process (flow sheet, unit processes, achievement of outputs), including compiling the risks throughout the flow sheet in collaboration with the Process Engineers on the project team
• Troubleshoot technical issues using data and observations
• Understand relevant regulations and liaise with regulatory agencies as needed
• Own and be accountable for the success of assigned projects throughout project development as measured by achieving treatment requirements (successful operation) and customer satisfaction through proactive communication, collaboration, and leadership of corrective action management, in collaboration with the team of Process Engineers on the project
• Demonstrate Veolia’s expertise in the external market through customer and conference presentations
• Provide training and 1:1 coaching to members of the Process Engineering team

Industry Leadership and Expertise:

A Process Engineering Project Technical Leader builds long-term relationships with customers and key experts in the industry and presents at industry conferences and technical forums to position Veolia as experts within the microelectronics market. They serve as an expert within the business, participating in innovation of solutions, technologies, and markets, and training and mentoring others in process design.

Qualifications:

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Ability to design complete integrated water, wastewater, or waste treatment solutions, including preliminary design of associated tanks, rotating equipment, piping, instrumentation, and controls
• Ability to integrate multiple main unit operations (e.g. clarifier, MBR, RO, thermal) into a single flow sheet with consideration of recycle streams, flow variations, and a range of influent qualities
• Demonstrated leadership skills
• Exceptionally strong oral and written communication skills in English for customer facing communication (including presentations) as well as internal collaboration and influence
• Proactive organization and time management
• Excellent computer skills (i.e., Excel, Word and PowerPoint and Google Suite analogues)
• Ability to exercise good judgement under changing conditions
• Critical and creative thinking, and ability to evaluate among numerous options
• Data analysis
• Effective troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Education and Experience:

Required:

• Bachelor or advanced degree in an Engineering field – Environmental, Chemical, or Mechanical preferred, or other technical discipline with a combination of process design and hands-on microelectronics water and wastewater treatment system experience
• 10+ years of related experience, preferably process engineering specific, with an emphasis in process design and/or operation of water, wastewater or waste treatment
• Demonstrated experience with UPW, wastewater, and reclaim treatment processes and system design/operation for the microelectronics industry
• Leadership experience or demonstrated leadership competency to connect people, set and communicate a vision, align and inspire a team towards an objective, train/coach/mentor others, and confidently make effective decisions with limited information under evolving conditions

Preferred:

Why Veolia?

• You'll receive comprehensive technical and commercial training, direct mentorship from experienced Account Managers, and a clear pathway to Account Manager promotion with direct account responsibilities.

Career Development Path:

Ready to transition your technical expertise into a rewarding customer-facing career while

making a difference in water treatment and sustainability? Apply today!

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
BUILT DIFFERENT

We believe there's a better way to build. One that moves faster, thinks bigger, and gives people the ownership to challenge what's been done before. We're not here to follow the standard. We're here to set a new one. We don't believe the best work happens inside rigid boxes. People are given real ownership, real responsibility, and the space to operate beyond a title. Scope grows with impact. Responsibility grows with trust. And the people who step up help shape what comes next. We're building an organization around ownership, not hierarchy, where your influence is defined by what you take on, not what's written on your email signature.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The infrastructure is ambitious. The people behind it should be too.

We need a Mechanical Engineer who thinks from first principles, questions convention, and wants the weight of owning the outcome. Someone who can design it, stand behind it, solve for it in the field, and build the runway as they go.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

+   Design it: Own mechanical system design end-to-end: chilled-water plants, air-cooled and direct-liquid-cooling (DLC) systems, piping, and fire protection.

+   Stamp it: Take professional responsibility for calculations, drawings, and specifications as Engineer of Record, not a reviewer of someone else's work, the author of it.

+   Build it: Stay close to construction and commissioning, catch conflicts before they become delays, and sign off only when it's actually right.

+   Challenge it: Push on cost, constructability, and third-party engineering deliverables without cutting the corners that matter.

WHAT YOU BRING

+   Active Professional Engineer (PE) license.

+   7+ years designing mechanical systems for data centers, industrial, or other mission-critical facilities.

+   Working knowledge of IMC, IPC, IECC, NFPA 13, ASME B31, and ASHRAE TC 9.9, backed by hands-on experience with chilled-water plants and liquid-cooling architectures.

+   Comfortable reading and redlining P&IDs, single-line diagrams, and construction documents without help.

+   Experience working directly with contractors, vendors, and construction teams through commissioning.

BUILT FOR THIS

If you are mission-driven, ownership-minded, drawn to hard problems, willing to challenge convention, and ready to build the playbook.

If you aren’t waiting for every answer, looking for layers of approval, leading from a distance, attached to “the way it’s always been done,” or looking for just another role.

BONUS POINTS

+   10+ years and multi-site U.S. data center delivery experience.

+   CFD or thermal-hydraulic modeling (AFT Fathom, ANSYS, or similar).

+   Background at a company that self-performs its own builds rather than relying on a GC.

+   Experience integrating with BAS/controls systems.

"People are our greatest differentiator: an environment where high performers thrive, where collaboration drives impact, and where careers are shaped by opportunity, not hierarchy."

Asher Genoot, Architect

JOIN US ON OUR MISSION TO BECOME THE #1 RETAIL TRADING PLATFORM IN THE WORLD

Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're empowering traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.

Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Since 2003, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. Through those efforts, our user base has grown to over 2 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

What you'll do:

NinjaTrader's Trade Surveillance team is being built to protect the integrity of our markets and our partners' programs by catching fraud and abuse before it costs anyone money. As a Staff Product Data Analyst, you'll own building and maintaining the in-house detection layer — the models and rules that flag wash trading, collusion, and eval/prop-firm fraud across our trading data — and the partner-facing surveillance reports built on top of them. Engineering builds the data pipeline; you define what runs through it, applying market-structure judgment to turn raw fills into defensible fraud findings that partners and leadership can act on.

In this role you will:

• Own and evolve the detection models and rules that flag market abuse — wash trading, hedging and reverse trading, collusion and coordinated accounts — across our trading data

• Own partner-facing surveillance reporting end to end, starting with standardized end-of-day reports and evolving toward real-time monitoring

• Work directly with eval and prop-firm partners to validate true and false positives, calibrate detection quality, and tune thresholds and rules

• Collaborate with partners on custom reporting and solution feasibility for partner requests

• Translate fraud patterns into precise, tunable detection logic across matching criteria, hold-time thresholds, recurrence windows, and P&L severity scoring

• Maintain data quality and hygiene across the surveillance data that feeds detection and reporting

• Investigate flagged cases end to end and produce clear, evidence-backed findings that partners and internal leadership can act on

• Reduce false positives continuously and surface new fraud patterns as bad actors adapt

What you'll need:

• Deep trade-surveillance or market-risk experience, including hands-on knowledge of market-abuse patterns such as wash trading, hedging, reverse trading, collusion, and copy trading, and how each can produce benign-looking lookalikes

• Working knowledge of futures/derivatives trading mechanics — fills, positions, and P&L — and what abusive trading looks like in practice

• Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery and Athena preferred), and comfort investigating large, messy transactional data

• Proven ability to design detection rules or anomaly models and defend them analytically — including precision/recall tradeoffs, thresholds, and validation — with domain judgment leading the analysis

• 10+ years in data analytics or data science, ideally in trading, fraud, risk, fintech, or market surveillance

• Ability to maintain data quality and turn technical findings into clear, concise reporting for partners and executives

Bonus Points for:

• Master's degree in analytics or a related quantitative field

• Prior prop-firm or brokerage experience

• Python or experience with fraud, AML, or surveillance tooling

• Experience building toward real-time or streaming detection

Compensation:
The salary range for this role will be $162,000.00 - $212,000.00 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of 12%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).

Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader. NinjaTrader offers a 401(k) plan through ADP under which the company will match up to 3.5% of employee contributions. Annual paid time off allowance accrues at a rate of 23 days per year plus seven paid holidays.

Location:

This role is based in Chicago, IL. *There may be remote flexibility for exceptional candidates in the following states: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington DC, Wisconsin.

Hybrid:

For Chicago-based employees, we follow a hybrid work schedule: In-office Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. In addition to these weekly remote days, we offer:

• 20 additional flex remote days annually

• 6 Company Wide Office-Optional weeks tied to major holidays

OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Under NPR’s Employee Code of Conduct, the Senior Manager, Policy and Representation will be considered “Outward-Facing Employee”, and as such should (i) avoid public participation in political and partisan activities in order to protect NPR’s reputation and its ability to pursue its mission; and (ii) refrain from public statements or actions that might call into question NPR’s commitment to accuracy and fairness.

Application Deadline

The application window will be open until Friday, October 9, 2026, at 11:59 PM Eastern Time.

Responsibilities

• Track, analyze, and brief internal leadership on legislative, regulatory, and industry developments impacting NPR, including copyright, artificial intelligence, telecommunications, and privacy policy.

• Build and maintain a sophisticated political network across Capitol Hill and federal agencies, serving as a registered lobbyist; manage LDA compliance activities pertaining to NPR.

• Meet with Hill staff, including Committees relevant to NPR, to educate them on NPR and its role and impact in the public radio system.

• Conduct in-depth research on Members of Congress and executive branch officials to develop effective political and advocacy strategies.

• Lead NPR’s representation with federal regulatory bodies, including the Federal Communications Commission, including monitoring regulatory developments and collaborating with internal offices to evaluate and respond to the impacts of FCC proceedings on public radio.

• Proactively build and maintain relationships with associations, media industry organizations, and other national-level stakeholders that engage on matters of importance to NPR; represent NPR policy perspectives at the national level.

• Research and track upcoming congressional events, industry convenings and administrative policy announcements and keep NPR leadership informed on policy developments relevant to NPR.

• Partner with the NPR Sr. Manager for Communications & Engagement on communications to a wide variety of policy stakeholders.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

• Excellent skills in tracking legislative and policy developments and demonstrated policy experience in copyright, artificial intelligence, telecommunications or privacy issues.

• Existing professional networks on the Hill, particularly in telecommunications or AI policy.

• Experience navigating the legislative process and working on nonpartisan advocacy initiatives.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in supporting external policy-related communications across a wide range of stakeholders.

• Proficient in the use of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Google suite products

• Exceptional organizational and time management skills and ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

• Collaborative working style, experience working in small teams, and the ability to complete high-quality independent work.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience creating new programs, policies or coalitions to advance company outcomes

• Experience representing media organizations within their industry and in other industries that affect media

• Affinity for public radio’s mission and service

• Experience working with a variety of stakeholders and external partners on complex policy issues

Education Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in public policy, government affairs, journalism or related field

Work Location & Requirements

• Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the Washington, D.C. office 3 days per week, on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location.

Job Type

• This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The anticipated U.S.-based salary range for this opportunity is $147,000-$165,000, plus benefits. The displayed range reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to offer new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

#LI-HYBRID

About Lumafield: 
 
Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing.
 
We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.
 
Engineers make million-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. We rebuilt the whole system, from X-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again.

Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to help us scale our technical programs and launches - coordinating across engineering, product, and other functions to land some of our largest initiatives. As a Staff TPM, you’ll have the ability to create and drive programs, and partner with us to figure out where we should be investing that we aren’t today. TPM as a function is new to Suno, and there’s a real opportunity to help us build it from the ground up




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead cross-functional programs end to end — things like model launches, multi-team engineering efforts, and engineering initiatives  — from scoping, through rollout, and tracking

 - Coach and grow the team's TPM, building the mentorship and structure that hasn't existed here before

 - Help shape what "TPM" means at Suno — the working model, the organizing principles, and where the function needs to grow

 - Partner closely with engineering leadership so cross-functional continues to move fast and collaboration is easy, contributing directly to team velocity

 - Help turn Suno's mission — making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone — into shipped, coordinated reality across teams




WHAT YOU'LL NEED


MUST-HAVES

 - 8–10 years in program or technical program management

 - Demonstrated adaptability — you find the right approach for the environment you're in rather than importing what worked somewhere else

 - A clear, articulable framework for how you evaluate and measure whether a program is actually succeeding

 - Enough technical/coding fluency to get hands-on and understand the work that needs to be done, not just coordinate around it


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Track record of building a program from zero in genuine ambiguity and landing it

 - Experience coaching or mentoring other program managers

 - Background at a consumer tech company, a high-scale tech company, or a hypergrowth scale-up

 - Experience coordinating launches for AI or ML-driven products




WORK LOCATION POLICY

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.




ADDITIONAL NOTES

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.




PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)




COMPENSATION:

 - The annual salary range for this role is $230,000 - $300,000 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)



Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Materials Manager
jobs.description:
About Vital Lyfe

At Vital Lyfe, we are on a mission to solve global water scarcity by creating innovative desalination systems. This is an opportunity to join a passionate, multidisciplinary team tackling one of the world’s most critical challenges, water.

Mission

The Materials Manager owns the flow, accuracy, and readiness of materials across Vital Lyfe operations. This role ensures all parts, assemblies, and hardware are received, stored, moved, issued, and shipped correctly to support production, engineering, and customer delivery. The Materials Manager leads inventory personnel, maintains inventory integrity, drives cross-functional resolution of material issues, and continuously improves processes to scale our fulfillment and manufacturing systems.

What You'll Do

 - Oversee end-to-end materials operations, ensuring parts and hardware are received, stored, issued, and available to support production and engineering needs.

 - Ensure timely and accurate movement of materials between receiving, storage, production lines, and shipping to support operational flow and schedule demands.

 - Ensure outbound shipments are executed correctly and on time, with all required documentation, traceability, and packaging/handling completed to preserve product integrity through delivery.

 - Maintain visibility and status communication for critical shipments and ensure shipment records remain accurate in required systems.

 - Maintain accurate inventory records and system integrity, including resolution of discrepancies and required adjustments.

 - Ensure inventory is properly controlled, including shelf-life, FIFO/stock rotation, environmental/storage requirements, and configuration/revision compliance.

 - Ensure picking, kitting/de-kitting, staging, and material fulfillment activities support schedule and work order commitments.

 - Maintain inventory levels and storage organization necessary to support operational demand.

 - Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve material, inventory, and fulfillment issues and to disposition obsolete or excess inventory.

 - Drive continuous improvement, cost efficiency, and achievement of site operational metrics.

 - Maintain safe, clean, and audit-ready operations in alignment with all safety, quality, and compliance requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

 - 2+ years of experience in materials management, inventory control, warehouse operations, or supply chain roles in a manufacturing or hardware environment.

 - 2+ years of experience leading teams or supervising materials/warehouse personnel.

 - Working knowledge of inventory accuracy practices, traceability, and material flow in production environments.

 - Experience operating within ERP/MRP systems and maintaining high data integrity.

 - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage priorities across production, engineering, and shipping demands.

 - Proven ability to drive process improvements and resolve operational issues cross-functionally.

 - Ability to work on-site in a fast-paced hardware environment.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience supporting regulated or high-reliability manufacturing environments

 - Familiarity with quality-driven inventory controls (serialization, lot trace, shelf-life).

 - Experience scaling warehouse/material systems for new product introduction and growth manufacturing.

 - Lean/continuous improvement background

 - Forklift/material handling certification (or ability to obtain).

Physical / Working Requirements

 - Ability to work in warehouse and production areas with routine lifting, carrying, and movement of materials.

 - Ability to stand/walk for extended periods and work around active operations safely.

 - Must be able to lift 50 lbs. unassisted.

 - Must be able to climb ladders and be comfortable working in tight spaces.

 - Must be able to move repetitively, bend or twist, and use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools or controls.

Why Join Vital Lyfe?

 - Work on high-impact problems with global relevance

 - Help scale breakthrough technology in water security and climate resilience

 - Early ownership in a high-growth, engineering-led startup

 - Join a tight-knit, mission-driven team in a fast-paced environment

 - Build long-term career equity as we grow

Location Requirement: Ability to work 100% onsite in Torrance, CA (remote or hybrid work will not be considered)



Vital Lyfe is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vital Lyfe is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Director - Internal Communications
jobs.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

THIS IS A CONTRACT (12 MONTH) TO PERM POSITION BASED IN OUR NEW YORK CITY OFFICE.

SoundCloud is looking for a Director of Internal Communications to lead the strategy and execution of our global internal communications program. Based in New York, this role will partner with senior leadership and teams across the company to strengthen how SoundCloud informs, engages, and connects our global workforce.

A key priority for this role will be leading the successful migration and launch of SoundCloud’s next-generation intranet. You will serve as the communications and program lead for a large, cross-functional team spanning People & Culture, IT and Cybersecurity, Brand, Communications, Finance and SoundCloud’s Webflow owners. You will establish the project’s governance and roadmap, align stakeholders, oversee content strategy and migration, and drive employee adoption of the new platform.

This role is crucial to fostering a strong culture of collaboration, inclusion, and connectivity by ensuring employees have timely access to clear, useful, and engaging information.

If you are a strategic leader, skilled storyteller, and experienced change communicator who is passionate about creating a best-in-class employee experience, and you know how to bring complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and oversee a comprehensive internal communications strategy serving employees across SoundCloud’s global offices, including New York, Los Angeles, Berlin and London, setting the strategic direction in close partnership with the executive team

• Lead SoundCloud’s intranet migration from planning through launch and adoption, including platform governance, stakeholder alignment, information architecture, content strategy, content auditing and migration, testing, training and ongoing optimization

• Serve as the central program lead for a cross-functional intranet working group spanning People & Culture, IT, Brand, Finance and more, establishing clear roles, milestones, decision-making processes and accountability

• Partner with technical and business stakeholders to ensure the new intranet meets employee needs while aligning with SoundCloud’s brand, security, privacy, accessibility and operational requirements

• Partner with Chief of Staff to produce agenda, content, and coordination of speakers for internal events, including monthly company-wide All Hands

• Counsel executives and senior leaders on communications that provide employees with clarity, context, and connection to SoundCloud’s business priorities

• Identify and manage opportunities to elevate SoundCloud and its executives through relevant industry awards and recognition programs, including developing and submitting compelling nominations

• Oversee SoundCloud’s internal editorial calendar, delivering timely communications related to company strategy, People initiatives, organizational change and workplace culture

• Align internal messaging, employee experience and employer branding with SoundCloud’s mission, core behaviors and product positioning

• Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to develop employer-branding strategies that position SoundCloud as a best-in-class employer and help attract a diverse pool of candidates on Linkedin, Glassdoor and beyond.

• Manage and continually improve SoundCloud’s internal communications channels, including the intranet and employee newsletters, using engagement data and employee feedback to assess effectiveness

• Partner with People and Workplace teams to develop communications strategies that increase engagement and enhance the employee experience

• Collaborate with the DEI team and Diversity Resource Groups to promote initiatives and programming through messaging that fosters understanding, inclusion, and engagement across the organization

• Monitor trends and emerging practices in internal communications, employee engagement, and workplace technology, providing guidance and new ideas to internal stakeholders

Experience and Background:

• 8+ years of internal communications experience within a global company or agency environment

• Demonstrated experience leading a large-scale intranet implementation, migration or digital workplace transformation involving multiple business and technical functions

• Strong program and project-management skills, including experience establishing governance, coordinating complex workstreams, managing competing priorities and holding stakeholders accountable to deadlines

• Experience leading change-management and employee-adoption programs for new platforms, systems or ways of working

• Ability to translate business, technical, security and employee-experience requirements into a clear strategy and executable plan

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across cultures, functions and levels of seniority

• Experience developing and executing internal communications strategies within a global organization

• Confidence working with and providing counsel, guidance and constructive feedback to senior executives

• Exceptional design and branding acumen, with experience developing presentations, videos and creative collateral

• Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, adapt quickly and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment

• Proven ability to build alignment, navigate differing stakeholder perspectives and move complex cross-functional initiatives forward

• Experience using data, analytics, and employee feedback to assess communications effectiveness and improve engagement

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $175,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below!

About us:

• We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)

• We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home

• We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard

• We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

• Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources

• Robust 401k program

• Generous professional development allowance

• Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!

• Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

jobs.title: Tech Specialist, Planning & Control, Dream Drive
jobs.description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to support the auto-parking and low-speed autonomy stack. This role focuses on trajectory optimization, path smoothing, and local planning, with direct impact on parking features such as Auto Park, Summon, and Park-to-Park. The ideal candidate will combine strong algorithmic foundations with production-grade software execution, driving both system performance and scalability. This role is based in Newark, CA. and requires employees to be onsite five days a week.

Key Responsibilities:

• Motion Planning & Trajectory Optimization Develop and enhance trajectory optimization algorithms (e.g., iLQR / MPC-based approaches) for low-speed scenarios Design and implement constraint-aware optimization, including Improve local planners to generate control-friendly trajectories

• System Architecture & Performance Optimization Refactor and scale planning stack architecture for maintainability and extensibility Optimize CPU usage and explore parallel/GPU acceleration opportunities Improve system-level behaviors such as: Stability under dynamic constraints Scalability across scenarios and vehicle platforms

• Debugging, Validation, and Production Integration Investigate and resolve real-world issues such as: Curvature discontinuities, velocity/trajectory mismatches, and edge-case steering behavior Validate solutions using: Simulation and vehicle logs Multi-scenario testing and benchmarking

• Research, Prototyping, and Innovation Evaluate and prototype new approaches (e.g., learned models, barrier functions, ML-based planning) Benchmark and compare planning algorithms for production viability Contribute to next-gen planning initiatives, including ML-driven planning

• Cross-Team Collaboration & Knowledge Transfer Drive technical discussions and share algorithm insights across teams Maintain high-quality documentation and support knowledge transfer Track work via Jira with clear metrics and reproducible results

Required Qualifications:

• M.S. or Ph.D. in Robotics, Control, Electrical Engineering, or related field

• 5-8+ years of software development experience in autonomous driving, ADAS, or robotics, with a focus on large-scale data and real-time systems

• Strong programming skills in C/C++ with solid understanding of software engineering design principles and best practices

• Proven track record of delivering ADAS/AD features through the full production lifecycle: requirements analysis, architecture/design, implementation, unit testing, feature tuning, SIL/HIL validation, and in-vehicle deployment

• Hands-on experience with software integration on embedded platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Xavier/Orin, Infineon Aurix)

• Demonstrated ability to build reliable production-grade systems, including large-scale architectures, evaluation pipelines, and performance-optimized models

• Leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• ML-based planning approaches

• GPU or parallel computing for planning

• Track record of production deployment in real vehicles
